66474.recognize_zh: H&E 為混合性小淋巴球背景中散在大型細胞，CD30 與 CD15 只標出零星大細胞（膜與高基體型態）、PAX5 弱陽性，符合典型何杰金淋巴瘤 (classic Hodgkin lymphoma)；cyclin D1 弱染 HRS 細胞（紅箭頭），FISH 可見 IGH::CCND1 融合訊號（白箭頭）。
features: H&E: effaced lymph node with a polymorphous background of small lymphocytes and histiocytes containing scattered large atypical cells
CD30 and CD15: only scattered large cells positive with membranous and paranuclear (Golgi) staining; background negative
PAX5: weak nuclear staining in scattered large cells, with few strongly positive background B cells
Cyclin D1: weak staining of a Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cell (red arrow) and positive histiocytes (blue arrow) against negative small lymphocytes
t(11;14) dual-fusion FISH: interphase nuclei with separate red and green signals plus a yellow fusion signal (white arrow)
66474.describe_en: Lymph node section shows effacement of architecture by a polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes and histiocytes with scattered large atypical cells. The large cells are positive for CD30 and CD15 with membranous and Golgi-pattern staining and show weak PAX5 expression, consistent with Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells. Cyclin D1 shows weak staining in the Hodgkin cells as well as positive histiocytes, while the small lymphocytes are negative, and there is no sheet-like mantle cell infiltrate. Interphase FISH with an IGH/CCND1 dual-fusion probe demonstrates a fusion signal in the neoplastic cells. Findings are consistent with classic Hodgkin lymphoma harboring IGH::CCND1, supporting clonal relation to the patient's prior mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Recurrent MCL shows monotonous sheets of small-to-medium cyclin D1-positive, CD5+/CD20+ B cells, whereas here cyclin D1-negative small T cells form the background and only rare CD30+/CD15+ large cells are present.
ALCL cells are more numerous, form sheets or sinusoidal clusters, are PAX5 negative and usually CD15 negative with T-cell or ALK/EMA expression.
TCHRLBCL large cells are strongly CD20 and PAX5 positive and CD30/CD15 negative.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer or polymorphic lymphoproliferation
ddx.vs: These contain HRS-like cells but are EBER positive and CD20 retained, while this case is EBER negative.

66474.stain: H&E; IHC: CD30, CD15, PAX5, cyclin D1; FISH

66154.recognize_zh: 低倍 (10× 物鏡) 下即可看到許多有核細胞一端拖出細長尾巴、核偏向另一端，呈手鏡狀 (hand-mirror cells)，散布在紅血球背景中；細節有限，須在高倍與流式確認為淋巴母細胞。
features: Low-power field with numerous nucleated cells scattered among densely packed red cells
Many cells show polarized shape with the nucleus at one pole and a narrow elongated cytoplasmic tail at the other
Admixed round nucleated cells with dark, condensed nuclei (smaller lymphoid cells or blasts without tails)
Nuclear detail, chromatin and nucleoli cannot be assessed at this magnification
66154.describe_en: Low-power smear shows numerous nucleated cells distributed among red cells, many of which have a polarized contour with an eccentric nucleus and a single narrow cytoplasmic projection, consistent with hand-mirror cell morphology. Chromatin pattern, nucleoli and cytoplasmic granularity cannot be evaluated at this magnification, and Auer rods cannot be excluded. The findings are suggestive of acute leukemia with hand-mirror blasts, which in this case represents acute lymphoblastic leukemia; high-power review and flow cytometry are required for lineage assignment.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with uropod-forming blasts
ddx.vs: Myeloid hand-mirror blasts are MPO positive and may show granules or Auer rods at high power, whereas lymphoblasts are MPO negative.
Artifactually elongated cells lack intact membranes and show streaming nuclear chromatin rather than an intact cell with a discrete cytoplasmic tail.

ddx.dx: Monocytes or activated lymphocytes with pseudopods
ddx.vs: Mature monocytes and reactive lymphocytes have condensed chromatin and more abundant cytoplasm on high-power review and are not TdT or CD34 positive.

66346.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中正常造血組織被多形性浸潤與纖維化取代，背景有小淋巴球、組織球及少數嗜伊紅性球，箭頭處為一顆具明顯大核仁的大型非典型細胞（Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg 細胞），符合古典型何杰金氏淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓。
features: Effacement of intertrabecular marrow by a polymorphous infiltrate with fibrosis and streaming spindled stromal cells
Background of small lymphocytes, histiocytes, plasma cells and scattered eosinophils
Scattered large atypical cells with abundant cytoplasm and a prominent nucleolus (arrow, Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-type cell)
Normal hematopoietic elements largely absent in this field
Magnification is low to intermediate, so nuclear detail of the large cells is limited
66346.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows marrow spaces between bony trabeculae effaced by a polymorphous infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes, histiocytes, plasma cells and scattered eosinophils within a fibrotic stroma. Scattered large atypical cells with abundant cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli are present (arrow), consistent with Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-type cells. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by classic Hodgkin lymphoma; confirmation by CD30, CD15 and PAX5 (weak) immunohistochemistry with CD45 negativity is recommended.

ddx.vs: Large cells are CD20+, CD45+, CD30− and CD15− in a T-cell- and histiocyte-rich background lacking eosinophils.
Neoplastic T cells show a spectrum of atypical cells with loss of pan-T antigens and clonal TCR rearrangement rather than rare CD30+/CD15+ large cells.
Reactive processes lack large atypical cells with macronucleoli and CD30/CD15 positivity.
Myelofibrosis has clustered atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei rather than Hodgkin cells with inclusion-like nucleoli in an inflammatory background.

66282.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指為一群細胞中核質比高、染色質細緻並有一個明顯大核仁的母細胞；周圍布滿前骨髓球、骨髓球、後骨髓球、帶狀及分葉核中性球，並有血小板聚集，呈典型 CML 的連續成熟光譜，母細胞只是其中少數。
features: Arrowed blast: large cell with high N:C ratio, round nucleus, fine chromatin and a single prominent nucleolus
Blast cytoplasm scant to moderate, pale blue-grey, without visible Auer rods
Surrounding cells show a full spectrum of granulocytic maturation: promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils
Occasional cells with dark granules possibly representing basophils; platelet clumps present
Red cells normocytic without significant poikilocytosis; overall appearance of marked leukocytosis
66282.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis with a full spectrum of granulocytic maturation, including promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils, with clusters of platelets. The arrowed cell is a blast with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, a prominent nucleolus and scant agranular cytoplasm, without Auer rods. Blasts appear infrequent relative to maturing forms in this field. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive; a manual differential with blast and basophil counts is needed to stage the disease.

ddx.vs: Reactive states show predominantly mature neutrophils with toxic changes and few myelocytes or blasts, lack basophilia, and are BCR::ABL1 negative.
aCML shows prominent dysgranulopoiesis and CMML shows monocytosis ≥10%, whereas CML has well-granulated cells with myelocyte and neutrophil peaks and basophilia.
Separated by counting blasts (≥20% for blast phase, or an increasing proportion) and basophils rather than by the morphology of a single blast.
CNL shows ≥80% segmented/band neutrophils with <10% immature granulocytes and CSF3R mutation, lacking the myelocyte bulge seen here.

exam.answer_en: Chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive — marked leukocytosis with full granulocytic maturation spectrum and an occasional blast
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指 blast 問名稱，再問整體診斷；CML 抹片特徵為 myelocyte 與 segmented neutrophil 雙峰、basophilia、少量 blast。
診斷：BCR::ABL1（t(9;22)(q34;q11) Philadelphia chromosome），以 karyotype、FISH 或 RT-PCR 確認；p210 最常見。
WHO 5th 將 CML 分為 chronic phase 與 blast phase（取消 accelerated phase）；blast phase 為 blast ≥20%、髓外芽細胞增生或周邊/骨髓出現 lymphoblast 增加。ICC 2022 仍保留 AP。
治療以 TKI（imatinib、dasatinib、nilotinib 等）為主，以 BCR::ABL1 IS 定量追蹤分子反應；T315I 突變對 ponatinib、asciminib 仍可反應。
Leukocyte alkaline phosphatase score 在 CML 低，可與 leukemoid reaction（高）區分（傳統考點）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 leukemoid reaction 混淆；後者以成熟中性球為主、有毒性顆粒、myelocyte 少且無 basophilia，BCR::ABL1 陰性。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指細胞為何？本病確診的分子/細胞遺傳檢查為何？
quiz.a: Myeloblast（blast）；BCR::ABL1 — t(9;22) Philadelphia chromosome（FISH/RT-PCR/karyotype）。

65898.recognize_zh: 上排（前期 T-LGLL）骨髓細胞量正常，CD8 與 TIA1 陽性的小 T 細胞呈線狀排列在竇狀血管內，CD3/TRBC1 雙染以紫色（TRBC1 陰性）為主；下排（轉化後）骨髓被大型不規則核、明顯核仁的淋巴細胞取代，CD8 膜染、TIA1 粗顆粒陽性，雙染仍幾乎全為紫色，顯示同一 TRBC1 限制性克隆。
features: Initial biopsy: normocellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and megakaryocytes (A)
Small CD8+ and TIA1+ T cells in linear intrasinusoidal arrays (B, C)
CD3 (purple)/TRBC1 (green) dual stain: intrasinusoidal T cells purple-only (TRBC1-negative) against a mixed background (D)
Follow-up biopsy: hypercellular marrow effaced by large atypical lymphocytes with irregular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and abundant cytoplasm (E)
Large cells show membranous CD8 and coarse granular cytoplasmic TIA1 (F, G)
Dual stain in the large-cell infiltrate is predominantly purple-only, consistent with the same TRBC1-restricted clone (H)
65898.describe_en: The initial bone marrow biopsy is normocellular with an interstitial and intrasinusoidal infiltrate of small bland T cells that are CD8- and TIA1-positive, and CD3/TRBC1 dual staining shows a TRBC1-negative restricted population, consistent with T-large granular lymphocytic leukemia. The follow-up biopsy is hypercellular and extensively replaced by large atypical lymphocytes with irregular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and abundant cytoplasm. These cells retain CD8 and granular TIA1 cytotoxic phenotype and remain CD3-positive/TRBC1-negative, matching the prior clone. With CD30 expression and identical TCR and mutational profiles reported, findings are consistent with large-cell transformation of T-LGLL to peripheral T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive CD8+ T cells are polytypic with both TRBC1-positive and -negative cells, lack intrasinusoidal clustering and do not show large-cell transformation.
HSTL also has intrasinusoidal marrow involvement but is usually γδ (TRBC1-negative because TCRβ is absent), CD8-negative, TIA1+/granzyme B-negative, and composed of medium-sized monotonous cells.
ALCL has hallmark cells with uniform strong CD30 and frequent loss of T-cell markers, lacking a documented preceding T-LGLL clone.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia is surface CD3-negative, EBV-positive and lacks TCR rearrangement, whereas these cells are CD3-positive αβ T cells.

65898.stain: H&E; IHC: CD8, TIA1; CD3/TRBC1 dual stain

65834.recognize_zh: 左上方嗜中性球的一個核葉旁有一顆小而深染的圓形染色質小體，呈鼓槌狀（drumstick）突出，代表女性不活化 X 染色體的 Barr body；旁邊兩顆嗜中性球核分葉較少可作對照。
features: Neutrophil (upper left) with a small, dense, round chromatin appendage projecting from a nuclear lobe (drumstick/Barr body)
Appendage about one-quarter to one-fifth the size of a lobe and darker than adjacent chromatin
Two adjacent neutrophils with band-like or bilobed nuclei and fine granular cytoplasm for comparison
Normocytic red cells with central pallor and a few platelets in the background
65834.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three neutrophils. One neutrophil displays a small, round, densely staining chromatin body projecting from a nuclear lobe, consistent with a drumstick appendage (Barr body), while the other neutrophils show band-like or minimally segmented nuclei with normal granulation. Red cells and platelets appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a neutrophil drumstick, a normal finding reflecting the inactivated X chromosome in females (or males with more than one X chromosome).

ddx.vs: Sessile nodules attach broadly without a thin stalk, and small accessory lobes are larger and less dense than a drumstick.
A detached fragment lies free in the cytoplasm without a chromatin connection to the nucleus.
An overlying platelet shows granular purple chromomere with pale hyalomere and a different plane of focus.

65770.recognize_zh: 同一張骨髓切片裡有兩種腫瘤：大片偏心核、嗜伊紅胞質的漿細胞（箭頭），旁邊是有腺腔、核大且核仁明顯的上皮腺體（圓圈）；PSA 染腺體、CD138 呈膜狀陽性、lambda 單株限制。
features: Two distinct neoplastic populations in the marrow space: sheets of discohesive plasma cells and cohesive epithelial glands
Plasma cells: medium-sized, round eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin and moderate amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm (arrows)
Glands: enlarged overlapping nuclei with vesicular chromatin and visible nucleoli, forming a central lumen (circles)
PSA: diffuse cytoplasmic positivity in the glandular tumor cells, surrounding stroma negative
CD138: diffuse membranous staining of the sheet-like plasma cell infiltrate
Lambda: strong cytoplasmic staining in the large majority of plasma cells, indicating light-chain restriction
65770.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows marked replacement of hematopoietic tissue by two separate processes. There are sheets of atypical plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm, and admixed cohesive nests and glands of epithelial cells with enlarged nuclei, prominent nucleoli and luminal formation. By immunohistochemistry the glandular component is diffusely positive for PSA, while the plasma cells are diffusely CD138-positive and lambda light chain-restricted. Findings are consistent with concurrent involvement by metastatic prostatic adenocarcinoma and a lambda-restricted plasma cell neoplasm (plasma cell myeloma).

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are scattered or perivascular and polytypic on kappa/lambda staining, not sheet-forming and lambda-restricted as here.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with epithelioid or anaplastic morphology
ddx.vs: Myeloma cells do not form true lumina and are keratin- and PSA-negative, whereas the circled glands here are PSA-positive.
Morphology of the glands is not site-specific; PSA (and NKX3.1) positivity establishes prostatic origin.
Osteoblasts line trabecular surfaces with a hof separated from the nucleus and are PSA-negative, lacking the atypia and lumen formation of these glands.

65066.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中大量高 N:C 比的母細胞，部分核呈雙葉或不規則，並夾雜細胞質內含粗大深紫色嗜鹼性顆粒的細胞；母細胞合併異常嗜鹼性顆粒，搭配 CD9、CD25、CD117 陽性而 MPO 陰性，指向急性嗜鹼性白血病。
features: Marked leukocytosis with numerous medium-to-large blasts, high N:C ratio and fine chromatin
Many blasts with bilobed, folded or irregular nuclear contours
Scant to moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm, some cells with a few coarse dark purple-black granules
Occasional cells heavily laden with coarse basophilic granules resembling immature basophils
Several hypogranular cells with irregular/ragged cytoplasmic outlines; platelets markedly reduced
65066.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis composed predominantly of medium to large blast cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely dispersed chromatin and frequent bilobed or irregularly folded nuclei. A subset of cells contains scattered coarse, dark basophilic cytoplasmic granules, and occasional cells are densely granulated, resembling immature basophils. Platelets are markedly reduced. Together with an MPO-negative, CD117+, CD34+, CD9+, CD25+ immunophenotype and absence of other defining abnormalities, findings are consistent with acute basophilic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Accelerated/blast phase of chronic myeloid leukemia
ddx.vs: CML shows a left-shifted granulocytic spectrum with absolute basophilia and BCR::ABL1 fusion, which must be excluded before diagnosing acute basophilic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with t(6;9)(p22.3;q34.1) DEK::NUP214 or BCR::ABL1
ddx.vs: These AMLs can show basophilia but are defined by their recurrent genetic abnormality and usually contain MPO-positive blasts.
Mast cells have oval nuclei with metachromatic granules and express tryptase and CD2/CD25 with strong CD117 but lack CD123/CD203c basophil pattern and often show KIT D816V.
APL granules are azurophilic red-purple with Auer rod bundles and blasts are strongly MPO positive with PML::RARA, unlike MPO-negative basophilic blasts.

65514.recognize_zh: MPO 細胞化學染色下，左下方一顆芽細胞的淡紫色細胞質中，有幾條細長針狀、染成紅棕色的桿狀物，就是 Auer rod；右下另有一顆整個細胞質呈棕色顆粒陽性的細胞。Auer rod 呈 MPO 陽性，證明芽細胞屬骨髓系，支持 AML。
features: Population of large blasts with high N:C ratio and pale lightly counterstained nuclei
One blast containing several thin, needle-shaped cytoplasmic Auer rods staining red-brown with MPO
Adjacent cell with diffuse coarse brown granular MPO positivity
Many surrounding blasts show weak to negligible MPO reaction (heterogeneous positivity)
Red cells in the background are unstained
65514.describe_en: Peripheral blood or marrow smear stained cytochemically for myeloperoxidase with a light counterstain shows numerous large blasts. One blast contains several slender, needle-like cytoplasmic inclusions that are MPO positive, representing Auer rods, and a neighboring cell shows strong diffuse granular MPO positivity; many other blasts are weakly reactive or negative. MPO-positive Auer rods establish myeloid lineage. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are MPO negative (<3%) and never contain Auer rods.
APL shows intensely MPO-positive hypergranular cells with bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells) in most abnormal promyelocytes, not scattered single rods in otherwise weakly reactive blasts.
Monoblasts are usually MPO negative or weak and NSE positive, and Auer rods are rare.
Precipitate lies on top of or outside cells in multiple planes, whereas Auer rods are intracytoplasmic, uniform in shape and MPO reactive.

exam.answer_en: AML — MPO cytochemistry showing MPO-positive needle-like Auer rods in a blast, confirming myeloid lineage
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著棕紅色針狀物問是什麼、此染色結果代表什麼；答 MPO-positive Auer rods，證明骨髓系。
判讀：傳統上 ≥3% blasts MPO 陽性即判為骨髓系；lymphoblasts 為 MPO 陰性。
Flow cytometry 的 cytoplasmic MPO 同樣為界定 myeloid lineage 的關鍵標記（如 MPAL 判定）。
MPO 陰性不排除 AML：monocytic、megakaryoblastic、minimally differentiated AML 可為陰性，需 NSE 與 flow。
Sudan black B 染色結果與 MPO 大致平行，Auer rods 亦陽性。
exam.pitfall_zh: 片中成熟嗜中性球或單核球本來就 MPO 陽性，不可把陽性正常細胞算入 blast 陽性率；需確認陽性細胞確為 blast 形態。

quiz.q: 圖中 blast 內染成紅棕色的針狀構造為何？這個染色結果如何區分 AML 與 ALL？
quiz.a: MPO-positive Auer rods；MPO 陽性（≥3% blasts）支持 AML，lymphoblasts 為 MPO 陰性。

65450.recognize_zh: 血片中可見血紅素擠到一側、另一側留下透明膜泡的泡泡細胞（blister cell，星號），以及邊緣像被咬一口的咬痕細胞（bite cell，箭頭），是氧化性溶血的線索。
features: Blister cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side and a clear membrane-bound vesicle (asterisks)
Bite cells with smooth semicircular peripheral defects (arrows)
Irregularly contracted, dense red cells and crenated forms
Background of normocytic red cells with occasional larger polychromatic-appearing cells
Platelets present and not clumped; no schistocytes in the field
65450.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mixed red cell population with numerous blister cells, in which hemoglobin is pushed to one side leaving a clear membranous vesicle, and bite cells with smooth peripheral indentations. Irregularly contracted dense cells and occasional crenated forms are also present, while true helmet-cell schistocytes are not prominent. Platelets appear adequate. Findings are consistent with oxidative hemolysis; in the context of recent phenazopyridine exposure and later normal G6PD activity, drug-induced oxidative hemolysis is favored.

ddx.vs: Morphology (bite/blister cells, Heinz bodies) is identical, so G6PD deficiency is excluded by enzyme assay performed after recovery, as it was normal here.
MAHA shows angular schistocytes and helmet cells with thrombocytopenia rather than blister cells with intact hemoglobin-filled halves and adequate platelets.
AIHA shows round spherocytes and a positive direct antiglobulin test, while this case has a negative DAT and oxidative forms.
Unstable hemoglobins also produce bite cells and Heinz bodies but are chronic and congenital, identified by hemoglobin stability testing or globin sequencing.

exam.answer_en: Drug-induced oxidative hemolysis (phenazopyridine) — blister cells and bite cells
pearls_zh: 考法：星號與箭頭分別問 blister cell 與 bite cell，下一題問確認檢查：supravital stain（crystal violet 或 new methylene blue）找 Heinz bodies。
急性溶血期 G6PD 活性可因網狀紅血球增多而假性正常，應於恢復後約 3 個月複驗，或做基因檢測。
Phenazopyridine、dapsone、primaquine、nitrofurantoin 等氧化藥物在大劑量時即使 G6PD 正常也可致溶血；phenazopyridine 亦可致 methemoglobinemia。
G6PD 缺乏者禁用 rasburicase 與 methylene blue；使用前應先確認 G6PD 狀態。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 blister cell 誤看成 schistocyte／helmet cell 而想到 MAHA；blister cell 一側仍有膜泡、血小板正常，可區分。

quiz.q: 星號標示的細胞叫什麼？確認氧化性紅血球損傷的下一步染色？
quiz.a: Blister cell；supravital stain 找 Heinz bodies

65322.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD123 免疫染色中，脂肪空泡間大多數腫瘤細胞呈顆粒狀的細胞質與膜棕色染色，強度中等且廣泛分布，顯示 CD123 陽性細胞瀰漫浸潤，支持 BPDCN 的骨髓侵犯。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of medium-sized cells between fat spaces
Moderate, granular cytoplasmic and membranous CD123 staining in the majority of cells
Staining intensity is weaker and more granular than the companion CD4 stain
Occasional CD123-negative cells with blue nuclei
Uneven section thickness with loosened cellularity toward the top
65322.describe_en: CD123 immunohistochemical stain of the bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a diffuse infiltrate of medium-sized cells, the majority of which display moderate granular cytoplasmic and membranous CD123 positivity. Occasional negative background cells are present. CD123 is not specific in isolation, as it is expressed in some AML and in reactive plasmacytoid dendritic cells, so interpretation requires the CD4, CD56, TCF4 and TCL1 profile. Findings support involvement by blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: CD123-positive AML blasts express myeloid markers such as MPO, CD13, CD33 or CD117 and lack the CD4+CD56+TCF4+TCL1+ pDC profile.
Reactive pDCs form small clusters of CD123+ cells rather than diffuse sheets replacing marrow.
Hairy cells are CD123-positive but are B cells expressing CD20, CD11c, CD103 and annexin A1.

65258.recognize_zh: 分葉核嗜中性球的細胞質內可見少數小而折光的藍綠色包涵體（位於核左緣與左下方），與周圍粉紅色顆粒明顯不同；這種「critical green inclusions」與肝衰竭、乳酸中毒等危重狀況相關。圖片經放大而解析度有限。
features: Mature neutrophil with a four-lobed nucleus and coarse chromatin
Small, discrete blue-green refractile cytoplasmic inclusions at the left nuclear margin and lower-left cytoplasm
Background cytoplasm with fine pink granules and a small clear vacuole between lobes
Adjacent large red cells including a knizocyte/stomatocyte-like form
Two small platelets; image is upscaled with limited resolution
65258.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature segmented neutrophil containing a few small, sharply demarcated blue-green refractile cytoplasmic inclusions distinct from the fine pink granules, together with a small cytoplasmic vacuole. Nearby red cells are enlarged, and occasional platelets are present. The image is enlarged and of limited resolution, so inclusion color must be interpreted with caution. The findings are consistent with green neutrophil inclusions ('critical green inclusions'), which are associated with acute liver injury, lactic acidosis and high short-term mortality and should prompt clinical notification.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale grey-blue, poorly defined, peripherally located patches of rough ER rather than sharply demarcated, refractile emerald-green inclusions.
Organisms have defined shapes (cocci, rods, budding yeasts) with basophilic staining and are not refractile green.

ddx.dx: Phagocytosed hemosiderin, bilirubin crystals or malarial pigment
ddx.vs: Hemozoin is brown-black and crystalline, while green inclusions are blue-green lipofuscin-like material linked to liver failure.
These are large pink-purple or grey granules, not small refractile green inclusions.

65194.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片的紅血球之間，可見游離於細胞外、細長且規則螺旋狀彎曲的藍紫色絲狀微生物（spirochetes），長度約為紅血球直徑的 1.5–3 倍，符合 Borrelia 回歸熱。
features: Extracellular, thin, tightly and regularly coiled spiral filaments lying free between red cells
Organisms are approximately 1.5-3 red cell diameters in length and stain blue-purple
No intraerythrocytic parasites (no ring forms, no Maltese cross, no gametocytes)
Red cells normochromic and normocytic with numerous crenated cells (echinocytes), likely artifact
Occasional small platelets; no leukocytes in this field
65194.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several extracellular, slender, regularly coiled spirochetes lying between red cells, each measuring about two to three red cell diameters in length. No intraerythrocytic inclusions are seen to suggest malaria or babesiosis. Red cells are normochromic with prominent crenation (echinocytes), and platelets appear reduced in this field. Findings are consistent with spirochetemia due to Borrelia species, compatible with tick-borne relapsing fever.

ddx.vs: These parasites are intraerythrocytic ring forms or tetrads, whereas Borrelia are extracellular long spiral filaments between red cells.
Trypanosomes are larger, flattened extracellular flagellates with an undulating membrane, a central nucleus and a kinetoplast, unlike the thin uniform coils of Borrelia.
Fibrin strands are straight or randomly branching and nonhelical, whereas spirochetes have regular, evenly spaced tight coils of consistent width.
Lyme borreliosis has too few organisms to be seen on blood smears, so visible spirochetemia favors relapsing fever Borrelia; species confirmation requires serology or PCR.

exam.answer_en: Tick-borne relapsing fever — extracellular Borrelia spirochetes lying between red cells on peripheral blood smear
pearls_zh: 考法：指紅血球之間的螺旋絲狀物問病原；答 Borrelia spirochete，並強調其位於紅血球外，對比 malaria 與 Babesia 位於紅血球內。
分型：soft tick（Ornithodoros）傳播 tick-borne relapsing fever（如美國西部 B. hermsii）；louse-borne 為 B. recurrentis。發燒期採血檢出率最高。
Lyme disease（B. burgdorferi）血中菌量低，抹片幾乎看不到；抹片可見螺旋體強烈支持 relapsing fever Borrelia。
治療（如 doxycycline 或 penicillin/ceftriaxone）後數小時內可發生 Jarisch-Herxheimer reaction：寒顫、高燒、低血壓，需密切監測。
exam.pitfall_zh: 常被忽略成 fibrin 絲或染料沉澱；Borrelia 粗細一致、螺旋規則緊密，fibrin 絲則直或隨機分支；發燒期多看幾個視野或加做 thick film。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球之間的螺旋狀微生物為何？抗生素治療後需警覺何種反應？
quiz.a: Borrelia（relapsing fever）；Jarisch-Herxheimer reaction。

64938.recognize_zh: 這是血液分析儀的列印報告，不是 EDTA 採血管照片：37°C 保溫後重新上機，WBC 5.1、HGB 10.1、PLT 126 等數值與直方圖都能正常產出，代表冷凝球蛋白造成的凝集與計數干擾已被溫熱排除。
features: Automated hematology analyzer printout (CBC with differential, histograms and WBC scattergram)
WBC 5.1 x10^3/uL with relative lymphocytosis (LY 50.8%) and low neutrophils (NE 2.0 x10^3/uL)
RBC 3.59 x10^6/uL, HGB 10.1 g/dL, HCT 30.6%, MCV 85.3 fL, MCHC 32.9 g/dL (normal, not spuriously elevated), RDW 16.5% high
PLT 126 x10^3/uL with MPV 11.6 fL; platelet histogram shows a single smooth curve without a large-particle tail
WBC and RBC histograms show well-separated populations without obvious interference peaks
64938.describe_en: The figure is an automated hematology analyzer printout obtained after incubating the specimen at 37 degrees Celsius. It reports WBC 5.1 x10^3/uL with relative lymphocytosis, normocytic anemia (hemoglobin 10.1 g/dL, MCV 85.3 fL) with a normal MCHC and elevated RDW, and mild thrombocytopenia (126 x10^3/uL). The histograms and scattergram are well formed without obvious interference signals. The internally consistent indices after warming indicate that cold-precipitating protein (cryoglobulin) interference has been reversed, and these values should be reported in preference to the unwarmed results; this is a non-morphologic laboratory figure and does not by itself establish the underlying lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Cold agglutinins cause spuriously low RBC with high MCV and MCHC that correct on warming and show red cell agglutinates on smear, whereas cryoglobulins also produce pale blue extracellular deposits and spurious WBC/platelet counts.
Platelet clumping is corrected by citrate collection rather than warming and shows platelet aggregates on the smear.
Genuine cytopenias persist after warming and on a prewarmed smear, unlike artifactual changes.

65130.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD138 免疫染色，大量空泡化細胞的細胞膜與細胞質呈棕色陽性、成片分布，證明這些看似組織球的透明細胞其實是漿細胞。
features: Sheets of CD138-positive cells with membranous/cytoplasmic brown staining
Positive cells have clear, vacuolated cytoplasm producing a bubbly, histiocyte-like pattern
Diffuse interstitial to sheet-like distribution across most of the field
Intervening CD138-negative hematopoietic cells counterstained blue
65130.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy immunostained for CD138 shows a diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of cells with membranous and cytoplasmic positivity. The positive cells have abundant clear to vacuolated cytoplasm, imparting a foamy, histiocyte-like appearance at low power, while the intervening hematopoietic elements are negative. The extent of CD138 positivity indicates marked plasma cell infiltration. Findings support a plasma cell neoplasm with vacuolated (pseudo-histiocytic) plasma cells; light-chain IHC or ISH would confirm clonality.

ddx.vs: Histiocytes are CD68/CD163-positive and CD138-negative, whereas these vacuolated cells are diffusely CD138-positive.

ddx.dx: Metastatic signet-ring or clear cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma can express CD138 but is cytokeratin-positive and cohesive, so a keratin stain and light-chain restriction separate it from myeloma.
Reactive plasma cells are scattered, perivascular and polytypic, not diffuse CD138-positive sheets.

64746.recognize_zh: 中央一個大型巨噬細胞，細胞質內可見被吞入的完整紅血球輪廓、多顆洋紅色小顆粒（被吞噬的血小板）與少量深色顆粒，本身核被推擠，這就是吞噬血球現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale blue, vacuolated cytoplasm and irregular cell border
Several intact ingested erythrocytes within cytoplasmic vacuoles
Numerous small magenta/purple granular bodies consistent with phagocytosed platelets, plus a few dark blue-black granules (possible hemosiderin/debris)
Macrophage nucleus/nuclei with open chromatin, partly obscured by ingested material
Background of maturing myeloid cells (promyelocyte/myelocyte, band and segmented neutrophils), lymphocytes and erythrocytes
64746.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing several intact phagocytosed erythrocytes and numerous small magenta granular bodies consistent with ingested platelets, together with a few dark pigment granules. The surrounding marrow shows maturing granulocytic precursors, neutrophils and lymphocytes without increased blasts in this field. The findings represent hemophagocytosis; since hemophagocytic histiocytes are nonspecific, correlation with HLH-2004 clinical and laboratory criteria (fever, cytopenias, ferritin, triglycerides, fibrinogen, soluble CD25) is required.

ddx.dx: Macrophage with ingested pigment or debris (e.g., after transfusion or iron overload)
ddx.vs: Iron-laden macrophages contain coarse blue-black hemosiderin confirmed by Prussian blue rather than intact erythrocytes and platelets.
Tingible body macrophages contain dense pyknotic nuclear fragments rather than intact red cells and platelets.
Organisms are uniform small oval bodies with a halo or kinetoplast, whereas platelet granules are irregular magenta granular clumps without internal structure.
Neoplastic histiocytes are cytologically atypical with nucleoli and form sheets, while this is a single bland macrophage in a normal-appearing marrow background.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis — marrow macrophage containing phagocytosed intact erythrocytes and platelets
pearls_zh: 考法：指著巨噬細胞內的完整紅血球輪廓與洋紅色小體，問「吞了什麼、代表什麼」；答紅血球與血小板被吞噬（hemophagocytosis）。
骨髓看到吞噬血球現象既不敏感也不專一（輸血、感染、敗血症後都可見），不能單憑此診斷 HLH。
HLH-2004 診斷條件（符合 5/8 或分子診斷）：發燒、脾腫大、兩系以上血球減少、高 triglyceride 或低 fibrinogen、組織吞噬血球、NK 活性低/無、ferritin ≥500 ng/mL、sCD25 升高。
成人 HLH 需找誘因：EBV 等感染、淋巴瘤（特別是 T/NK 細胞淋巴瘤）、自體免疫疾病（macrophage activation syndrome）；HScore 可估計機率。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易將被吞入的血小板誤認為細胞內病原體（Histoplasma、Leishmania）：血小板為不規則洋紅色顆粒團、無內部結構；Histoplasma 有透明暈，Leishmania 有核與 kinetoplast。

quiz.q: 圖中巨噬細胞吞入的是哪些血球成分？骨髓看到此現象是否足以診斷 HLH？
quiz.a: 紅血球與血小板；不足，需符合 HLH-2004 條件（或分子診斷）。

64618.recognize_zh: GMS 銀染下，綠色背景的骨髓組織中布滿大量黑色、細長分枝的菌絲，在脂肪空泡之間形成密集網狀，顯示骨髓被侵襲性黴菌廣泛浸潤。
features: Innumerable black-staining, slender filamentous fungal hyphae throughout marrow stroma
Hyphae form dense interlacing meshworks, particularly at the lower left, with branching forms
Hyphae are relatively narrow and uniform in width at this magnification; septation cannot be reliably assessed
Light green counterstain of hematopoietic/stromal tissue with interspersed fat spaces and a bony trabecula (upper left)
Distribution is diffuse rather than confined to vessels or granulomas
64618.describe_en: Grocott methenamine silver stain of the bone marrow core biopsy highlights innumerable black, slender, filamentous and branching fungal hyphae diffusely permeating the marrow stroma between fat spaces, forming dense interlacing meshworks. Hyphal width appears relatively narrow and uniform, but septation and branching angle cannot be precisely characterized at this magnification. Findings indicate extensive invasive fungal (mould) infection of the bone marrow; culture or molecular identification is required for speciation.

ddx.vs: Mucorales hyphae are broad, ribbon-like, pauciseptate with right-angle branching and often stain weakly with GMS, whereas these are narrow, uniform and strongly argyrophilic, favoring a septate mould.
Candida shows budding yeast forms mixed with constricted pseudohyphae, which are not evident among these uniform filaments.
Reticulin fibers are thin, continuous linear fibers along the stromal framework on reticulin stain, whereas GMS here shows discrete short thick tubular hyphal segments with branching.
Filamentous bacteria are much thinner (<1 µm), beaded and gram-positive, well below the diameter of true fungal hyphae.

64490.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞極度增生，滿是細胞質粉紅、帶顆粒的嗜酸性球；CD117 與 CD25 標出散在或鬆散聚集的紡錘形肥大細胞，網狀纖維染色顯示明顯纖維化，符合伴嗜酸性球增多與 FIP1L1::PDGFRA 重排的骨髓/淋巴腫瘤。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow (A) replaced by sheets of eosinophils and eosinophil precursors with bright eosinophilic granular cytoplasm
CD117 (B) highlights numerous spindle-shaped mast cells, singly and in loose interstitial clusters with occasional small dense aggregates
CD25 (C) is expressed by the same spindle mast cells, indicating an aberrant immunophenotype
Reticulin stain (D) shows diffuse dense coarse fiber network with intersections, consistent with marked fibrosis (MF-3)
No sheets of blasts identifiable at this magnification
64490.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is markedly hypercellular, with the intertrabecular space filled by eosinophils and their precursors. CD117 and CD25 immunostains highlight increased spindle-shaped mast cells distributed singly and in loose interstitial clusters, with rare dense aggregates, and the mast cells show aberrant CD25 expression. Reticulin staining demonstrates marked diffuse fibrosis. In a patient with persistent hypereosinophilia, negative KIT D816V, and an FIP1L1::PDGFRA fusion detected by NGS, findings are consistent with myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and FIP1L1::PDGFRA rearrangement, presenting with CEL-like features.

ddx.dx: Systemic mastocytosis with associated hematologic neoplasm
ddx.vs: SM shows compact dense mast cell aggregates of 15 or more cells and usually KIT D816V, whereas here mast cells are mostly loose/interstitial with PDGFRA fusion and KIT D816V negative.
CEL is defined only after excluding PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1, JAK2 and FLT3 rearrangements; detection of FIP1L1::PDGFRA reclassifies the case.
Reactive eosinophilia lacks atypical CD25+ spindle mast cells, marked fibrosis, and a clonal fusion gene.
PMF shows clustered atypical megakaryocytes with JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations rather than eosinophil-predominant hypercellularity with mast cell proliferation.

64426.recognize_zh: 大量紅血球表面有數目不一、長短粗細不規則的尖刺突起（棘狀紅血球，acanthocyte），間雜數顆小而深染、無中央淡染區的小球形紅血球；在使用 ALK 抑制劑 alectinib 的病人，棘狀紅血球顯著增加是其溶血的特徵。
features: Numerous acanthocytes with few, irregularly spaced, coarse thorny projections of variable length
Scattered dense microspherocytes lacking central pallor
Marked anisocytosis with occasional irregular or fragmented red cell forms
Some cells show more regular crenation resembling echinocytes
Scattered normal-appearing platelets; no agglutination, schistocyte predominance or inclusions evident
64426.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisocytosis with numerous acanthocytes bearing irregular, coarse, thorn-like projections of varying size and spacing. Scattered microspherocytes and occasional irregular fragments are also present, while red cell agglutination is not seen. Platelets appear adequate. In a patient receiving alectinib with Coombs-negative hemolysis, findings are consistent with alectinib-associated acanthocytic hemolytic anemia.

ddx.dx: Echinocytes (burr cells, drying artifact or uremia)
ddx.vs: Echinocytes have 10-30 short, evenly spaced, regular projections around the whole circumference, whereas acanthocytes have fewer irregular spicules of unequal length.

ddx.dx: Spur cell anemia of advanced liver disease
ddx.vs: Spur cell anemia shows identical acanthocytes but occurs with severe liver dysfunction; the drug history and normal liver tests separate them.
These inherited conditions show lifelong acanthocytosis with neurologic disease or fat malabsorption rather than acquired onset after starting a drug.
MAHA shows predominant schistocytes (helmet cells, triangles) with thrombocytopenia, whereas fragments are few and platelets adequate here.

64106.recognize_zh: 右側一顆分葉嗜中性球胞質內有多個大小不一的白色透明空泡狀吞噬體，並夾雜粉紅色顆粒，左下角為一顆正常小淋巴球作對照；在冷凝球蛋白血症中，這些比一般毒性空泡更大的白色吞噬體代表吞噬的冷凝球蛋白。
features: Segmented neutrophil with multiple clear, variably sized cytoplasmic vacuoles/phagosomes
Some phagosomes larger than typical toxic vacuoles
Scattered pink-violet cytoplasmic granules
Small mature lymphocyte at the lower left for size comparison
Red cells with central pallor; image is somewhat blurred, limiting fine detail
64106.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil with multiple clear cytoplasmic vacuoles of variable size, some larger than ordinary toxic vacuoles, together with scattered pink-violet granules. A small mature lymphocyte is present nearby, and the red cells are unremarkable. The image is slightly out of focus, so the contents of the vacuoles cannot be characterized. In the context of cryoglobulinemic vasculitis, the findings are consistent with neutrophil phagocytosis of cryoglobulin.

ddx.vs: Sepsis produces small uniform vacuoles with coarse toxic granules and Döhle bodies, while phagocytosed cryoglobulin forms larger, irregular phagosomes.
Artifactual vacuoles are small, appear in delayed samples, and affect many cells uniformly without large phagosomes.
Bacteria or yeasts are visible as basophilic structures within vacuoles, which are not seen here.

64042.recognize_zh: 低中倍率骨髓抹片中可見多顆巨核細胞，右上與左側兩顆體積中等、胞質豐富卻只有單一圓形不分葉的核（monolobated megakaryocyte），下方另一顆小型單核巨核細胞，符合 MDS del(5q) 的巨核細胞型態。
features: Several megakaryocytes in a low-to-medium power field, readily identified against a cellular aspirate
Megakaryocytes medium-sized with abundant granular pink-purple cytoplasm and a single round to oval non-lobated nucleus
Smaller megakaryocytic forms with a single eccentric nucleus and basophilic cytoplasm
Numerous small mature-appearing hematopoietic cells in the background
Thick grey streaks of smeared particle/fibrin material limit assessment of some areas
64042.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Romanowsky stain, medium power) shows a cellular specimen with several megakaryocytes readily seen in a single field. The megakaryocytes are medium-sized with abundant granular cytoplasm but single round to oval, non-lobated nuclei, and smaller hypolobated forms are also present. Background hematopoietic cells are numerous, and thick smeared particle material obscures parts of the field. The predominance of monolobated megakaryocytes is characteristic of myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q), requiring cytogenetic confirmation.

ddx.dx: Micromegakaryocytes of other MDS or AML-MR
ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes are very small (lymphocyte-to-promyelocyte size) with separated or single nuclei, whereas del(5q) megakaryocytes are normal-to-medium size with a single round nucleus.
ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with deeply hyperlobulated nuclei.

Osteoblasts have an eccentric nucleus with a perinuclear pale zone (hof) away from the nucleus and basophilic cytoplasm, and plasma cells are much smaller, while megakaryocytes have abundant granular cytoplasm and platelet budding.
Reactive megakaryocytes are increased but show normal multilobated nuclei.

exam.answer_en: Myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q) — numerous monolobated megakaryocytes with abundant cytoplasm on aspirate
pearls_zh: 考法：一個視野內指著數顆巨核細胞，問「核有什麼異常」；關鍵字是 non-lobated/monolobated，且胞質量正常甚至豐富（不是 micromegakaryocyte）。
5q- 症候群典型實驗室組合：巨球性貧血（MCV 上升）、血小板正常或增加、骨髓芽細胞 <5%；看到單葉巨核細胞應主動要求 karyotype/FISH。
治療連結：lower-risk 且輸血依賴者 lenalidomide 可達輸血獨立與細胞遺傳學緩解；用藥初期常見中性球與血小板下降，需監測血球。
預後相關：伴 TP53 突變者對 lenalidomide 反應較差、進展為 AML 風險較高，診斷時建議做 TP53 突變檢測。
exam.pitfall_zh: 單葉巨核細胞易與其他 MDS/AML-MR 的 micromegakaryocyte 混淆；後者體積小如淋巴球、胞質少，del(5q) 的巨核細胞為中等大小、胞質豐富但核不分葉。

quiz.q: 圖中巨核細胞的主要異常為何？此型 MDS 對哪一種藥物特別有效？
quiz.a: 單葉不分葉核（monolobated megakaryocytes）；lenalidomide

63914.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑、脂肪與出血，造血區由密集的單核細胞間質性浸潤取代，巨核細胞不明顯；但這個倍率下看不出腫瘤細胞特徵，無法單靠此圖認出 BPDCN，需搭配高倍與免疫染色。
features: Bone marrow core with a thin bony trabecula and preserved fat spaces
Cellularity moderately increased for age in the hematopoietic areas (estimated about 50–60%)
Dense interstitial and sheet-like mononuclear cell infiltrate between adipocytes
Megakaryocytes not readily identified at this magnification
Focal interstitial hemorrhage
63914.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows bony trabeculae with intervening marrow that contains preserved fat and focal hemorrhage. The hematopoietic areas are occupied by a dense interstitial to sheet-like infiltrate of mononuclear cells, with megakaryocytes not readily appreciated. Cytologic detail is insufficient at this magnification to characterize the infiltrate, and the pattern is not specific. Findings are compatible with marrow involvement by a blastic neoplasm; correlation with high-power morphology and immunohistochemistry (CD4, CD56, CD123, TCL1) is required to support blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Low-power architecture is indistinguishable; MPO/CD34/CD117 positivity and TCL1/CD123 profile on IHC separate AML from BPDCN.
Also produces a diffuse interstitial infiltrate; TdT and B/T lineage markers are required.
Normal marrow shows a mix of erythroid islands, maturing granulocytes and scattered megakaryocytes rather than a monotonous mononuclear infiltrate, which needs higher power to confirm.

63850.recognize_zh: 視野中散布多個兩端尖細的鐮刀狀紅血球（sickle cells），合併標靶細胞、船形細胞、小球形與大小不一的紅血球；在 HbS 與 HbD 雙重異合子（HbSD）的家族背景下，這種有鐮刀化的嚴重異形紅血球即為臨床上類似鐮刀型貧血的表現。
features: Numerous sickled (drepanocytic) red cells with pointed ends, some crescent or boomerang-shaped
Boat-shaped/oat cells and elongated irreversibly sickled forms
Target cells and scattered dense, hyperchromic microspherocyte-like cells
Marked anisocytosis with microcytes and larger oval macrocytes
Occasional red cell fragments; scattered platelets in background; no nucleated cells in this field
63850.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis. There are numerous sickled red cells, including crescentic and boat-shaped forms, together with target cells, dense microspherocytic cells, ovalocytes and larger macrocytic red cells. Platelets are present in the background and no nucleated red cells or leukocytes are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a sickling hemoglobinopathy; in this family study, the appearance fits compound heterozygous HbS/HbD-Punjab disease, which behaves clinically like sickle cell anemia.

ddx.vs: HbSS has an identical smear, so the distinction requires HPLC showing a single S-window peak without the additional D-window peak seen in HbSD.
HbSC shows fewer sickle cells but more target cells and angular HbC crystal-containing 'billiard ball' or 'Washington monument' cells, with HbC migrating in the C/E/A2 region.
S/beta-thal shows more pronounced microcytosis and hypochromia with elevated HbA2 and variable HbA on HPLC rather than a D-window variant.
Elliptocytes are blunt-ended ovals of uniform shape without pointed tips, and drying artifacts are oriented in one direction across the field.

exam.answer_en: Sickling disorder (compound HbS/HbD-Punjab) — numerous sickle cells with target cells on PB smear
pearls_zh: 考官會指兩端尖細的 irreversibly sickled cell 問名稱；血片無法區分 HbSS、HbSD 與 HbS/β0-thal，須以 HPLC 或電泳分型。
HbD-Punjab 在 CE-HPLC 於 D-window 沖提，但鹼性電泳與 HbS 同位置；酸性（citrate agar）電泳可分開 HbS 與 HbD。
HbS/HbD-Punjab 為會鐮刀化的複合異合子，臨床類似 sickle cell anemia：慢性溶血與血管阻塞危象。
HbD trait 單獨存在不會鐮刀化；HbSC 則以標靶細胞與 HbC 結晶為主、典型鐮刀細胞較少。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為橢圓紅血球（elliptocyte）：elliptocyte 兩端鈍圓、色素均勻，sickle cell 兩端尖細且血紅素緻密。

quiz.q: 圖中兩端尖細的紅血球叫什麼？只看血片能否區分 HbSS 與 HbSD？
quiz.a: Sickle cell（drepanocyte）；不能，需 HPLC/電泳（HbSD 另有 D-window 峰）

63786.recognize_zh: 中央大型細胞含約八個彼此分開、形狀與大小一致的圓形核，細胞質豐富且帶細顆粒，這是蝕骨細胞（osteoclast）；旁邊有一個細胞質深藍、核偏心的漿細胞。
features: Very large multinucleated cell with about eight separate, uniform round-to-oval nuclei
Nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, not overlapping or lobulated
Abundant blue-purple cytoplasm with fine granules and irregular frayed borders
Nearby plasma cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nucleus; scattered neutrophils
Background of smeared, grayish red cells suggesting protein-rich aspirate
63786.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a very large multinucleated cell containing approximately eight discrete, uniform round nuclei with fine chromatin, set in abundant finely granular basophilic cytoplasm with irregular borders, consistent with an osteoclast. An adjacent cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and an eccentric nucleus is consistent with a plasma cell, and scattered mature neutrophils are present. The red cells in the background appear smeared and dark gray. Osteoclasts may be conspicuous in marrow aspirates from patients with active bone resorption, as in plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single multilobulated, interconnected nucleus rather than multiple separate uniform nuclei.
Neoplastic multinucleated plasma cells have fewer nuclei, deep blue cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof, and lack the granular pale cytoplasm of osteoclasts.
Osteoblasts are separate cells each with its own cell membrane and a pale Golgi zone away from the nucleus, rather than one syncytial cell.
Tumor clusters show nuclear pleomorphism, overlapping and molding with cell borders between cells, unlike the uniform nuclei in a single cytoplasm here.

exam.answer_en: Osteoclast in bone marrow aspirate — multinucleated cell with multiple separate uniform nuclei, beside a plasma cell
pearls_zh: 考法：指多核大細胞問 osteoclast 還是 megakaryocyte；關鍵是核是否彼此分開、大小一致。
Osteoclast 源自單核球/巨噬細胞系，由 RANKL 活化；myeloma 細胞增加 RANKL 並經 DKK1 抑制 osteoblast，造成溶骨病變。
Myeloma 骨病治療用 bisphosphonate（如 zoledronic acid）或 denosumab（anti-RANKL），需注意顎骨壞死。
Osteoclast 也見於兒童骨髓、副甲狀腺機能亢進與骨轉移，本身不代表腫瘤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 megakaryocyte：megakaryocyte 是單一相連的分葉核，osteoclast 為多個分開、大小一致的圓核。

quiz.q: 中央多核大細胞是什麼？旁邊胞質深藍、核偏心的細胞是什麼？
quiz.a: Osteoclast；plasma cell

63530.recognize_zh: 低倍下紅血球不是一條條疊成錢串狀，而是聚成大小不一、形狀不規則的團塊，散布整個抹片，這種不規則聚集就是紅血球凝集（agglutination），配合臨床即為冷凝集素病的典型抹片表現。
features: Diffuse irregular, three-dimensional clumps of red cells of varying size throughout the smear
Clumps have irregular, grape-like outlines rather than linear stacked (coin-like) chains
Free single red cells interspersed between aggregates
Scattered leukocytes and platelets without obvious abnormality at this low magnification
Low magnification limits evaluation of individual red cell morphology (e.g., spherocytes, polychromasia)
63530.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows extensive red cell agglutination, with red cells forming numerous irregular, variably sized three-dimensional clumps distributed throughout the smear, interspersed with single free red cells. The aggregates lack the linear, stacked-coin arrangement of rouleaux. Leukocytes and platelets are present without evident abnormality, although individual red cell morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with red cell agglutination due to cold agglutinins, as in primary cold agglutinin disease; correlation with a direct antiglobulin test (C3d positive) and cold agglutinin titer is recommended, and a smear prepared from a prewarmed sample should disperse the clumps.

ddx.dx: Rouleaux formation (e.g., plasma cell myeloma, inflammation)
ddx.vs: Rouleaux form linear stacks of red cells resembling coins with a blue proteinaceous background, whereas agglutinates are irregular clumps that do not disperse with saline but do with warming.
Warm AIHA typically shows spherocytes and polychromasia with IgG-positive DAT and little agglutination, whereas cold agglutinins cause prominent agglutination that disappears at 37 C.
In thick areas red cells overlap diffusely without discrete clumps separated by clear spaces, and the monolayer area of the slide appears normal.

exam.answer_en: Cold agglutinin disease — irregular three-dimensional red cell agglutinates (not rouleaux) throughout the smear
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍見紅血球成團，問凝集還是錢串（rouleaux）；再問確認方法：檢體 37°C 預溫後重做抹片，凝集應散開。
DAT：C3d 陽性、IgG 通常陰性；cold agglutinin 多為 IgM κ，主要針對紅血球 I 抗原。
原發性 CAD 屬低度克隆性 B 細胞增生，骨髓可見 LPL 樣浸潤，但 MYD88 L265P 通常陰性。
自動血球計數會受干擾：RBC 假性降低、MCV 與 MCHC 假性升高；預溫檢體後重測可校正。
治療：保暖避寒；rituximab 為基礎，sutimlimab（C1s 抑制劑）可阻斷補體溶血；類固醇效果差。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 rouleaux；錢串為線狀疊幣排列、見於高球蛋白血症，加生理食鹽水可分散，凝集為不規則立體團塊，需預溫才會散開。

quiz.q: 這種紅血球排列稱為什麼？DAT 典型結果為何？
quiz.a: Red cell agglutination；C3d 陽性（IgG 陰性）

63466.recognize_zh: 周邊血片中央一顆比紅血球大約兩倍的深紫色細胞核，呈分葉或腎形、染色質濃密，周圍幾乎沒有細胞質，符合游離的巨核細胞裸核（bare megakaryocyte nucleus）；周圍紅血球大致正常，部分有中央淡染區。
features: Isolated nucleus about two times the diameter of a red cell
Lobulated/indented nuclear contour with dense, deeply basophilic chromatin
Minimal to absent surrounding cytoplasm
No nucleoli or blast features
Background red cells with central pallor and a partially seen leukocyte at the lower edge
63466.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single naked nucleus approximately twice the size of a red cell, with a lobulated contour, dense deeply basophilic chromatin, and virtually no surrounding cytoplasm. No nucleoli are identified. The background red cells show no marked abnormality in this field. Findings are consistent with a bare megakaryocyte nucleus; rare forms can be seen in healthy individuals, but increased numbers should prompt review for myeloid neoplasm, particularly myelofibrosis, or a leukoerythroblastic picture.

ddx.vs: Smudge cells are flattened, pale, disrupted lymphocyte nuclei with a smeared, streaky chromatin pattern rather than a compact, dense lobulated nucleus.
Micromegakaryocytes retain a rim of granular cytoplasm, often with platelet budding, and are associated with MDS/CML.
Lymphoma cells and blasts retain a rim of basophilic cytoplasm and show cleaved nuclei or fine chromatin with nucleoli.
Nucleated red cells have a smaller round pyknotic nucleus with a surrounding hemoglobinized cytoplasm.

63402.recognize_zh: 油鏡下可見數顆有核紅血球（NRBC），其中一顆的核旁有小片脫出的核碎片（nuclear budding），加上多形紅血球與大量血小板；這些是溶血伴有核紅血球的非特異表現，G6PD 缺乏需靠酵素檢驗與 Heinz body 染色確認。
features: Several orthochromatic normoblasts with small, dense, pyknotic nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm
One nucleated red cell with a small detached nuclear bud/fragment adjacent to the main nucleus
Anisopoikilocytosis with oval and teardrop-like forms and cells with irregular hemoglobin distribution
Bite cells or blister cells are not convincingly identified in this field
Numerous large granular platelets and thin smear background with a crystal-like artifact
63402.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows several nucleated red cells with small dense nuclei, one of which displays nuclear budding with a detached nuclear fragment. Red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with oval and teardrop-like forms, and platelets are numerous with large granular forms. Classic bite or blister cells are not convincingly seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a hemolytic picture with circulating nucleated red cells showing nuclear budding; these changes are not specific, and G6PD deficiency requires confirmation by enzyme assay and a Heinz body preparation.

ddx.dx: Dyserythropoiesis (e.g., myelodysplastic neoplasm, congenital dyserythropoietic anemia)
ddx.vs: True dyserythropoiesis shows internuclear bridging, multinuclearity and megaloblastoid change in marrow precursors, whereas budding in circulating normoblasts during acute hemolysis is a reactive finding.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single small round nuclear remnants in anucleate red cells, not a bud attached to a nucleated cell.
Thalassemia shows prominent microcytosis, target cells and basophilic stippling with a lifelong history rather than acute hemolysis after an oxidant trigger.
MAHA shows schistocytes with thrombocytopenia, whereas platelets are abundant here.

63338.recognize_zh: 高倍下多個異型巨核細胞（megakaryocyte）聚集，核濃染、呈雲朵狀或團塊狀分葉（hyperchromatic, clumped nuclei），部分核質比偏高，周圍有含鐵血黃素沉積與脂肪空泡；這是骨髓纖維化期 MPN 的巨核細胞異型性。
features: Clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with variable size
Hyperchromatic, bulbous and clumped (cloud-like) nuclei with aberrant lobation
Some megakaryocytes with increased N:C ratio and naked nuclear forms
Background fibrotic eosinophilic stroma with intrasinusoidal-appearing hematopoiesis
Scattered erythroid and granulocytic precursors; coarse brown hemosiderin deposits
Interspersed fat vacuoles
63338.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, bulbous and clumped nuclei, aberrant lobation and variable nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios. The background shows mixed granulocytic and erythroid precursors in a streaming, fibrotic-appearing stroma with scattered hemosiderin deposits and fat vacuoles. Reticulin staining is needed to grade fibrosis. In a patient with polycythemia vera, findings are consistent with the megakaryocytic atypia of post-polycythemic myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei and loosely scattered, without hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei or significant fibrosis.
PMF shows the same cloud-like hyperchromatic megakaryocytes; distinction requires prior PV history.
MDS megakaryocytes are small, hypolobated or micromegakaryocytes with dysplasia in other lineages rather than bulbous hyperchromatic clusters.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia / acute panmyelosis with myelofibrosis
ddx.vs: These show sheets of CD34/CD61-positive blasts with small dysplastic megakaryocytes and an acute clinical course.

exam.answer_en: Post-polycythemia vera myelofibrosis — clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, bulbous cloud-like nuclei in fibrotic marrow
pearls_zh: 考法：指成簇的巨核細胞問「MPN 纖維化期的巨核細胞異型性」：核濃染、雲朵狀/球狀（bulbous）、N:C 比升高、裸核；常與 ET 巨核細胞比較。
MPN 巨核細胞比較：ET 為大至巨大、hyperlobulated staghorn 核、散在分布；PV 為大小多形、鬆散聚集；PMF 與 post-PV MF 為異型、緊密大簇、濃染雲朵狀核。
必做 reticulin（WHO 0–3 分級）與 trichrome；纖維化 grade 2–3 加上先前 PV 病史才符合 post-PV MF。
分子：以 JAK2 V617F 為主；額外的 high-molecular-risk 突變（如 ASXL1、SRSF2、EZH2、IDH1/2）與較差預後相關。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 ET 的巨核細胞或 MDS 的發育不良巨核細胞；本圖為濃染雲朵狀核、成簇且背景纖維化，MDS 則多為 hypolobated 或 micromegakaryocytes。

quiz.q: 圖中成簇的大型細胞是哪一種細胞？其核形態如何描述？
quiz.a: Atypical megakaryocytes；hyperchromatic, bulbous/cloud-like nuclei

63274.recognize_zh: 兩個 40 倍血液抹片視野（A、B）中，紅血球間散布許多小型碎片、盔形及三角形的破碎紅血球（schistocytes），部分為棘狀皺縮細胞，血小板仍可見；這種碎裂紅血球是機械性溶血的判讀重點。
features: Composite of two low-power peripheral blood fields (A, B)
Scattered schistocytes including small irregular fragments, helmet cells and triangular forms
Occasional crenated/echinocytic red cells and mild anisopoikilocytosis
Platelets present in small clumps, not markedly reduced in these fields
Leukocytes include segmented neutrophils, lymphocytes and a larger mononuclear cell; no blasts
63274.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power (two fields) shows mild to moderate anisopoikilocytosis with scattered schistocytes, including small irregular fragments, helmet cells and triangular forms, as well as occasional crenated red cells. Platelets are present and appear adequate in these fields, and the leukocytes are morphologically unremarkable. At this magnification a schistocyte percentage should be estimated on high power before reporting. Findings are consistent with fragmentation hemolysis, compatible with mechanical hemolytic anemia in the appropriate clinical setting such as a prosthetic or diseased heart valve.

ddx.vs: Shows similar schistocytes but with marked thrombocytopenia, whereas platelets appear preserved here; ADAMTS13 activity and renal function help separate them.
Schistocytes are accompanied by thrombocytopenia and prolonged PT/aPTT with low fibrinogen and elevated D-dimer.
Artifactual crenated cells are evenly spiculated and uniform in size, lacking the sharp-cornered fragments and helmet cells of true schistocytes.
Show micropoikilocytes and budding fragments with microspherocytes, related to red cell membrane defects or thermal injury rather than a valve.

exam.answer_en: Mechanical (fragmentation) hemolytic anemia — scattered schistocytes including helmet cells and triangular fragments, platelets preserved
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍先判斷主題是 schistocytes，再問病因：人工/病變心臟瓣膜、TMA、DIC；本圖血小板不少，是傾向瓣膜相關機械性溶血的線索。
Schistocyte 應在高倍單層區計數，ICSH 建議至少計數 1000 顆紅血球；>1% 支持 thrombotic microangiopathy。
血管內溶血檢驗：LDH 升高、haptoglobin 下降、hemoglobinuria 與 hemosiderinuria，DAT 陰性；長期尿中失鐵可導致缺鐵。
人工瓣膜溶血常與瓣膜周圍漏（paravalvular leak）相關，應安排心臟超音波；嚴重者需手術處理。
exam.pitfall_zh: 低倍下易把乾燥假影造成的 echinocytes 算成 schistocytes；真正 schistocytes 有銳角或直邊，echinocytes 大小一致、周緣均勻小棘。

quiz.q: 圖中帶銳角的破碎紅血球稱為什麼？血小板數正常時最應考慮哪類病因？
quiz.a: Schistocytes（如 helmet cells）；人工或病變心臟瓣膜造成的機械性溶血

63210.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片六格 H&E 中，脂肪細胞之間的間質被大片淡粉紅色、無細胞、質地均勻呈蠟樣的無定形物質取代，並有裂隙；造血細胞與漿細胞被擠到沉積物邊緣，形態上符合類澱粉（amyloid）沉積。
features: Overall normocellular marrow with preserved adipocytes and a bony trabecula at low power
Extensive interstitial deposits of pale eosinophilic, acellular, amorphous, waxy material separating fat cells
Artifactual cracks and clefts within the deposits
Residual hematopoietic cells and scattered plasma cells compressed at the edges of the deposits
No sheets or nodules of neoplastic plasma cells evident on H&E
63210.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy (H&E, composite of six fields) shows an overall normocellular marrow with preserved adipocytes. At higher power, the interstitium contains abundant pale eosinophilic, acellular, amorphous, glassy deposits with fine cracking artifact, displacing residual hematopoietic elements and scattered plasma cells to the periphery of the deposits. No sheets of neoplastic plasma cells are evident on H&E. The morphology is suggestive of amyloid deposition; confirmation requires Congo red staining with apple-green birefringence under polarized light and amyloid typing, and plasma cell clonality should be assessed with CD138 and kappa/lambda studies.

ddx.vs: Shows finely granular or fibrillar pale pink-blue ground substance with hypocellularity and fat atrophy, and is Congo red negative but Alcian blue positive.
Edema and fibrin are paler, wispy or fibrillar rather than dense waxy cracked deposits, and are Congo red negative.
Deposits are Congo red negative and non-fibrillar (granular) on electron microscopy, despite monotypic light chain staining.
Fibrosis consists of collagen bundles with spindle fibroblasts highlighted by reticulin/trichrome, not structureless amorphous material.

exam.answer_en: Amyloid deposition in bone marrow — interstitial acellular, waxy eosinophilic amorphous deposits with cracking (confirm with Congo red)
pearls_zh: 考法：指淡粉紅、無細胞、蠟樣物質問下一步染色：Congo red 在偏光下呈 apple-green birefringence；也常問沉積位置（間質、血管壁）。
分型：AL（輕鏈，lambda 多於 kappa）、ATTR（wild-type 或 hereditary）、AA；治療前建議以 mass spectrometry 分型，IHC 分型易誤判。
AL amyloidosis 的骨髓 clonal plasma cells 常只有少量（多低於 10%）；需搭配 serum/urine immunofixation 與 serum free light chain。
預後取決於心臟侵犯（NT-proBNP、troponin 用於 Mayo staging）；可合併腎病症候群，以及因 factor X 缺乏導致的出血。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 gelatinous transformation 或水腫混淆：後者較淡、呈細顆粒或絲狀，Congo red 陰性（gelatinous transformation Alcian blue 陽性），並常伴脂肪萎縮與低細胞性。

quiz.q: 要確認這些沉積物為類澱粉，應做什麼染色？偏光下有何表現？
quiz.a: Congo red；apple-green birefringence

63082.recognize_zh: 這是流程示意圖（Figure 2）：MPN 導致血栓，並分為動脈（經動脈粥狀硬化）與靜脈血栓；CHIP 同時連到動脈粥狀硬化與其他癌症，發炎與 MPN、其他癌症雙向互相促進並獨立促成血栓。
features: Box-and-arrow flow diagram labeled Figure 2
MPN leads to thrombosis, which branches into atherosclerosis (then arterial) and venous thrombosis
CHIP connects to atherosclerosis and to other cancers
Bidirectional arrows link MPN with other cancers and other cancers with inflammation
Inflammation feeds into thrombosis
63082.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic flow diagram (Figure 2) summarizing the pathogenesis of thrombosis in myeloproliferative neoplasms. MPN is shown as a direct driver of thrombosis, subdivided into venous thrombosis and atherosclerosis leading to arterial thrombosis. Clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP) is linked to atherosclerosis and to other cancers, and inflammation is depicted as bidirectionally connected with cancers and as an independent contributor to thrombosis. The figure is interpreted as a conceptual model rather than diagnostic data.

62954.recognize_zh: 高倍下是一致的中至大型淋巴樣細胞片狀排列，核圓至略不規則、染色質細緻、部分有小核仁，視野中央可見有絲分裂像，散在淡粉紅色組織球；缺乏典型小細胞外觀，提示被套細胞淋巴瘤的母細胞樣/多形性（blastoid/pleomorphic）變異型。
features: Sheets of intermediate-to-large lymphoid cells with scant to moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin
Small but distinct nucleoli in many cells; occasional larger pleomorphic nuclei
Mitotic figure present in the center of the field
Scattered pale eosinophilic histiocytes and a few extravasated red cells
No proliferation centers or follicular structures
62954.describe_en: High-power H&E section shows diffuse sheets of intermediate-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and small distinct nucleoli. Occasional larger pleomorphic nuclei and a mitotic figure are present, along with scattered pale histiocytes. The cytology is more blastoid/pleomorphic than classic mantle cell lymphoma. With cyclin D1 and CD5 expression and a high p53 index, findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma, blastoid/pleomorphic variant.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli and are cyclin D1- and SOX11-, while pleomorphic MCL remains cyclin D1+/CD5+.
LBL has similarly fine chromatin with a starry-sky pattern but is TdT+ and lacks cyclin D1.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: HGBL has intermediate blastoid cells and high mitotic activity but is CD10+ and cyclin D1-, requiring FISH for MYC/BCL2.
Classic MCL shows small-to-intermediate cells with irregular nuclei, condensed chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli, lacking the blastoid chromatin and brisk mitoses here.

62890.recognize_zh: 視野中央一個略帶灰藍（多染性）的紅血球內有三個深紫色包涵體：兩個小圓點與一個新月形團塊，排列成笑臉狀；這些緻密、邊界清楚的紫色核殘餘就是 Howell-Jolly 小體。
features: Single slightly grey-blue (polychromatophilic) red cell containing three discrete dense purple inclusions
Two small round inclusions and one larger crescent-shaped inclusion, each sharply defined
Inclusions are smooth and homogeneous, not refractile, and lie within the red cell
Adjacent small round dark lymphocyte and a larger immature mononuclear cell at the field edge
Background normochromic red cells; image has a yellow-green color cast
62890.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a slightly polychromatophilic red cell containing three sharply defined, dense, dark purple inclusions: two small round bodies and one crescent-shaped body. The inclusions are homogeneous and non-refractile, consistent with nuclear remnants. A small lymphocyte and a larger immature mononuclear cell are present nearby, and the image has a yellow-green color cast that limits assessment of subtle staining. Findings are consistent with multiple Howell-Jolly bodies, which may reflect hyposplenism or dyserythropoiesis, in a patient under follow-up for acute myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Smaller, multiple grey-blue granules clustered at the cell periphery that stain with Prussian blue, rather than one to three dense round purple bodies.
Numerous fine to coarse blue dots distributed evenly throughout the red cell.
Rings have a chromatin dot attached to a delicate blue cytoplasmic ring, whereas Howell-Jolly bodies are solid round bodies without cytoplasm.
Platelets have granular purple centers with a pale halo and lie in a different focal plane.

exam.answer_en: Howell-Jolly bodies — multiple dense, sharply defined purple nuclear remnants within a single red cell
pearls_zh: 考法：指紅血球內緻密圓形紫色小體，問名稱與成分（DNA 核殘餘），並與 Pappenheimer bodies、basophilic stippling 區分。
正常由脾臟移除（pitting）；出現多提示脾功能低下、切脾後，或紅系病態造血與巨母紅血球性貧血。
一顆紅血球內出現多個 HJ bodies 較常與 dyserythropoiesis（如 MDS、白血病治療後、megaloblastic）相關。
Feulgen 陽性、Prussian blue 陰性；Pappenheimer bodies 為 Prussian blue 陽性的含鐵顆粒。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Pappenheimer bodies：後者為多顆細小灰藍顆粒、聚集於紅血球周邊且鐵染色陽性；HJ bodies 較大、圓且緻密深紫、邊界清楚。

quiz.q: 紅血球內這些緻密深紫色小體是什麼？成分為何？
quiz.a: Howell-Jolly bodies；DNA 核殘餘

62826.recognize_zh: 雌激素受體（ER）免疫染色下，瀰漫浸潤骨髓的腫瘤細胞核大多呈強烈深棕色陽性，夾雜的小型造血細胞核為藍色陰性；腫瘤細胞 ER 核陽性，支持轉移性乳癌。
features: IHC for estrogen receptor on a marrow core with diffuse tumor infiltration and scattered fat spaces
Strong nuclear staining in the large majority of tumor cells, with some weaker nuclei
Faint nonspecific cytoplasmic blush in some tumor cells
Interspersed small residual hematopoietic cells with negative blue nuclei
Tumor cells arranged in discohesive sheets without glands
62826.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for estrogen receptor on the bone marrow core shows strong nuclear positivity in the large majority of the diffusely infiltrating tumor cells, while interspersed small residual hematopoietic cells are negative. Faint cytoplasmic blush is present but nuclear localization is unequivocal. In conjunction with GATA3 positivity, cytoplasmic p120 and the plasmacytoid discohesive morphology, findings support metastatic ER-positive lobular breast carcinoma.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells are ER and GATA3 negative and show CD138/MUM1 positivity with light chain restriction.
These can be ER positive but are PAX8 positive and usually GATA3 negative.
Gastric signet ring carcinoma is typically ER and GATA3 negative and often CDX2 positive.

62762.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片以網狀纖維染色與三色染色顯示明顯纖維化，H&E 可見流線狀基質中散在異型巨核細胞；臨床照片則有前臂皮下結節與手指變形、表面白色堊狀沉積的痛風石，符合原發性骨髓纖維化合併難治性痛風。
features: Hypercellular fibrotic marrow with streaming spindle-shaped stroma (H&E)
Scattered large atypical, hyperchromatic megakaryocytes within fibrotic stroma
Dense, diffuse reticulin fibers adjacent to a bone trabecula (reticulin stain)
Extensive blue collagen deposition on trichrome stain, indicating collagen fibrosis
Clinical photos: subcutaneous forearm nodules and deforming, ulcerated digital tophi with chalky white material
62762.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a cellular marrow replaced by streaming fibrotic stroma containing scattered atypical, hyperchromatic megakaryocytes. Reticulin stain demonstrates diffuse and dense intersecting reticulin fibers, and trichrome stain shows extensive collagen deposition, consistent with advanced (MF-3) fibrosis. Accompanying clinical photographs show subcutaneous nodules over the forearm and severely deformed, ulcerated fingers with chalky white deposits, consistent with tophaceous gout. Findings are consistent with primary myelofibrosis in the overt fibrotic stage, with secondary hyperuricemia manifesting as refractory tophaceous gout.

ddx.dx: Post-polycythemia vera or post-essential thrombocythemia myelofibrosis
ddx.vs: Marrow morphology may be identical, so separation depends on a documented prior history of PV or ET.
MDS with fibrosis shows small hypolobated dysplastic megakaryocytes and multilineage dysplasia rather than large cloud-like MPN-type megakaryocytes, with no JAK2/CALR/MPL driver.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma with desmoplastic marrow fibrosis
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumor forms cohesive keratin-positive epithelial nests within the fibrosis, lacking atypical megakaryocytic clusters.
HCL fibrosis is reticulin-predominant with a diffuse infiltrate of fried-egg B cells (CD20, annexin A1, BRAF V600E positive) rather than atypical megakaryocytes.

62698.recognize_zh: 淋巴球 gate 的 CD5 對 CD7 流式圖：綠色 NK 細胞族群 CD7 陽性、CD5 陰性且數量多；藍色 T 細胞 CD5 與 CD7 皆陽性，紫色族群兩者皆陰性（B 細胞）。
features: Dot plot gated on lymphocytes: CD5-PB (x) versus CD7-APC700 (y), color-coded populations
Large green population CD7 positive (~10^1), CD5 negative, consistent with NK cells
Blue population CD5 positive, CD7 positive with partial dimmer CD7 tail, consistent with T cells
Magenta population CD5 negative, CD7 negative, consistent with B cells
NK population is expanded relative to T cells
62698.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of the lymphocyte gate displays CD5 versus CD7. A large CD7-positive, CD5-negative population (green) consistent with NK cells is present alongside CD5-positive, CD7-positive T cells (blue) and a small CD5/CD7 double-negative population (magenta) consistent with B cells. The expanded CD5-negative NK population retains CD7 in this plot. Combined with other tubes showing surface CD3 negativity and CD2, CD56 and CD57 expression, findings support an NK-cell lymphocytosis, consistent with the reported chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells.

ddx.vs: T-LGL cells are surface CD3 positive, frequently with dim or lost CD5 and CD7, whereas the expanded population here is CD5 negative and must be shown to be CD3 negative.
Reactive expansions are transient and show polyclonal KIR (CD158) expression, whereas CLPD-NK persists over 6 months with restricted KIR expression or loss of CD94/NKG2A heterogeneity.
ANKL is usually CD56 bright with immature morphology, EBV positivity and a fulminant course rather than an indolent lymphocytosis.

62634.recognize_zh: CD34 染色主要標出骨髓中大量微血管與竇狀內皮細胞，箭頭所指是一顆圓形、細胞膜陽性的造血前驅細胞/母細胞，屬於零星存在；表示在細胞增多的骨髓中母細胞並未增加。
features: Strong CD34 staining of capillary and sinusoidal endothelium throughout the marrow
Arrow marks a single round CD34-positive hematopoietic cell with membranous staining
No clusters or aggregates of CD34-positive blasts
Hypercellular marrow with numerous CD34-negative hematopoietic cells and fat spaces
Weak non-specific background staining at the upper left edge
62634.describe_en: CD34 immunohistochemistry of a bone marrow core biopsy shows strong staining of numerous capillaries and sinusoidal endothelial cells, which serve as an internal positive control. Hematopoietic CD34-positive cells are rare; the arrow marks a single round cell with membranous staining, and no clusters or sheets of CD34-positive blasts are identified in the hypercellular marrow. Findings indicate that blasts are not increased, arguing against a myelodysplastic or acute leukemic process, and are compatible with the reactive marrow of paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria.

ddx.vs: Shows increased CD34-positive blasts (>=5%) often forming small clusters away from bony trabeculae.
CD34-positive blasts form sheets or constitute >=20% of cellularity.
Also shows few CD34-positive cells, but the marrow is markedly hypocellular with fat replacement.

62570.recognize_zh: CD3 免疫染色：散在與成片的小 T 淋巴球呈膜陽性，而夾雜其中的大型漿母細胞樣細胞（核大、泡狀、核仁明顯）完全不染，證明這些大細胞不是 T 細胞；是 germinotropic LPD 免疫組合中的陰性對照。
features: Membranous CD3 staining in numerous small reactive T lymphocytes
Large atypical plasmablastic cells with vesicular nuclei and nucleoli are CD3 negative
T cells denser in one region (interfollicular) and scattered within the follicular area
No aberrant CD3 expression in large cells
62570.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD3 highlights numerous small reactive T lymphocytes with membranous staining, more densely in interfollicular areas and scattered within the follicular region. The admixed large atypical cells, with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, are negative for CD3. This excludes a T-cell origin for the large cells. In the context of HHV8 LANA-1 and EBER positivity with lack of B-cell antigens, the findings support HHV8-positive germinotropic lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with large cells
ddx.vs: In PTCL the large atypical cells themselves express CD3 (or show aberrant loss of other T-cell antigens), whereas here they are CD3 negative.
THRLBCL has scattered large CD20+ B cells in a T-cell and histiocyte-rich background and is HHV8 negative, while the large cells here lack B-cell antigens and are HHV8 positive.
HRS cells are CD30+/CD15+, weak PAX5+ and HHV8 negative, often rosetted by CD3+ T cells.

62506.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下呈瀰漫的小至中型淋巴球浸潤，核圓、染色質深，其間混有較大、核淡且有核仁的前淋巴球與類免疫母細胞，形成較淡染的區域（增殖中心）；右上可見殘存巨核細胞，符合 CLL 骨髓浸潤。
features: Diffuse sheet-like infiltrate of small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells
Round nuclei with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm in most cells
Admixed larger cells with vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli (prolymphocytes/paraimmunoblasts) forming paler areas
Residual megakaryocyte in the upper right
Near-complete replacement of normal hematopoiesis in this field
62506.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy at high power shows diffuse replacement of the marrow by small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells with round nuclei and condensed chromatin. Admixed larger cells with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli, consistent with prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts, form ill-defined paler areas resembling proliferation centers. A residual megakaryocyte is present, but normal hematopoiesis is largely effaced. Findings are consistent with diffuse bone marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: MCL lacks proliferation centers, shows irregular nuclear contours, and is cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.
Richter transformation shows confluent sheets of large cells rather than scattered paraimmunoblasts within a small-cell background.
FL infiltrates are paratrabecular with cleaved centrocytes and are CD10/BCL6-positive, CD5-negative.

62442.recognize_zh: 一顆顆粒球的細胞核呈完整的甜甜圈狀環形，中央包著一小塊細胞質「洞」，核染色質粗大並帶紫紅色顆粒——這就是環形核嗜中性球（ring neutrophil），在骨髓性腫瘤中常與 i(17q) 相關。
features: Granulocyte about twice the diameter of surrounding red cells
Nucleus forms a closed, doughnut-shaped ring enclosing a central island of cytoplasm
Coarse, clumped chromatin within the ring nucleus
Pinkish-grey cytoplasm with fine violet granules
Background normocytic, normochromic red cells and a single platelet
62442.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a granulocyte with a ring-shaped (doughnut) nucleus enclosing a central clear zone of cytoplasm. The chromatin is coarsely clumped, and the cytoplasm contains fine granules. Surrounding red cells and the single platelet are unremarkable. Findings represent a ring neutrophil, a form of nuclear dysplasia that in a myeloid neoplasm such as acute myelomonocytic leukemia raises consideration of i(17q) or other cytogenetic abnormalities, but ring nuclei can also be seen in reactive and drug-related settings.

ddx.dx: Reactive or growth factor-associated ring nuclei
ddx.vs: Occasional ring-shaped band nuclei occur in reactive granulocytosis or G-CSF exposure, so significance depends on frequency and accompanying dysplasia.
A folded band has a U- or C-shaped nucleus with ends that overlap rather than a truly continuous ring with a central cytoplasmic hole.
Hypersegmented neutrophils have six or more discrete lobes joined by filaments rather than a single continuous annular nucleus.

ddx.dx: Monocyte with vacuolated or folded nucleus
ddx.vs: Monocytes have lacy chromatin, grey vacuolated cytoplasm and a folded nucleus without a sharply punched-out central ring.

62378.recognize_zh: 流式細胞儀母細胞閘中 CD33 對 CD13 作圖，69.81% 母細胞為 CD33+CD13+，另有 23.42% 為 CD33+CD13-，確認母細胞屬骨髓系譜系。
features: Dot plot gated on blasts: CD33-PC5.5 (y-axis) versus CD13-PE (x-axis)
Dominant CD33+CD13+ cluster (69.81%)
CD33+CD13- subset (23.42%) forming a tail toward lower CD13 intensity
Few CD33-CD13- (6.03%) and CD33-CD13+ (0.75%) events
62378.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on blasts shows CD33 versus CD13. Most blasts co-express CD33 and CD13 (69.81%), with an additional CD33-positive CD13-negative subset (23.42%); nearly all gated blasts are therefore CD33-positive. These findings support myeloid lineage of the blast population. Specific subclassification such as inv(3)/t(3;3) requires cytogenetic confirmation.

ddx.dx: B- or T-lymphoblastic leukemia with myeloid antigen expression
ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts may aberrantly express CD13/CD33 but carry lineage-defining CD19/CD79a or cytoplasmic CD3 and lack MPO.
BPDCN is CD4+CD56+CD123bright TCL1+ and usually CD13/CD33 negative or weak, unlike this strongly CD33+ population.

62314.recognize_zh: 低倍下可見散在的中小型淋巴球樣細胞，高倍下細胞核圓形至略呈腎形、染色質均勻，周邊淡藍色細胞質有細毛狀突起（hairy projections），符合毛狀細胞白血病（HCL）的周邊血表現。
features: Small to medium-sized mononuclear cells, slightly larger than mature lymphocytes
Moderate N:C ratio with round, oval to slightly indented/bilobed nuclei
Homogeneous, moderately condensed chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli
Pale blue cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections
Low-power field shows scattered abnormal cells without neutrophils or monocytes (suggesting cytopenias/monocytopenia)
Background red cells largely normocytic with occasional target cells
62314.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows scattered mononuclear cells, with no neutrophils or monocytes evident in the field. At high power these are small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly indented nuclei, homogeneous chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and moderate pale blue cytoplasm bearing fine circumferential hair-like projections. Red cells show mild anisocytosis with occasional target cells; platelets appear sparse. Findings are consistent with involvement by hairy cell leukemia, to be confirmed by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing.

ddx.vs: Villous lymphocytes of SMZL have polar, shorter villi and often a basophilic cytoplasm with occasional nucleoli, and are CD25/CD103/annexin A1 negative.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a prominent central nucleolus, higher counts without monocytopenia, and lack CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL shows broad-based polar villi and is typically CD25-negative, CD103 variably positive, and annexin A1/BRAF V600E negative.
Reactive lymphocytes show varied size with abundant cytoplasm hugging red cells rather than fine uniform circumferential projections, and are polyclonal by flow cytometry.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia in peripheral blood — mononuclear cells with oval/indented nuclei, pale cytoplasm and circumferential hairy projections; monocytopenia
pearls_zh: 考法：指細胞質周邊毛髮狀突起的淋巴細胞，問名稱與病名；並問抹片中「少了什麼」：monocytes（monocytopenia 是 HCL 的經典線索）。
典型臨床：中年男性、脾腫大而淋巴結腫大少見、全血球減少，周邊血 hairy cells 數量常很少，需仔細找。
骨髓常 dry tap（reticulin 纖維增加），診斷依賴切片 IHC 與周邊血流式（CD11c、CD25、CD103、CD123）。
BRAF V600E 為 classic HCL 的分子特徵；若 BRAF wild type 且 IGHV4-34，需考慮 variant 型或其他脾臟 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
治療前後易有感染（中性球與單核球低下），cladribine 治療後淋巴球長期低下需留意機會性感染。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 splenic marginal zone lymphoma 的 villous lymphocytes：SMZL 突起較短且集中於細胞兩極、常有核仁與漿細胞樣分化；HCL 突起環繞全周，且 CD25/CD103+。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞質周邊有毛髮狀突起的是什麼細胞？此病人周邊血常特別缺少哪一種白血球？
quiz.a: Hairy cells（hairy cell leukemia）；monocytes（monocytopenia）
