62250.recognize_zh: TTF-1 核染色使環繞膠質的濾泡上皮細胞核呈棕色，而旁邊的淋巴小葉完全陰性，證實這些濾泡是甲狀腺組織，與胸腺淋巴組織交錯分布。
features: Strong nuclear TTF-1 positivity in cuboidal epithelial cells lining colloid-filled follicles
Positive follicles form clusters directly abutting the lymphoid lobules
Thymic lymphoid tissue entirely TTF-1-negative
Follicles vary in size with no crowding or architectural atypia
Adipose tissue and vessels negative; fold artifacts present
62250.describe_en: TTF-1 immunohistochemistry demonstrates strong nuclear staining in the epithelial cells lining the colloid-containing follicles, confirming thyroid follicular differentiation, while the adjacent lymphoid lobules are negative. The TTF-1-positive follicles are closely intermingled with, but separate from, the lymphoid tissue and show no architectural crowding. Findings are consistent with ectopic thyroid tissue intermixed with a cervical thymic remnant.

ddx.dx: Metastatic papillary thyroid carcinoma in lymph node
ddx.vs: Both are TTF-1-positive, so the distinction rests on morphology: metastases show nuclear clearing, grooves and papillae within a nodal capsule/sinus framework, which are absent here.
Parathyroid chief cells form solid sheets without colloid and are TTF-1-negative, PTH/GATA3-positive.

62122.recognize_zh: 這是示意插圖：一顆大型細胞含兩個鏡像對稱的核葉，各有一個大而深染、如包涵體般的核仁，周圍核質淡染，呈典型「貓頭鷹眼」（owl-eye）雙核 Reed-Sternberg 細胞。
features: Very large cell with abundant pale-to-amphophilic cytoplasm (illustration)
Two mirror-image nuclear lobes with distinct nuclear membranes
Each lobe contains a single large, round, inclusion-like dark nucleolus with a perinucleolar clear halo
Vesicular, pale chromatin surrounding the nucleoli
Owl-eye appearance; no background cells depicted
62122.describe_en: This is a schematic illustration rather than a photomicrograph. It depicts a large binucleate cell with abundant cytoplasm and two mirror-image nuclei, each containing a prominent, inclusion-like eosinophilic-to-violaceous nucleolus surrounded by a clear halo and vesicular chromatin. The depiction corresponds to the classic diagnostic Reed-Sternberg cell of classic Hodgkin lymphoma; in tissue, such cells must be seen in the appropriate inflammatory background with a CD30+/CD15+/PAX5 weak/CD45- immunophenotype.

ddx.dx: Reed-Sternberg-like cells in EBV-driven reactive or lymphoproliferative states (e.g., infectious mononucleosis)
ddx.vs: RS-like immunoblasts in reactive states are usually CD15-negative, CD45-positive with strong B-cell program, and lack the classic Hodgkin inflammatory milieu.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma hallmark cells
ddx.vs: Hallmark cells have eccentric kidney-shaped nuclei with a paranuclear eosinophilic zone, grow in sheets or sinuses, and are CD30+ with T-cell/cytotoxic markers or ALK, typically CD15-negative and PAX5-negative.
LP cells have multilobated, folded nuclei with smaller nucleoli and are CD20+/CD45+, CD30-/CD15-, unlike the owl-eye RS cell.

exam.answer_en: Classic Reed-Sternberg cell (illustration) — binucleate owl-eye cell with mirror-image nuclei and large inclusion-like nucleoli; classic Hodgkin lymphoma
pearls_zh: 考法：看到鏡像雙核、各有大型嗜酸性核仁（owl eye）即答 Reed-Sternberg cell 與 classic Hodgkin lymphoma，並追問 IHC。
cHL 表型：CD30+、CD15+（多數）、PAX5 弱陽性、CD45−、CD20 陰性或弱且不均一；OCT2/BOB1 常缺失；EBV（EBER/LMP1）在 mixed cellularity 較常陽性。
NLPHL 的 LP（popcorn）細胞則為 CD20+、CD45+、PAX5 強、OCT2+，CD15−、CD30−，兩者表型相反是必考對比。
RS 細胞在腫瘤中通常少於數個百分比，背景以反應性 T 細胞、嗜酸性球、組織球、漿細胞為主，這是 cHL 的組織學特色。
臨床：B symptoms、搔癢、飲酒後淋巴結疼痛；分期以 PET-CT 為主，治療方案如 ABVD 或 brentuximab vedotin 組合。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 EBV 感染（infectious mononucleosis）的 immunoblast 或 ALCL 的 hallmark cell 誤認為 RS 細胞：immunoblast 為 CD15−、PAX5 強陽性；ALCL 為 PAX5− 且常 ALK+ 或 T 細胞標記陽性。

quiz.q: 這顆雙核、各有大型核仁的「貓頭鷹眼」細胞叫什麼？典型的 CD30 與 CD15 表現為何？
quiz.a: Reed-Sternberg cell；CD30 陽性、CD15 陽性（CD45 陰性）

62058.recognize_zh: 紅色免疫染色中倍下，陽性細胞不形成明顯結節而是廣泛散佈，其中許多呈中空的環狀結構（疑為包圍 LP 細胞的 rosettes 或膜染色的大細胞），反映 NLPHL 中較瀰漫的變異型態。
features: Diffusely distributed positive cells without a well-defined nodular arrangement in this field
Numerous ring-shaped positive structures with unstained centers, compatible with rosettes around large cells or membranous staining of large cells
Scattered smaller positive cells with membranous red staining between the rings
Background of numerous negative small lymphocytes
Antibody identity not labeled in the image
62058.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen, antibody not specified in the image) of lymph node at medium power shows positive cells distributed diffusely across the field without a clear nodular pattern. Many positive structures form rings with unstained centers, which may represent rosettes of positive T cells around large cells or crisp membranous staining of large cells; distinction requires higher magnification. Scattered smaller positive cells lie among a predominantly negative small lymphocyte background. In the context of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma, a diffuse distribution suggests a variant (diffuse or T-cell-rich) pattern; correlation with the labeled immunopanel, CD21 for follicular dendritic meshworks, and assessment for progression is required.

ddx.vs: THRLBCL has scattered large B cells in a diffuse CD8+ T-cell background that typically lacks PD-1+ rosettes and residual CD21+ meshworks.
LRCHL may show rosettes but its large cells are CD30+/CD15+ and weak for PAX5, which requires dedicated staining to separate.
Reactive paracortex shows a mixed population of immunoblasts with preserved sinuses and follicles, not diffuse ringed large cells effacing the node.

61994.recognize_zh: A–C 格骨髓抹片中，細胞核偏心、染色質呈輪輻狀、細胞質藍灰且有核旁淡區的漿細胞，胞質內充滿粉紅至紫紅色的桿狀/顆粒狀嗜天青結晶包涵體，外觀像前骨髓細胞；D 格免疫染色這些細胞呈強膜染色（插圖為同樣含包涵體的漿細胞），證實為腫瘤性漿細胞而非急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）。
features: Large plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and coarse clock-face chromatin (A-C)
Abundant cytoplasm packed with pink-red to purple azurophilic crystalline rods and granules (arrows/arrowheads)
Some cells show perinuclear hof; nucleoli occasionally visible
Background of maturing granulocytes and erythroid cells
Panel D: clusters of large cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic IHC staining (antigen not labeled, likely CD138); inset shows a plasma cell with cytoplasmic inclusions
61994.describe_en: Composite figure of bone marrow aspirate smears (Wright-Giemsa, panels A-C) and biopsy immunohistochemistry (panel D). The aspirate shows neoplastic plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and abundant basophilic cytoplasm packed with azurophilic crystalline rod-like and granular inclusions, closely resembling promyelocytes or Auer-rod-laden cells. The biopsy shows clusters of large cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining (antigen not labeled, pattern compatible with CD138), and the inset highlights a plasma cell with cytoplasmic inclusions on H&E. The findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with azurophilic crystalline inclusions, a morphologic mimic of acute promyelocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: APL promyelocytes have bilobed or folded nuclei with fine chromatin, MPO-positive granules and Auer rod bundles and are CD138 negative, whereas these cells have eccentric clock-face nuclei and are CD138/light-chain positive and MPO negative.
Promyelocytes have a Golgi hof with round central nucleus, fine chromatin and nucleoli, and mature in an orderly granulocytic sequence with MPO positivity.
Crystal-storing histiocytes are CD68+/CD163+ macrophages with intracytoplasmic crystals, not CD138+ plasma cells with clock-face nuclei.

ddx.dx: Plasma cells with Russell bodies or Dutcher bodies
ddx.vs: Russell bodies are round homogeneous pink immunoglobulin globules and Dutcher bodies are intranuclear, unlike the fine azurophilic rods and granules here.

61994.stain: Wright-Giemsa; IHC (antigen not labeled); H&E inset

61930.recognize_zh: 高倍CD20染色下，腦內小血管管腔擠滿細胞膜強陽性（棕色）的大型B細胞，核大、染色質空泡狀，血管壁外的腦實質細胞核則全為藍色陰性，是血管內大B細胞淋巴瘤的典型免疫染色表現。
features: Large tumor cells with strong, crisp membranous and cytoplasmic CD20 positivity
Tumor cells packed within vessel lumina, conforming to vessel shape, with a retraction space separating the vessel from surrounding neuropil
Nuclei are large (several times a glial nucleus), round to oval, with vesicular chromatin and unstained nuclear centers
Single CD20-positive cells present in smaller capillaries
Surrounding glial and endothelial nuclei are CD20-negative; no extravascular positive cells
61930.describe_en: High-power CD20 immunohistochemistry shows small vessels in brain parenchyma distended by large atypical lymphoid cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD20 staining. The neoplastic cells have enlarged vesicular nuclei and are confined to the vessel lumina, including individual positive cells within capillaries. The adjacent neuropil contains only CD20-negative glial nuclei without extravascular spread. Findings are consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Primary CNS diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Primary CNS DLBCL shows CD20-positive cells infiltrating into brain parenchyma around vessels rather than remaining purely intraluminal.
Its tumor cells are CD20-negative and positive for CD3epsilon, CD56, cytotoxic granule proteins and EBER.
Carcinoma cells are CD20-negative and cytokeratin-positive, forming epithelial nests with more cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma — large CD20+ cells confined within brain capillary lumina
pearls_zh: 考法：問腫瘤細胞位置（僅在血管腔內）與譜系（CD20+ B 細胞）；部分病例 CD5 陽性。
臨床常以不明熱、神經症狀、皮膚病灶、LDH 升高表現，常無腫塊或淋巴結腫大，易延遲診斷。
診斷可用隨機皮膚切片（random skin biopsy）或骨髓切片；亞洲型（Asian variant）常合併噬血症候群。
治療以含 rituximab 的化療為主，並考慮 CNS 侵犯的治療與預防。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為原發 CNS DLBCL；後者腫瘤細胞侵入腦實質形成血管周圍套袖與成片浸潤，IVLBCL 則僅在血管腔內。

quiz.q: 此 CD20 染色中腫瘤細胞分布最關鍵的特點？
quiz.a: 只在小血管腔內，無血管外浸潤

61866.recognize_zh: 低倍視野中散佈多個含細小環狀寄生蟲的紅血球，有些紅血球內含多個蟲體，並見紅血球外的小型蟲體，無瘧色素、裂殖體或配子體，符合巴貝西蟲（Babesia）感染。
features: Scattered red cells containing tiny intraerythrocytic ring and dot forms
Occasional red cells with more than one parasite
Small extracellular forms between red cells (some may be platelets)
No pigment, schizonts or gametocytes; red cells not enlarged
Tetrads not resolvable at this magnification
Partial nucleated cell at the left edge and a few crenated red cells
61866.describe_en: Giemsa-stained peripheral blood smear at low magnification shows scattered red cells containing tiny intraerythrocytic ring and dot forms, with occasional red cells harboring more than one parasite. Small extracellular forms are present between red cells, although some may represent platelets. There is no hemozoin pigment, schizont or gametocyte, and infected red cells are normal in size; tetrad forms cannot be resolved at this power. A partially captured nucleated cell is present at the left edge, and a few crenated red cells are likely artifactual. Findings are consistent with Babesia infection; confirmation by high-power examination and PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: P. falciparum lacks extracellular forms and tetrads and may show gametocytes, Maurer's clefts or pigment, with a travel history to an endemic area.
Overlying platelets are granular with a halo and are not ring-shaped with a pale central vacuole.
Artifacts are refractile or lie in varied focal planes over cells and background, lacking consistent ring morphology.

exam.answer_en: Babesiosis — scattered RBCs with tiny intraerythrocytic ring forms, some multiply infected, no pigment or gametocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：辨認環狀體後被追問「為何不是瘧疾」：無瘧色素、無配子體與裂殖體。
寄生率計算：受感染紅血球數 ÷ 總紅血球數 ×100%；一顆紅血球內有多個蟲體仍只算一顆。
形態不確定時以 PCR 確認並分辨物種。
輸血傳播性 babesiosis 是重要的輸血安全議題。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把染色沉澱或折光假影當成寄生蟲；假影焦面不一、常落在背景，Babesia 為紅血球內形態一致、有淡中心的細環。

quiz.q: 計算寄生率時，一顆紅血球內有 3 個蟲體要算幾顆？
quiz.a: 1 顆受感染紅血球

61802.recognize_zh: 免疫組織化學染色中，散在的圓形小至中型細胞呈棕色膜狀／細胞質染色，另有細長內皮細胞樣血管結構同樣陽性，型態最符合 CD34（標記未標示）；陽性母細胞零散分布於大量陰性骨髓細胞中。
features: Hypercellular tissue composed predominantly of negative cells with oval vesicular nuclei
Scattered round mononuclear cells with crisp membranous/cytoplasmic brown staining
Elongated positive endothelial-lined capillary structures serving as internal control
Positive round cells present singly and in small groups, not forming sheets
Bone trabecula edge at upper left
61802.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a hypercellular marrow core (marker not labeled; pattern most consistent with CD34) highlights scattered small-to-intermediate round cells with membranous and cytoplasmic staining, present singly and in small clusters, together with positive capillary endothelium as an internal control. The majority of hematopoietic cells, including larger cells with vesicular nuclei, are negative. The positive cells should be quantified and checked for clustering or abnormal localization; the findings support an increase in CD34-positive precursors in this GATA2-associated myeloid neoplasm rather than sheets of blasts.

ddx.dx: Reactive marrow with normal CD34 distribution
ddx.vs: Normal marrow shows CD34 mainly in endothelium with fewer than about 2% scattered positive precursors and no clustering.
AML shows diffuse sheets of CD34-positive blasts replacing the marrow, not scattered single cells.
Mast-cell or macrophage markers would label cells with granular or spindled morphology and would not outline capillary endothelium.

61738.recognize_zh: 免疫染色中可見成群的中至大型細胞呈強棕色膜狀陽性，分布成不規則的帶狀與團塊，旁邊為陰性的小淋巴球與壞死樣背景；圖中未標示抗體，染色型態像 CD20 標示的淋巴瘤樣肉芽腫大型 B 細胞。
features: Clusters and cords of medium to large cells with strong membranous staining
Positive cells show vesicular nuclei on hematoxylin counterstain
Irregular, band-like distribution rather than confluent sheets
Admixed negative small lymphocytes and a pale, partly necrotic-appearing background
Antibody not labeled in the image
61738.describe_en: Immunohistochemistry (antibody not specified; membranous pattern suggestive of CD20) highlights clusters and cords of medium to large cells with strong membranous staining in an irregular distribution, with admixed negative small lymphocytes and a pale background. Because the antibody is not labeled, the lineage of the positive cells cannot be assigned with certainty from this image alone. If this represents CD20, the aggregates of large B cells, together with EBER positivity and angiocentric necrosis in companion images, are consistent with lymphomatoid granulomatosis.

ddx.vs: DLBCL shows confluent sheets of large B cells without a prominent reactive T-cell background or angiocentric necrosis.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma (if the stain is CD30)
ddx.vs: ALCL shows uniform strong membranous and Golgi CD30 staining of hallmark cells that are CD20-negative and EBER-negative.
ENKTL large cells are CD20-negative and CD56/cytoplasmic CD3-positive despite also being EBER-positive.

61674.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下，骨小樑兩側的造血骨髓被纖維化的梭形細胞基質取代，其中散佈多核蝕骨細胞樣巨細胞（左下），骨小樑邊緣呈扇貝狀吸收凹陷；上方殘存脂肪與造血細胞，這種骨小樑旁纖維化加上蝕骨活性增加是副甲狀腺機能亢進（osteitis fibrosa）的表現。
features: Low-power trephine biopsy with thick trabecular bone traversing the field
Paratrabecular and intertrabecular fibrosis composed of loose to compact spindle-cell stroma replacing hematopoietic marrow (lower left and right)
Multinucleated osteoclast-like giant cells within the fibrotic stroma, most evident at lower left
Irregular, scalloped trabecular surfaces with resorption clefts suggestive of dissecting (tunneling) resorption
Residual hematopoietic marrow with adipocytes in the upper field, separated from bone by a rim of fibrous tissue
61674.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy at low power shows thickened, irregular bone trabeculae with scalloped surfaces and resorption clefts. The intertrabecular spaces adjacent to bone are replaced by cellular fibrous stroma of spindle cells containing scattered multinucleated osteoclast-like giant cells, while residual hematopoietic marrow with fat cells is present in the upper field, rimmed by paratrabecular fibrosis. Osteoblastic rimming cannot be assessed well at this magnification. Findings are consistent with osteitis fibrosa (hyperparathyroid bone disease) with secondary marrow fibrosis, in keeping with the history of primary hyperparathyroidism.

ddx.vs: Primary myelofibrosis shows clustered atypical megakaryocytes and diffuse reticulin/collagen fibrosis with osteosclerosis, without osteoclast-rich paratrabecular fibrosis and dissecting resorption, and is supported by JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations.

Histology is similar, so separation relies on clinical data: secondary hyperparathyroidism shows renal failure with low or normal calcium, whereas this patient had hypercalcemia and a parathyroid adenoma.
Paget disease shows a mosaic pattern of irregular cement lines with large osteoclasts containing many nuclei, and marrow fibrosis without hypercalcemia or elevated parathormone.

ddx.dx: Giant cell tumor or brown tumor of bone
ddx.vs: A brown tumor is a localized mass of hemorrhagic giant cell-rich stroma, whereas this biopsy shows diffuse paratrabecular fibrosis with scattered osteoclasts along trabeculae.

61610.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以中大型芽細胞為主，核圓、染色質細緻、胞質中等量呈嗜鹼性，部分可見少量顆粒與核旁淡染區，旁邊夾雜少數成熟嗜中性球，符合伴成熟的 AML 型態（CEBPA 突變需分子檢測確認）。
features: Predominance of medium-to-large blasts with round to oval nuclei
Fine, dispersed chromatin with small inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm, some cells with sparse azurophilic granules and a perinuclear hof
Scattered maturing neutrophils (segmented forms) and a few erythroid precursors
No hypergranular promyelocytes, monocytic nuclear folding, or overt dysplasia
61610.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and composed predominantly of medium-to-large blasts with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, a subset containing sparse azurophilic granules. Scattered maturing neutrophils are present, suggesting some granulocytic maturation. There are no hypergranular promyelocytes, no monocytoid features, and no significant dysplasia in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; the specific genetic subtype (mutated CEBPA) cannot be determined morphologically and requires molecular testing.

ddx.vs: NPM1-mutated AML often shows cup-like nuclear invaginations and monocytic features, but separation from CEBPA-mutated AML requires molecular testing.
t(8;21) blasts have abundant cytoplasm with salmon-colored granules, prominent perinuclear hofs, and long single Auer rods with dysplastic neutrophils.
Lymphoblasts have scant agranular cytoplasm and lack accompanying granulocytic maturation; MPO negativity and lymphoid flow markers confirm.
APL cells are hypergranular promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and bundles of Auer rods, not agranular to sparsely granular blasts.

61546.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD30 染色中，散在的大型單核與雙核細胞呈強膜狀加核旁高爾基體點狀（Golgi dot）陽性，周圍小淋巴球與組織球陰性，符合 CHL 的 HRS 細胞。
features: Scattered large mononuclear and binucleate cells with strong CD30 expression
Membranous staining with paranuclear Golgi-zone accentuation; nuclei with prominent nucleoli visible through the stain
Occasional smaller CD30-positive cells, possibly mononuclear Hodgkin cells or activated cells
Background small lymphocytes and histiocytes negative, with faint diffuse background staining
61546.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD30 on a bone marrow biopsy highlights scattered large atypical cells, including binucleate forms, with strong membranous and paranuclear Golgi-pattern staining. The surrounding small lymphocytes, histiocytes and stromal cells are negative, with mild nonspecific background staining. The large cells are present singly rather than in cohesive sheets. In conjunction with CD15 positivity, weak PAX5 and CD20 negativity, findings are consistent with marrow involvement by classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: ALCL forms cohesive sheets or sinusoidal clusters of uniformly CD30+ hallmark cells that are PAX5-negative, often ALK+ or EMA+, rather than scattered HRS cells with weak PAX5.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive DLBCL or large B-cell lymphoma with CD30 expression
ddx.vs: The CD30+ large cells in DLBCL are CD20+ with strong PAX5 and often form sheets, unlike scattered CD20-negative HRS cells.
Activated immunoblasts in viral infection are smaller, lack Golgi-pattern accentuation and CD15, and retain CD20/CD45 expression.

exam.answer_en: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma involving bone marrow — scattered large CD30+ HRS cells with membranous and paranuclear Golgi staining
pearls_zh: 考法：問 CD30 的染色型態—細胞膜加核旁 Golgi dot，是 HRS 細胞的特徵型態；並問陽性細胞分布為散在單顆而非成片。
CHL 完整表型：CD30+、CD15+（多數）、PAX5 弱陽性、CD45 陰性、CD20 陰性或異質、OCT2/BOB1 常缺失、MUM1 陽性；EBV 狀態視亞型而異。
骨髓侵犯即 Ann Arbor stage IV；在 PET-CT 分期普及後，骨髓切片多不再常規施行，但原因不明的血球低下或 B 症狀時仍具價值。
治療連結：CD30 是 brentuximab vedotin 的標靶；HRS 細胞常有 9p24.1（PD-L1/PD-L2）擴增，是 PD-1 抑制劑有效的基礎。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 CD30+ 活化免疫母細胞或 ALCL 當成 HRS 細胞；活化 B/T 細胞較小且無 Golgi 型態，ALCL 則成片分布、CD15 多陰性且 ALK 或 T 細胞標記可陽性。

quiz.q: 這些 CD30 陽性大細胞的典型染色型態是什麼？骨髓侵犯的 CHL 屬於 Ann Arbor 第幾期？
quiz.a: 細胞膜加核旁 Golgi dot；stage IV

61482.recognize_zh: 這是細胞遺傳學影像：放大後的 G 顯帶中期分裂相，約 46 條染色體分散良好、可見明暗帶紋，重疊少，是品質適合進行核型分析的中期細胞。
features: Magnified GTG-banded metaphase spread with chromosomes well separated and minimal overlap
Chromosomes elongated (prometaphase-to-metaphase length) with clear alternating light and dark bands
Centromeric constrictions discernible on many chromosomes, aiding identification
Chromosome identity and any abnormality cannot be determined until arranged into a karyogram
61482.describe_en: This is a cytogenetic image, not a morphologic smear, showing an enlarged view of a GTG-banded metaphase spread from a cultured bone marrow aspirate. The chromosomes are well dispersed with minimal overlap and show clear banding and centromeric constrictions, indicating a metaphase of good quality for analysis. Such spreads are counted and then arranged into a karyogram by length, centromere position and banding pattern. No abnormality can be interpreted from this unarranged spread, and findings require correlation with blood and marrow morphology.

61354.recognize_zh: 視野中央一個巨大組織球，細胞質淡染多泡，內含數個被吞噬的完整有核細胞（圓核細胞與分葉核嗜中性球）及紅血球碎片，是骨髓抹片上的吞噬血球現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant pale, finely vacuolated (foamy) cytoplasm
Engulfed intact nucleated cells within the cytoplasm, including round-nucleated cells and a segmented neutrophil
Phagocytosed red cell fragments/debris and small purple inclusions in cytoplasm
Background cellular aspirate with maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and plasmacytoid cells
61354.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular with trilineage hematopoietic elements. A large histiocyte with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm contains several engulfed intact nucleated cells, including a neutrophil, together with red cell debris, consistent with hemophagocytosis. Hemophagocytosis is a supportive but neither sensitive nor specific finding; correlation with HLH-2004 clinical and laboratory criteria (fever, cytopenias, ferritin, soluble CD25, NK activity) and a search for an underlying infection or malignancy is recommended.

ddx.vs: Isolated hemophagocytic histiocytes occur after transfusion or in sepsis without HLH, so the finding must be weighed against clinical criteria rather than morphology alone.
Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris rather than intact red cells, platelets or whole nucleated cells.
Storage histiocytes have striated or granular blue cytoplasm filled with lipid material, not phagocytosed intact cells.
Emperipolesis shows intact cells passing within megakaryocyte cytoplasm with a lobulated megakaryocyte nucleus, unlike a histiocyte with a small bland oval nucleus.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis in bone marrow — histiocyte containing engulfed intact nucleated cells and red cell debris
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指含被吞完整細胞的大組織球，問「這個現象叫什麼？足以診斷 HLH 嗎？」答：hemophagocytosis；不足以單獨診斷，需符合 HLH-2004 標準。
HLH-2004 需符合 8 項中 5 項（或分子診斷）：發燒、脾腫大、≥2 系血球低下、高三酸甘油酯或低纖維蛋白原、hemophagocytosis、NK 活性低、ferritin ≥500、sCD25 升高。
成人 HLH 常見誘因：EBV 等感染、淋巴瘤（尤其 T/NK 細胞淋巴瘤）、自體免疫疾病（MAS）；必須積極找原因。
Ferritin 明顯升高（常遠超過 500 ng/mL）是重要線索；成人可用 HScore 估計機率。
exam.pitfall_zh: 常誤以為看到噬血現象即為 HLH；輸血或敗血症也可見少量噬血組織球，且需與只含凋亡碎片的 tingible body macrophage 區分——後者不含完整紅血球或有核細胞。

quiz.q: 圖中組織球的現象稱為什麼？HLH-2004 診斷標準需符合幾項中的幾項？
quiz.a: Hemophagocytosis；8 項中至少 5 項（或有 HLH 相關分子診斷）

61290.recognize_zh: 抹片中滿是大型母細胞，核圓形、染色質細緻，多數可見一至數個明顯核仁，細胞質中等至豐富、灰藍色且無顆粒，符合單核母細胞（monoblast）為主的急性單核母細胞白血病（AML-M5a）。
features: Numerous large blasts with round to oval nuclei
Fine, delicate chromatin with one to several prominent nucleoli
Moderate to abundant grey-blue agranular cytoplasm
Occasional cells with eccentric nuclei; no nuclear folding in most cells
No Auer rods seen; thick area of smear with poorly spread grey red cells
61290.describe_en: Smear shows a predominance of large blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, one or more prominent nucleoli, and moderate to abundant grey-blue agranular cytoplasm. Nuclear folding is uncommon, and Auer rods are not seen. The background shows poorly spread red cells in a thick area. The morphology is consistent with acute monoblastic leukemia (FAB M5a); nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD11b, CD4) are recommended to confirm monocytic differentiation.

ddx.vs: M5b has predominantly promonocytes and monocytes with folded nuclei, whereas monoblasts constitute ≥80% of monocytic cells in M5a.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts in AML-M0/M1 have scantier cytoplasm and are MPO-positive or CD13/CD117-positive, and nonspecific esterase-negative.

ddx.dx: Large B-cell lymphoma in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells have deeply basophilic, often vacuolated cytoplasm with coarser chromatin and express B-cell markers.

exam.answer_en: Acute monoblastic leukemia (FAB M5a) — large monoblasts with round nuclei, prominent nucleoli and abundant agranular grey-blue cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指這群細胞質豐富灰藍、核圓有明顯核仁的母細胞，問「是哪一系？如何證明？」答：monoblast；NSE（α-naphthyl butyrate esterase）陽性且可被 NaF 抑制。
FAB M5a：單核球系細胞中 monoblast ≥80%；M5b 則以 promonocyte 與 monocyte 為主。WHO 中 promonocyte 視同 blast 計數。
流式：CD14、CD64、CD11b、CD4、CD36 陽性，MPO 常弱或陰性；常見 KMT2A 重排（t(9;11) KMT2A::MLLT3），多見於兒童。
臨床：單核球性白血病常見牙齦增生、皮膚浸潤、CNS 侵犯，以及高白血球造成 leukostasis 與 DIC；lysozyme 升高可致腎小管損傷。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 AML without maturation 的 myeloblast 或大 B 細胞淋巴瘤；monoblast 細胞質較多、NSE 陽性、表現 CD14/CD64，myeloblast 則細胞質少、MPO 強陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中母細胞最可能為何種細胞？哪一種細胞化學染色陽性並可被 sodium fluoride 抑制？
quiz.a: Monoblast（AML M5a）；nonspecific esterase（α-naphthyl butyrate/acetate esterase）

61226.recognize_zh: 黏膜切片中，擴張浸潤於腺體之間與固有層的淋巴樣細胞幾乎全部呈 CD3 強陽性（棕色），腺體上皮為陰性，顯示瀰漫的 T/NK 細胞表型浸潤。
features: Diffuse, dense sheet-like infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells replacing the lamina propria
Strong CD3 staining in nearly all infiltrating cells, with membranous/cytoplasmic pattern
Residual mucosal glands are CD3 negative and appear separated and compressed by the infiltrate
Positive cells extend between and around glands toward the mucosal surface
No significant CD3-negative lymphoid component visible at this magnification
61226.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD3 on a mucosal biopsy highlights a dense, diffuse infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells expanding the lamina propria and separating residual glands, which are negative. Nearly all infiltrating cells are strongly positive. In conjunction with the morphology, CD56 expression and EBER positivity, the findings support extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma; note that NK cells express cytoplasmic CD3-epsilon detected by polyclonal CD3 antibodies in paraffin sections.

ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates are mixed with B cells, plasma cells and preserved architecture, lack sheet-like destruction and are EBER negative.

ddx.dx: Enteropathy-associated or monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These intestinal T-cell lymphomas are EBER negative and often CD8+/CD56+ (MEITL) with prominent epitheliotropism rather than angiocentric necrosis.
PTCL-NOS is usually CD56 negative and EBER negative in tumor cells, and expresses surface CD3 with TCR rearrangement.

61162.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片的骨髓顆粒中，在脂肪空泡與造血細胞之間可見一條細長、彎曲成環狀的線狀結構，符合微絲蚴（microfilaria）；此張照片解析度低且下半部被灰色遮蓋，細節有限。
features: Marrow particle with fat spaces and trilineage hematopoietic cells along the smear edge
Slender, curved/looped filamentous structure within the particle at the center of the field, consistent with a microfilaria
Body is thin and faintly stained; internal nuclear column, sheath and tail nuclei not resolvable
Scattered erythroid precursors and myeloid cells without obvious intracellular organisms
Image quality limited: low resolution, uneven color and lower half blanked by a gray overlay
61162.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle with interspersed fat spaces and hematopoietic elements. Within the particle a thin, curved, looped filamentous structure is present, consistent with a microfilaria entrapped in the marrow particle. Detailed features such as sheath, nuclear column and tail nuclei cannot be assessed because of low magnification, image quality and a gray overlay obscuring the lower half of the photograph. Findings are consistent with microfilariae in the bone marrow aspirate, correlating with the peripheral blood microfilaremia in this patient.

ddx.vs: Fibrin forms fine interlacing meshwork and fibers are uniform and refractile, whereas a microfilaria is a discrete tapered worm with a column of nuclei.
Smear artifacts show smudged nuclear chromatin smeared in the direction of spreading rather than a looped structure with tapering ends.

ddx.dx: Leishmania or Histoplasma in marrow macrophages
ddx.vs: These are small intracellular organisms within histiocytes, not elongated extracellular worms.

61098.recognize_zh: H&E 呈緊密成片、核偏位且染色質粗糙的漿細胞樣細胞；CD138 呈瀰漫膜染色，kappa ISH 陽性而 lambda ISH 陰性，顯示單株輕鏈限制的漿細胞腫瘤。
features: Diffuse, cohesive sheets of medium-sized plasmacytoid cells with minimal intervening stroma
Round, eccentric nuclei with coarse (clock-face-like) chromatin and occasional binucleation; mild nuclear pleomorphism
Moderate amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm, some with perinuclear hof
CD138: strong diffuse membranous staining of essentially all tumor cells
Kappa ISH diffusely positive with lambda ISH negative (kappa light-chain restriction)
61098.describe_en: Biopsy of the sacral/iliac mass shows diffuse sheets of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse chromatin, moderate amphophilic cytoplasm and mild nuclear atypia, without an admixed reactive lymphoid or germinal center component. The neoplastic cells are diffusely CD138 positive and show kappa light-chain restriction by in situ hybridization (kappa positive, lambda negative). In a patient with known multiple myeloma, findings are consistent with a kappa-restricted plasma cell neoplasm (plasmacytoma/extramedullary progression of myeloma).

ddx.vs: Plasmablastic lymphoma shows larger immunoblastic cells with prominent nucleoli, very high Ki-67, frequent EBER positivity and usually no myeloma history.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL contains a CD20+ small B-cell component and residual follicles, whereas this lesion is a pure CD138+ plasma cell sheet.
Reactive plasma cells are polytypic with mixed kappa and lambda ISH signals and admixed inflammatory cells.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma with plasmacytoid morphology
ddx.vs: Carcinoma and melanoma lack light-chain restriction and express keratins or S100/SOX10, although CD138 can be positive in carcinoma.

61098.stain: H&E; IHC: CD138; ISH: kappa, lambda

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell neoplasm (plasmacytoma/extramedullary myeloma) — sheets of CD138+ plasma cells with kappa light-chain restriction
pearls_zh: 考法：組合圖常問「如何證明是腫瘤性？」→ kappa/lambda ISH 呈單一輕鏈限制（本例 kappa+、lambda−）。
腫瘤性漿細胞常 CD19−、CD45−、CD20−，可異常表現 CD56 或 cyclin D1（尤其 t(11;14)）。
孤立性骨漿細胞瘤需排除全身性骨髓瘤：評估骨髓克隆漿細胞、無 CRAB、PET-CT 或 MRI 無其他病灶；主要治療為局部放射治療。
本例已有骨髓瘤病史，腫塊屬全身性疾病的髓外/骨旁表現，治療依骨髓瘤全身治療原則。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 plasmablastic lymphoma；後者細胞更大、核仁明顯、Ki-67 極高且常 EBER+，本例為成熟漿細胞形態並有骨髓瘤病史。

quiz.q: 圖中哪兩張染色可證明這群漿細胞為單株？結果如何？
quiz.a: Kappa 與 lambda ISH；kappa 陽性、lambda 陰性

61034.recognize_zh: 三格並列的免疫染色：CD10 在散在中型淋巴細胞呈膜陽性、PD-1 在大量淋巴細胞呈強膜狀陽性、CXCL13 呈細胞質點狀顆粒陽性；同一淋巴結中多個濾泡輔助 T 細胞（TFH）標記陽性，支持 AITL。
features: CD10 panel: membranous staining of scattered and clustered medium-sized lymphocytes, many with clear cytoplasm
PD-1 panel: strong membranous staining of a large proportion of lymphoid cells in sheets
CXCL13 panel: dot-like/granular paranuclear cytoplasmic staining in numerous lymphoid cells
Positive cells are small-to-medium lymphocytes rather than large blasts
Composite image of three immunostains (labeled CD10, PD-1, CXCL13)
61034.describe_en: Composite immunohistochemistry of a lymph node infiltrate shows that the atypical lymphoid population expresses follicular helper T-cell markers. CD10 highlights scattered and clustered medium-sized lymphocytes with membranous staining, PD-1 is strongly expressed in a large proportion of the infiltrating cells, and CXCL13 shows granular dot-like cytoplasmic positivity in many cells. Expression of at least two (ideally three) TFH markers in the neoplastic T cells is consistent with nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphoma, angioimmunoblastic type (AITL).

ddx.vs: Normal TFH cells (PD-1+/CXCL13+) are confined to germinal centers, whereas here they are expanded in sheets outside follicles.
Shares the TFH phenotype but the neoplastic cells form nodular, follicle-like aggregates without extrafollicular FDC expansion or HEV proliferation.
PTCL-NOS by definition lacks expression of two or more TFH markers.
PD-1+ T cells there form rosettes around CD20+ LP cells within B-cell nodules rather than diffuse sheets.

exam.answer_en: Nodal TFH-cell lymphoma, angioimmunoblastic type (AITL) — neoplastic T cells express CD10, PD-1 and CXCL13
pearls_zh: 考法：三格 IHC 問「這些標記共同代表什麼表型？」→ 濾泡輔助 T 細胞（TFH），再問對應的淋巴瘤。
TFH 表型：除 CD4 外表現 ≥2 個（最好 3 個）TFH 標記：PD-1、CXCL13、ICOS、BCL6、CD10。
PD-1、ICOS 敏感度較高；CD10、CXCL13 特異度較高。
PTCL-NOS 依定義不具 TFH 表型；TFH 表型的 nodal 淋巴瘤分 angioimmunoblastic、follicular、NOS 三型。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為反應性濾泡增生（正常 TFH 也 PD-1+/CXCL13+）；正常 TFH 侷限於生發中心，腫瘤性 TFH 則在濾泡外成片擴張。

quiz.q: 淋巴結中 T 細胞同時表現 CD10、PD-1、CXCL13，代表何種表型？
quiz.a: Follicular helper T-cell (TFH) phenotype，支持 AITL

60970.recognize_zh: PET/CT 顯示左頸多顆 FDG 攝取淋巴結；切片低倍為副皮質區淡染擴張，高倍見大量核碎屑（karyorrhexis）、組織球與淋巴樣細胞但幾乎沒有嗜中性球，TCL1 陽性細胞與 CD123 陽性漿細胞樣樹突細胞團聚集在壞死周邊，符合菊池病（Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease）。
features: Panel A (PET/CT): multiple FDG-avid left cervical lymph nodes (arrow)
Panel B (low power H&E): pale, expanded paracortical area replacing normal architecture
Panel C (high power H&E): abundant apoptotic karyorrhectic debris with histiocytes (some with crescentic nuclei), immunoblasts and medium-sized plasmacytoid cells; neutrophils absent
Panel D: strongly positive cells (TCL1 per legend) at the interface of necrosis and viable tissue
Panel E: clusters of CD123-positive plasmacytoid dendritic cells at the periphery of necrosis
60970.describe_en: PET/CT shows multiple FDG-avid left cervical lymph nodes. The excised node shows a pale, expanded paracortex with patchy necrotizing lesions containing abundant karyorrhectic debris, histiocytes with crescentic nuclei, immunoblasts and plasmacytoid cells, and a conspicuous absence of neutrophils and eosinophils. Immunostains highlight TCL1-positive cells and clusters of CD123-positive plasmacytoid dendritic cells at the periphery of the necrotic foci. Findings are consistent with histiocytic necrotizing lymphadenitis (Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease).

ddx.vs: Shares karyorrhexis and pDC clusters but shows hematoxylin bodies, plasma cells and Azzopardi vessel changes; ANA/dsDNA serology is required.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell or large B-cell lymphoma with necrosis
ddx.vs: Immunoblasts are sheet-forming with clonal/aberrant phenotype, whereas Kikuchi shows a mixed CD8-T-cell, MPO-positive histiocyte and pDC population.
Suppurative/granulomatous necrosis with neutrophils or epithelioid granulomas, or viral inclusions, which are absent in Kikuchi.
Paracortical immunoblastic proliferation with EBER-positive cells and heterophile antibodies, usually without extensive karyorrhectic necrosis lacking neutrophils.

exam.answer_en: Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease (histiocytic necrotizing lymphadenitis) — paracortical karyorrhectic necrosis with histiocytes and pDCs, notably lacking neutrophils
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指壞死區大量核碎屑，問「缺少哪一種細胞」是關鍵 → 幾乎無嗜中性球與嗜酸性球，藉此與化膿性感染性淋巴結炎區分。
IHC：組織球 CD68+ 且常 MPO+（crescentic histiocytes），浸潤淋巴球以 CD8+ T 細胞為主，壞死周邊聚集 CD123+ plasmacytoid dendritic cells。
臨床：年輕亞洲女性多見，頸部疼痛性淋巴結腫大合併發燒、白血球低下；多為自限性，數週至數月緩解，以支持療法為主。
必須排除 SLE：驗 ANA、anti-dsDNA、補體；部分病人會同時或日後發生 lupus，應長期追蹤。PET/CT 可呈高 FDG 攝取而易被誤認為淋巴瘤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最危險的誤診是 peripheral T-cell lymphoma：兩者都有副皮質區擴張與大型免疫母細胞；Kikuchi 為多形性混合、CD8+ 為主、MPO+ 組織球且無 T 細胞克隆性，淋巴瘤則有細胞異型與克隆性。

quiz.q: 此淋巴結的壞死區有大量核碎屑，但明顯缺乏哪種細胞？診斷 Kikuchi 病後應檢驗什麼以排除相關自體免疫疾病？
quiz.a: 嗜中性球（及嗜酸性球）；ANA、anti-dsDNA 等檢查排除 SLE

60906.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中的巨大多核細胞乍看像蝕骨細胞，但細胞質為深藍色、無粉紅顆粒，細胞核具漿細胞樣粗塊狀染色質，旁邊並有雙核與多核的異型漿細胞；FISH 以箭頭標示多核細胞內的異常訊號，證實為多核腫瘤性漿細胞而非蝕骨細胞。
features: Giant multinucleated cell with numerous round to oval nuclei clustered centrally and abundant basophilic cytoplasm
Nuclei show coarse, clock-face-like clumped chromatin typical of plasma cells rather than the fine chromatin and nucleoli of osteoclast nuclei
Cytoplasm lacks the pink granularity of osteoclasts; small vacuoles present
Additional binucleated and multinucleated atypical plasma cells with perinuclear hof in panels B-D
FISH (panel E): multinucleated cell with arrows marking nuclei carrying abnormal probe signals, confirming clonality
60906.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows a giant multinucleated cell with many clustered nuclei and abundant basophilic cytoplasm, mimicking an osteoclast. The nuclei, however, have coarsely clumped plasma cell-type chromatin and the cytoplasm lacks the eosinophilic granularity of osteoclasts; similar binucleated and multinucleated atypical plasma cells are present in adjacent fields. Interphase FISH performed on the multinucleated cell demonstrates abnormal signal patterns in its nuclei (arrows), indicating that it belongs to the neoplastic clone. Findings are consistent with plasma cell neoplasm with multinucleated (osteoclast-like) myeloma cells.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts have separated, uniform nuclei with fine chromatin and single nucleoli in abundant pink granular cytoplasm, and are CD138 negative/CD68 positive.
Megakaryocytes have one lobulated polyploid nucleus with granular pink-purple cytoplasm rather than multiple separate plasma cell-type nuclei.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma with tumor giant cells
ddx.vs: Carcinoma giant cells arise in cohesive keratin-positive clusters, not among CD138-positive, light-chain-restricted plasma cells.
Occasional binucleation occurs in reactive plasmacytosis, but giant multinucleated forms with abnormal FISH signals indicate a clonal neoplasm.

60842.recognize_zh: 周邊血中大型母細胞核內有一塊淡染、界限清楚的中央凹陷，像杯口（cup-like/fish-mouth），A 圖插圖 MPO 顆粒集中於凹陷處；B 圖則為核摺疊成兩葉而非真正杯狀的母細胞，用以對比 cuplike AML（常見 NPM1、FLT3-ITD）。
features: Large blasts with moderate N:C ratio and fine, dispersed chromatin
Panel A: nuclei with a sharply demarcated pale central invagination occupying a large part of the nucleus (cup-like/fish-mouth nuclei)
Moderate amount of lightly basophilic agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods seen
Panel A inset: cytochemistry shows brown granular positivity concentrated in the region of the nuclear invagination
Panel B: blasts with nuclei folded into overlapping lobes giving a paler band, mimicking but not forming a true cup; inset with weak/negative staining in most blasts
60842.describe_en: Peripheral blood smears show numerous large blasts with fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and moderate agranular basophilic cytoplasm. In panel A, many blasts contain a well-demarcated clear central nuclear invagination spanning a substantial portion of the nucleus, giving a cup-like appearance, and cytochemistry highlights granular positivity localized to the invagination. In panel B, blasts show nuclear folding of two lobes that creates a pale overlap zone rather than a true invagination, with little staining in the inset. Findings in panel A are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blasts, a morphology associated with NPM1 mutation and FLT3-ITD; panel B illustrates a folded-nucleus mimic, and molecular testing is required.

ddx.dx: Acute monocytic leukemia with folded promonocytes
ddx.vs: Promonocytes have delicately folded, convoluted nuclei with gray-blue cytoplasm and fine azurophilic granules and are nonspecific esterase positive, without a sharp clear central nuclear pocket.
APL variant blasts show bilobed 'butterfly' nuclei with fine granules, strong diffuse MPO and PML::RARA, rather than a central cup-shaped invagination.
Lymphoblasts are MPO-negative with scant cytoplasm and lack the perinuclear MPO-positive cup region; flow cytometry shows CD19/CD10/TdT.

captions: A: AML blasts with cup-like nuclear invaginations; inset cytochemistry with positivity at the invagination
B: blasts with two folded nuclear lobes mimicking cup-like nuclei; inset with largely negative staining

exam.answer_en: AML with cup-like blasts (panel A: sharp central nuclear invagination with MPO at the cup) versus folded two-lobed nuclei mimic (panel B)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指 A 圖核中央清楚的淡染凹陷，問「這叫什麼形態？聯想哪些突變？」→ cup-like（fish-mouth）blast，與 NPM1 突變及 FLT3-ITD 相關；B 圖是核摺疊的假象。
Cup-like 定義重點：核內凹陷需佔核面積相當比例且界限清楚，MPO 顆粒常集中於凹陷處（對應 Golgi 區）。
表型：cup-like AML 常 CD34−、HLA-DR−，易與 APL 混淆，需儘快排除 PML::RARA。
分子意義：NPM1 突變無 FLT3-ITD 在 ELN 2022 屬 favorable；FLT3-ITD 陽性者可合併 FLT3 抑制劑（如 midostaurin）治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把核摺疊（B 圖）當成真正 cup-like：兩葉重疊只形成淡染帶、MPO 不集中；也易與 microgranular APL 的蝴蝶狀雙葉核混淆，後者 MPO 強而瀰漫並有 PML::RARA。

quiz.q: A 圖中核內有清楚杯狀凹陷的母細胞，最常相關的兩個分子變異是什麼？
quiz.a: NPM1 突變與 FLT3-ITD

60586.recognize_zh: 抹片中巨噬細胞胞質內塞滿多顆被吞噬的紅血球與有核細胞（噬血現象，hemophagocytosis）；切片中另見一顆大細胞帶有核內包涵體外圍透明暈（owl's eye）及胞質顆粒，免疫染色呈棕色陽性，提示 CMV 感染。
features: Large macrophages on aspirate smear with abundant cytoplasm engulfing multiple intact red blood cells and occasional nucleated cells (hemophagocytosis)
Macrophage nuclei displaced to the periphery by phagocytosed material
Tissue section: markedly enlarged (cytomegalic) cell with large intranuclear inclusions surrounded by a clear halo ('owl's eye') and fine eosinophilic cytoplasmic granular inclusions
Immunohistochemistry shows strong brown nuclear and granular cytoplasmic staining of the enlarged cell, consistent with CMV antigen
Surrounding cells lack viral cytopathic change
60586.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears (Wright-Giemsa) show several activated macrophages containing numerous phagocytosed erythrocytes and nucleated hematopoietic cells, indicating hemophagocytosis. A tissue section (H&E) shows a cytomegalic cell with prominent intranuclear inclusions surrounded by a clear halo and granular cytoplasmic inclusions, characteristic of cytomegalovirus cytopathic effect. Immunohistochemistry highlights the inclusion-bearing cell with strong nuclear and cytoplasmic positivity for CMV. Findings are consistent with cytomegalovirus-associated hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis in an immunosuppressed host; hemophagocytosis alone is not diagnostic and must be correlated with HLH clinical and laboratory criteria.

ddx.vs: EBV infection lacks cytomegalic cells with owl's eye inclusions and is demonstrated by EBER in situ hybridization rather than CMV immunostaining.
HSV produces multinucleation, nuclear molding and ground-glass chromatin without cytomegaly or cytoplasmic inclusions and stains with HSV rather than CMV antibodies.

ddx.dx: Reactive hemophagocytosis after transfusion or sepsis
ddx.vs: Occasional hemophagocytic macrophages occur nonspecifically, but they lack an identifiable viral cytopathic cell and do not fulfil clinical HLH criteria.
Lymphoma-associated HLH shows an atypical lymphoid infiltrate rather than viral inclusions, requiring immunophenotyping and clonality studies.

exam.answer_en: CMV-associated HLH — marrow macrophages with hemophagocytosis plus cytomegalic cell with owl's-eye intranuclear inclusion, CMV IHC positive
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指兩處——抹片中吞滿紅血球的巨噬細胞（hemophagocytosis）與切片中巨大細胞的核內包涵體（owl's eye），分別問現象與病原，再整合為 CMV 誘發 HLH。
CMV 確認：切片 CMV IHC 或 in situ hybridization、血中 CMV DNA 定量 PCR；免疫抑制（本例 azathioprine）是 CMV 再活化的背景。
HLH 判讀：噬血現象不具特異性（輸血、敗血症也可見），須符合 HLH-2004（8 項中 5 項：發燒、脾腫大、血球減少、TG↑/fibrinogen↓、噬血、NK 活性↓、ferritin ≥500、sCD25↑）。
處置邏輯：治療誘因（ganciclovir 或 valganciclovir）並減少免疫抑制；成人 secondary HLH 須同時篩檢感染、淋巴瘤與自體免疫三大誘因。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 CMV 巨大細胞誤認為 Reed-Sternberg 細胞或巨核細胞：CMV 細胞為單核、核內大包涵體外圍透明暈並有胞質顆粒包涵體，CMV IHC 陽性；RS 細胞為雙核/多葉核仁且 CD30/CD15+。

quiz.q: 切片中巨大細胞核內包涵體周圍有透明暈，這種外觀俗稱什麼？可用什麼方法確認病原？
quiz.a: Owl's eye inclusion；CMV 免疫染色（或 ISH、血中 CMV PCR）。

60650.recognize_zh: A 圖骨髓抹片可見多個巨噬細胞吞噬紅血球與有核細胞（箭頭，嗜血現象 hemophagocytosis），旁邊有深染的不典型淋巴樣細胞；B 圖 IHC 顯示大量瀰漫浸潤的陽性淋巴球，C 圖紅色核訊號 ISH 顯示許多細胞 EBV（EBER）陽性。
features: Aspirate: macrophages engulfing erythrocytes and nucleated cells (hemophagocytosis, arrows)
Atypical medium-sized lymphoid cells with dark, irregular nuclei and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Biopsy IHC (panel B): dense, diffuse interstitial infiltrate of membrane/cytoplasm-positive lymphoid cells replacing marrow
In situ hybridization (panel C): numerous cells with red nuclear signal, consistent with EBER positivity
Residual fat spaces scattered among the infiltrate
60650.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (panel A) shows several histiocytes containing phagocytosed red cells and nucleated cells, accompanied by atypical lymphoid cells with hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei. The core biopsy immunostain (panel B) highlights a dense, diffuse interstitial infiltrate of positive lymphoid cells, presumed to be a T-cell marker given the title, occupying most of the marrow space. EBER in situ hybridization (panel C) labels the nuclei of a large proportion of the infiltrating cells. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by an EBV-positive peripheral T-cell lymphoma with secondary hemophagocytosis; the specific T-cell antigen in panel B cannot be determined from the image alone.

ddx.vs: Reactive EBV-HLH lacks a dense, diffuse sheet-like marrow infiltrate of atypical T cells; clonal TCR rearrangement and aberrant T-cell phenotype support lymphoma.
Also EBV-positive with hemophagocytosis, but the neoplastic cells lack surface CD3 and TCR rearrangement and express CD56, whereas PTCL shows T-cell lineage.

ddx.dx: Systemic EBV-positive T-cell lymphoma of childhood
ddx.vs: Morphologically overlapping; distinguished mainly by age, clinical setting of acute or chronic active EBV infection, and a CD8-positive phenotype.
EBV-positive cHL shows scattered large Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30/CD15 positive) with EBER restricted to those cells rather than a diffuse EBER-positive small-medium lymphoid infiltrate.

60714.recognize_zh: 體腔積液中出現大型、多形性的淋巴瘤細胞，核不規則或多葉、細胞質深嗜鹼性且邊緣有細毛狀突起；免疫細胞化學顯示腫瘤細胞核呈點狀顆粒狀（speckled）HHV8 LANA-1 陽性，為原發性積液淋巴瘤的典型表現。
features: Large pleomorphic cells, many times the size of red cells, with high N:C ratio
Irregular, folded to multilobated nuclei with coarse chromatin and variably visible nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with ruffled or hairy cytoplasmic projections and occasional clear vacuoles
Immunocytochemistry (B): dense granular/speckled nuclear staining in the large cells, typical of HHV8 LANA-1
Background red cells and occasional small non-staining cells; no cohesive epithelial clusters
60714.describe_en: Cytospin of the effusion fluid shows numerous large, discohesive, pleomorphic lymphoid cells with irregular to multilobated nuclei, coarse chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm bearing fine surface projections, with features ranging from immunoblastic to anaplastic. An immunocytochemical stain demonstrates a speckled nuclear pattern in the large cells, characteristic of HHV8 latency-associated nuclear antigen (LANA-1). No cohesive epithelial clusters are seen. Findings are consistent with primary effusion lymphoma; the typical 'null' phenotype (CD45+, CD138+, CD30+, lacking CD20/CD79a and surface Ig) and EBER co-infection should be assessed.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving effusion / fluid overload-associated LBCL
ddx.vs: These express pan-B markers (CD20, PAX5) and are HHV8/LANA-1 negative.
Carcinoma and mesothelial cells form cohesive 3D groups with cytokeratin positivity and lack CD45 and nuclear LANA-1.
ALCL shows hallmark horseshoe nuclei with strong CD30 and T-cell/ALK expression and is HHV8-negative, whereas PEL is LANA-1 positive.
Plasmablastic lymphoma shares the plasmablastic phenotype but is EBV+/HHV8-negative and usually forms a solid mass rather than a lymphomatous effusion.

captions: Effusion cytospin: large pleomorphic lymphoma cells with basophilic cytoplasm and irregular nuclei
Immunocytochemistry: speckled nuclear HHV8 LANA-1 staining in tumor cells

exam.answer_en: Primary effusion lymphoma — large pleomorphic immunoblastic/anaplastic cells in effusion with nuclear speckled HHV8 LANA-1 staining
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指 IHC 核內點狀染色，問「這是什麼抗原？代表哪個病毒？」→ LANA-1，HHV8/KSHV。
PEL 典型為體腔積液而無明顯腫塊，多見於 HIV 感染者，常合併 EBV 共感染；亦有 extracavitary PEL。
表型為 null phenotype：CD45+、CD30+、CD138+、MUM1+，但 CD20、CD79a、PAX5 與表面 Ig 多為陰性。
WHO 5th 新增 fluid overload-associated LBCL：同樣以積液表現，但 HHV8 陰性、B 細胞標記陽性，預後較好。
exam.pitfall_zh: 因缺乏 B 細胞標記，易誤判為轉移癌或 ALCL：癌細胞成團聚集、keratin 陽性；ALCL 常 ALK 或 T 細胞標記陽性；PEL 以 HHV8 LANA-1 陽性確認。

quiz.q: 圖中核內點狀陽性的 IHC 是偵測哪個病毒的什麼抗原？
quiz.a: HHV8（KSHV）LANA-1

60522.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片低倍下以大量原始細胞（blasts）為主，其間夾雜幾個體積偏小、核單葉或低分葉的發育異常巨核細胞；「芽細胞增加＋小型單核/低分葉巨核細胞」是 AML with inv(3)/t(3;3) 的典型組合。
features: Hypercellular aspirate dominated by medium to large blasts with fine chromatin, nucleoli and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Dysplastic megakaryocytes that are small with non-lobated or hypolobated round nuclei
At least one megakaryocyte with a single dense eccentric nucleus and abundant pale cytoplasm
Few maturing granulocytes and scattered erythroid precursors in the background
No Auer rods or prominent granulation evident at this magnification
60522.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and composed predominantly of medium to large blasts with fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and scant basophilic cytoplasm, with reduced maturing myeloid and erythroid elements. Scattered megakaryocytes are dysplastic, including small forms with non-lobated or hypolobated round nuclei. Auer rods are not appreciated at this magnification. In the setting of an increased blast population, prominent mono-/hypolobated megakaryocytes should prompt cytogenetic testing for inv(3)(q21.3q26.2) or t(3;3)(q21.3;q26.2) (GATA2::MECOM), and findings are consistent with AML with MECOM rearrangement.

ddx.vs: MR-AML also shows multilineage dysplasia, so karyotype/FISH for 3q26 MECOM rearrangement is needed to separate it from inv(3)/t(3;3) AML.
del(5q) MDS has small mononuclear megakaryocytes too but blasts are <5% (well below the blast count seen here) and anemia with thrombocytosis is typical.
AMKL blasts are CD41/CD61 positive with cytoplasmic blebs and marrow fibrosis, whereas here dysplastic megakaryocytes are admixed with non-megakaryocytic blasts.
t(6;9) AML typically shows basophilia and multilineage dysplasia, and only cytogenetics reliably separates it from inv(3).

exam.answer_en: AML with MECOM rearrangement (inv(3)/t(3;3), GATA2::MECOM) — increased blasts with small mono-/hypolobated dysplastic megakaryocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指小型、核不分葉或少分葉的巨核細胞，配合大量 blast，問「應做什麼細胞遺傳學？」→ inv(3)(q21.3q26.2)/t(3;3)，MECOM rearrangement。
機轉：GATA2 enhancer 被重排至 MECOM 附近，造成 MECOM 過度表現；可用 karyotype 或 MECOM break-apart FISH 偵測。
臨床：血小板常正常或增加（與其他 AML 不同），常合併 monosomy 7；對化療反應差、預後不良，適合者應考慮 allogeneic HSCT。
WHO 5th 將 AML with MECOM rearrangement 列為 defining genetic abnormality，無 blast 比例門檻；ICC 2022 要求 blast ≥10%。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 MDS with isolated del(5q) 混淆：兩者都有單核小巨核細胞與血小板偏高，但 del(5q) blast <5% 且預後較好；inv(3) 需以 karyotype/FISH 確認。

quiz.q: 圖中核不分葉的小型巨核細胞配合 blast 增加，應懷疑哪個基因重排？
quiz.a: MECOM rearrangement（inv(3)/t(3;3)，GATA2::MECOM）

60458.recognize_zh: 高倍下單調一致的小到中型淋巴樣細胞，核輪廓不規則、略有切跡，染色質中等凝集、核仁不明顯，細胞質極少，其間散在粉紅色細胞質的上皮樣組織細胞（pink histiocytes），是被套細胞淋巴瘤的典型組合。
features: Monotonous small-to-medium lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm
Irregular, angulated to slightly cleaved nuclear contours
Moderately dense, evenly dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Scattered single epithelioid histiocytes with pink cytoplasm
Small hyalinized vessels; absence of large centroblasts, paraimmunoblasts, and plasma cells
60458.describe_en: High-power view shows a diffuse, monotonous population of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm, irregular to slightly cleaved nuclear contours, moderately dense chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli. Scattered single epithelioid histiocytes with eosinophilic cytoplasm and small hyalinized vessels are present. Large transformed cells, paraimmunoblasts, and plasma cells are not conspicuous. Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma, pending confirmation with cyclin D1 and SOX11.

ddx.vs: SLL cells have round nuclei with clumped chromatin and proliferation centers with paraimmunoblasts, and are cyclin D1 negative.
FL contains a mixture of centrocytes and centroblasts in follicles and is CD10/BCL6 positive and cyclin D1 negative.

ddx.dx: Blastoid mantle cell lymphoma or lymphoblastic lymphoma
ddx.vs: Blastoid cells have finer chromatin and high mitotic activity; lymphoblastic lymphoma is TdT positive and cyclin D1 negative.
MZL has monocytoid cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and plasmacytic differentiation and is CD5/cyclin D1 negative.

exam.answer_en: Mantle cell lymphoma — monotonous small-to-medium cells with irregular nuclei and scattered pink epithelioid histiocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指散在粉紅色細胞質的上皮樣組織細胞（pink histiocytes）與玻璃樣變小血管，問哪個小 B 細胞淋巴瘤具此組合。
表型：CD20+、CD5+、CD23−（或弱）、CD200−/弱、SOX11+；CD5+ 小 B 細胞淋巴瘤一定要做 cyclin D1 排除 MCL，避免誤診為 CLL。
必考遺傳：t(11;14)(q13;q32) CCND1::IGH 導致 cyclin D1 過度表現；cyclin D1 陰性 MCL 多有 CCND2 重排，SOX11 陽性可協助診斷。
預後因子：blastoid/pleomorphic 型態、Ki-67 >30%、TP53 突變/過度表現與 MIPI 分數；SOX11 陰性的 leukemic non-nodal MCL 通常較惰性。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 CLL/SLL；CLL 有淡染增殖中心（prolymphocytes、paraimmunoblasts），MCL 單一形態、無增殖中心、核不規則並散在 pink histiocytes。

quiz.q: 此單一形態小至中型淋巴細胞間散在粉紅色組織細胞，最符合哪個淋巴瘤？確認需哪兩個核染色？
quiz.a: Mantle cell lymphoma；cyclin D1 與 SOX11

60394.recognize_zh: 這是臨床照片：A、B 手背與前臂有多發紅紫色、表面光亮或破潰結痂的結節，C、D 為治療後結節明顯消退僅剩殘留小丘疹與色素沉著；在已知多發性骨髓瘤病史下，符合皮膚漿細胞瘤及治療反應。
features: Panel A: multiple firm, dome-shaped, red-violaceous nodules on the dorsal hand, the largest with a hemorrhagic/crusted surface
Panel B: forearm with multiple erythematous papules and nodules, some with scaly/crusted surfaces
Panels C and D: post-treatment near-complete regression, leaving small residual papules and mottled erythema/hyperpigmentation
No microscopic morphology is shown; confirmation requires skin biopsy with CD138 and light-chain restriction
60394.describe_en: Clinical photographs show multiple red-violaceous, dome-shaped cutaneous nodules on the dorsum of the hand (A) and the forearm (B), several with hemorrhagic crusts or scale. After therapy the nodules have largely resolved, with only small residual papules and post-inflammatory discoloration (C, D). This is a non-morphologic figure; in a patient with relapsed IgG kappa multiple myeloma, such nodules are suggestive of cutaneous plasmacytomas (extramedullary myeloma), which should be confirmed on biopsy by sheets of plasma cells expressing CD138 with kappa light-chain restriction.

ddx.vs: Biopsy shows blasts or lymphoma cells (e.g., CD20+ B cells or CD3+ T cells) rather than CD138+ light-chain-restricted plasma cells.
Violaceous nodules of Kaposi sarcoma show a spindle-cell vascular proliferation that is HHV-8 LANA positive on biopsy.
Amyloid presents as waxy papules or purpura with Congo red-positive deposits rather than dense plasma cell nodules.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Usually lacks systemic myeloma and shows a mixed B-cell and plasma cell infiltrate with reactive follicles rather than monotonous plasma cell sheets.

60266.recognize_zh: 散在數顆較小、緻密且沒有中央淡染區的紅血球，表面有數量不等、長短不一且分布不規則的尖刺或棒狀突起，與周圍正常圓盤狀紅血球形成對比，符合棘紅血球（acanthocytes／spur cells）。
features: Scattered small dense red cells lacking central pallor
Irregular, unevenly spaced projections of variable length with pointed or club-shaped tips
Background red cells largely normocytic with central pallor
No schistocytes, target cell predominance or red cell inclusions evident
No leukocytes in field; few platelets
60266.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a background of normocytic red cells with scattered acanthocytes. These cells are small, dense and lack central pallor, bearing a few irregularly distributed spicules of varying length, some with knob-like ends. Fragmented red cells are not prominent. Findings are consistent with acanthocytosis, as can be seen in advanced liver disease (spur cell anemia).

ddx.vs: Echinocytes have 10-30 short, evenly spaced, uniform projections and often retain central pallor, whereas acanthocytes have fewer irregular spicules and are dense.
Schistocytes have straight cut edges and sharp angular points from mechanical fragmentation rather than a round body with multiple irregular spicules.
Keratocytes have one or two horn-like projections flanking a ruptured vacuole, not multiple scattered spicules.

exam.answer_en: Acanthocytes (spur cells) — small dense red cells without central pallor bearing few irregular, unevenly spaced spicules; e.g. spur cell anemia of liver disease
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著緻密、無中央淡染區、突起長短不一且分布不均的紅血球，問 acanthocyte 還是 echinocyte——看突起數量、規則性與是否緻密。
機轉：紅血球膜外層脂質（cholesterol/phospholipid 比例）異常使外層膜面積相對增加；最常見於嚴重肝硬化的 spur cell anemia，屬預後不良的溶血。
遺傳原因必考：abetalipoproteinemia（MTTP 突變，脂肪吸收不良、脂溶性維生素缺乏、色素性視網膜病變）；neuroacanthocytosis 如 McLeod syndrome（XK 基因，Kell 抗原減弱）與 chorea-acanthocytosis。
其他情境：脾切除後、厭食症/營養不良；尿沉渣中的 acanthocytes（G1 cells）則指向腎絲球性血尿。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 echinocyte（burr cell）混淆；echinocyte 有 10–30 個短而規則、均勻分布的突起且常保留中央淡染區（也常是乾燥假象），acanthocyte 突起少、長短不一且細胞緻密。

quiz.q: 圖中帶不規則尖刺的緻密紅血球叫什麼？若病人合併脂肪瀉與色素性視網膜病變，最可能的遺傳疾病與突變基因為何？
quiz.a: Acanthocyte（spur cell）；abetalipoproteinemia，MTTP 突變。

60138.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中白血球以帶橘紅顆粒的嗜酸性球為主，數量明顯增加，部分核分葉異常（單葉或多葉），另見一個嗜鹼性球，呈現顯著嗜酸性球增多，符合 PDGFRA 重組相關腫瘤。
features: Marked eosinophilia: eosinophils are the most numerous leukocytes in the field
Some eosinophils with abnormal nuclear segmentation (non-lobated or multilobated)
Variable granule density, with a few cells appearing sparsely granulated (limited at this power)
Scattered neutrophils, lymphocytes and a basophil with dark coarse granules
Red cells largely normocytic; platelets present
60138.describe_en: Low-power view of the peripheral blood smear shows marked eosinophilia, with eosinophils outnumbering other leukocytes. Some eosinophils show abnormal nuclear segmentation and variably reduced granulation, although fine granular detail is limited at this magnification. Scattered neutrophils, lymphocytes and a basophil are also present, and red cells are largely unremarkable. Morphology alone cannot establish clonality, but in the setting of a FIP1L1-PDGFRA rearrangement, findings are consistent with a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PDGFRA rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophils can also look abnormal, so separation depends on clinical work-up and absence of PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 rearrangements rather than morphology.
Flow cytometry shows an aberrant T-cell population (e.g., CD3-CD4+) producing IL-5, without a myeloid clonal marker.
CML shows a granulocytic left shift with basophilia and BCR-ABL1, and eosinophilia is not the dominant finding.
SM is identified by marrow mast cell aggregates, elevated tryptase and KIT D816V.

60074.recognize_zh: 兩張骨髓抹片中，除了大量顆粒球系前驅細胞外，各有一顆細胞的核碎裂成 3–4 顆大小相近、極濃縮深染的圓球（karyorrhexis），周圍是淡染細胞質；這些是凋亡細胞（apoptotic cells），在 Diamond-Blackfan anemia 可能反映紅血球系前驅細胞凋亡增加，但圖中數量少，只能作為輔助觀察。
features: Cells with nuclei fragmented into 3-4 dense, uniformly round, hyperchromatic nuclear fragments within pale cytoplasm (karyorrhexis), one in each panel
Background marked myeloid predominance: promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands, and an eosinophil precursor
Maturing erythroid precursors not identified
Scattered small lymphocytes with condensed chromatin
Brownish red cell staining artifact; apoptotic cell frequency cannot be quantified from two fields
60074.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a marked myeloid predominance with promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands, and an eosinophil precursor, while maturing erythroid precursors are not identified. In each field there is a cell whose nucleus has fragmented into several dense, uniformly round, hyperchromatic nuclear fragments within pale cytoplasm, consistent with apoptotic cells (karyorrhexis). Whether apoptosis is truly increased cannot be established from these two fields and would require systematic counting or ancillary assays. Findings are consistent with erythroid hypoplasia with scattered apoptotic cells, which in Diamond-Blackfan anemia may reflect p53-mediated apoptosis of erythroid progenitors.

ddx.dx: Dyserythropoiesis with multinucleated or budding normoblasts (e.g. CDA, MDS)
ddx.vs: Dysplastic normoblasts have hemoglobinized cytoplasm and nuclear fragments with retained chromatin texture and variable size, rather than uniformly dense round apoptotic bodies.

ddx.dx: Howell-Jolly body-containing red cells or nuclear debris
ddx.vs: Howell-Jolly bodies are single small inclusions in anucleate red cells, not multiple large fragments in a nucleated cell's cytoplasm.
Contains phagocytosed apoptotic debris within an abundant histiocyte cytoplasm with its own intact nucleus.
Neutrophil lobes are connected by chromatin strands with granular cytoplasm, whereas these fragments are separate, perfectly round, and uniformly dense.

60010.recognize_zh: 視野中央的紅系前驅細胞在已血紅素化的灰粉色細胞質中含有五個大小不等的濃縮圓核（多核化），是紅系發育不良的明確證據；旁邊有數顆母細胞，底部另見一顆正常形態的正染性紅母細胞可作對照。
features: Multinucleated late erythroid precursor with five round, variably sized condensed nuclei
Hemoglobinized gray-pink cytoplasm consistent with orthochromatic stage
Adjacent blasts with fine chromatin, high N:C ratio, and basophilic cytoplasm
Normal-appearing mononuclear normoblast at bottom for comparison
Granulocytic precursor with indented nucleus at top; no Auer rods seen
60010.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a late erythroid precursor containing five discrete, variably sized nuclei with condensed chromatin within hemoglobinized cytoplasm, representing erythroid multinucleation. A mononuclear orthochromatic normoblast nearby provides a normal comparison. Several blasts with fine chromatin and basophilic agranular cytoplasm are also present, without Auer rods. Findings demonstrate dyserythropoiesis in a background of blasts, consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic multinucleated erythroblasts show open, finely stippled chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, without increased myeloblasts.
CDA shows binucleate or multinucleate erythroblasts in a young patient with isolated anemia and no increase in blasts.
Drug, alcohol, or chemotherapy effect can cause similar changes but without an increase in blasts, and resolves after withdrawal.

exam.answer_en: Dyserythropoiesis in AML, myelodysplasia-related — multinucleated orthochromatic erythroid precursor with five nuclei beside blasts
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指多核紅系細胞，並指底部單核正染性紅母細胞作對照，問哪一顆異常、叫什麼（multinucleated erythroid precursor）。
下一步：數 500 顆有核細胞分類決定母細胞比例；送 karyotype、FISH 與 myeloid NGS（含 TP53、ASXL1、SRSF2 等）以確認分類與風險。
TP53 突變：WHO 5th 與 ICC 對 TP53 處理不同；ICC 2022 設有 AML with mutated TP53 獨立類別（母細胞 ≥20%），預後極差，常伴複雜核型與明顯紅系發育不良。
治療：年長或不適強化療者常用 venetoclax + azacitidine；適合強化療的 secondary/MR AML 可考慮 CPX-351，並評估 allo-HSCT。
exam.pitfall_zh: 容易誤判為 congenital dyserythropoietic anemia：CDA 多為年輕人單純貧血、雙核或多核紅母細胞但母細胞不增加且無其他系異常；本圖旁有多顆母細胞，應朝 AML 方向並做分子/細胞遺傳。

quiz.q: 圖中五核的紅系細胞代表哪一系的發育不良？要判定為有意義的發育不良需達該系多少比例？
quiz.a: 紅系發育不良（dyserythropoiesis, multinucleation）；≥10%。

30314.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中有一個核分六葉以上的嗜中性球（hypersegmented neutrophil），紅血球大小不均，混有大卵圓紅血球、淚滴細胞與破碎紅血球（schistocytes），血小板稀少；過度分葉的嗜中性球與大卵圓細胞提示維生素 B12 缺乏，而非 TTP。
features: Hypersegmented neutrophil with six or more nuclear lobes
Marked anisopoikilocytosis with macro-ovalocytes and a polychromatic macrocyte
Red cell fragments (schistocytes), teardrop cells and small dense microspherocyte-like fragments
Decreased platelets in the field
No nucleated red cells or blasts in this field
30314.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with macro-ovalocytes, teardrop cells and red cell fragments including schistocytes, along with a polychromatic macrocyte. A hypersegmented neutrophil with at least six nuclear lobes is present, and platelets appear decreased. The combination of schistocytes and thrombocytopenia can mimic a thrombotic microangiopathy, but the hypersegmented neutrophil and macro-ovalocytes indicate ineffective megaloblastic hematopoiesis. Findings are consistent with severe vitamin B12 deficiency causing pseudo-thrombotic microangiopathy; normal or near-normal ADAMTS13 activity, low reticulocytes and very high LDH support this diagnosis.

ddx.vs: TTP shows schistocytes with reticulocytosis and ADAMTS13 activity below 10%, without hypersegmented neutrophils or macro-ovalocytes.
Morphology is identical, so serum B12, folate, methylmalonic acid and homocysteine levels are needed to distinguish them.
MDS shows hypolobated or hypogranular neutrophils and dysplasia that does not correct with vitamin replacement.
HUS and DIC present with schistocytes plus renal failure or coagulopathy and lack megaloblastic features.

exam.answer_en: Severe vitamin B12 deficiency (pseudo-TMA) — hypersegmented neutrophil and macro-ovalocytes with schistocytes and thrombocytopenia
pearls_zh: 考法：考官先指破碎紅血球讓你想到 TTP，再指 ≥6 葉核的嗜中性球問「哪個細胞推翻 TTP」；答 hypersegmented neutrophil 與 macro-ovalocytes 指向 megaloblastic anemia。
檢驗區分：B12 缺乏 pseudo-TMA 常見網狀紅血球偏低（無效造血）、LDH 極高、MCV 可偏高；ADAMTS13 活性不會嚴重低下（TTP 為 <10%）。
確認：血清 B12 低、methylmalonic acid 與 homocysteine 升高（MMA 對 B12 缺乏較特異）；查 intrinsic factor 抗體評估 pernicious anemia。
臨床意義：避免不必要的 plasma exchange；給予肌肉注射 B12，初期注意低血鉀；單補葉酸可能掩蓋貧血但使神經學（subacute combined degeneration）惡化。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤診為 TTP 並啟動血漿置換：兩者都有 schistocytes 與血小板低下，但 TTP 網狀紅血球升高、無過度分葉嗜中性球與大卵圓紅血球，且 ADAMTS13 <10%；PLASMIC score 在此情況可能誤導，MCV 升高是扣分線索。

quiz.q: 有破碎紅血球與血小板低下的病人，圖中哪一顆細胞提示應優先考慮維生素 B12 缺乏而非 TTP？
quiz.a: 過度分葉嗜中性球（hypersegmented neutrophil，≥6 葉）。

27498.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中的芽細胞細胞質內含一個或數個圓形、淡藍至粉紅色的大型球狀包涵體，外觀類似漿細胞的 Russell 小體；插圖切片中的細胞同樣含嗜伊紅圓形小球，電子顯微鏡則顯示細胞內一個大型、界限清楚的圓形包涵體——這是罕見的「類 Russell 小體」B 淋巴芽細胞白血病型態。
features: Panel A: large blasts with irregular nuclei and moderate basophilic, finely granular cytoplasm
Round, pale blue-gray to pink, sharply defined intracytoplasmic globular inclusions resembling Russell bodies
Inclusions vary in size and may indent or displace the nucleus
Inset (tissue section): cells containing bright eosinophilic round cytoplasmic globules
Panel B (electron micrograph): large round homogeneous intracytoplasmic inclusion surrounded by compressed cytoplasm
27498.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (A) shows blasts with high-to-moderate nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and basophilic cytoplasm, several of which contain one or more large, round, homogeneous pale blue to pink cytoplasmic globules resembling Russell bodies; the inset shows corresponding eosinophilic globules in a tissue section. Transmission electron microscopy (B) demonstrates a large, round, homogeneous intracytoplasmic inclusion. These inclusions are not specific for plasma cell differentiation. In the context of a Philadelphia chromosome-positive B-lymphoblastic leukemia, findings are consistent with B-ALL with Russell-like cytoplasmic inclusions; lineage assignment rests on flow cytometry (CD19, CD10, TdT) and BCR::ABL1 testing.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with Russell bodies (Mott cells)
ddx.vs: Mott cells are mature plasma cells with clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof that are CD138+/CD45-/TdT-, not TdT+ CD19+ blasts.
Pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules are MPO-positive azurophilic granules in myeloblasts, whereas these inclusions occur in MPO-negative B-lineage blasts.

ddx.dx: Metastatic signet-ring or rhabdoid tumor cells
ddx.vs: Signet-ring cells contain mucin vacuoles and rhabdoid cells contain intermediate filament whorls, and both are keratin-positive and CD45-negative.

18666.recognize_zh: 六格周邊血拼圖整理「骨髓系白血球增多」：可見嗜中性球增多、帶有早期顆粒球的左移、胞質灰藍且核折疊的單核球、成群大型深藍胞質細胞、形態異常的顆粒球，以及嗜酸性球與嗜鹼性球增多；判讀重點是辨認增多的是哪一種細胞與成熟度。
features: A: low-power smear with increased segmented neutrophils (neutrophilia)
B: left-shifted granulocytes including a myelocyte/metamyelocyte and band forms
C: monocytes with folded, irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, and abundant gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm
D: clusters of large cells with round nuclei and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm admixed with granulocytes
E: granulocytes with abnormal nuclear segmentation/hypogranularity and a smudged cell
F: eosinophil with orange granules and basophil with dark purple granules
18666.describe_en: This composite of peripheral blood smears illustrates categories of myeloid leukocytosis. Panels show mature neutrophilia at low power, a left shift with myelocytes and band forms, monocytosis with folded nuclei and vacuolated gray-blue cytoplasm, clusters of large cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, granulocytes with abnormal segmentation and granulation, and eosinophils and basophils. The approach is to identify the lineage and maturation stage that is expanded, look for dysplasia, blasts, and basophilia, and then separate reactive causes (infection, G-CSF, steroids) from myeloid neoplasms such as CML, CMML, or CNL. Panel labels are not provided in the image, so the exact clinical entity for each panel cannot be confirmed from the figure alone.

ddx.vs: CML shows a myelocyte and segmented neutrophil 'two-peak' left shift with basophilia and BCR-ABL1, while a leukemoid reaction has toxic granulation, Dohle bodies, and no basophilia.
CMML shows persistent monocytes of at least 1 x 10^9/L and 10% with dysgranulopoiesis, whereas reactive monocytosis lacks dysplasia and resolves with the underlying cause.

ddx.dx: Reactive eosinophilia versus myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia
ddx.vs: Clonal eosinophilia is supported by PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 rearrangements, dysplasia, or increased blasts rather than eosinophil morphology alone.

exam.answer_en: Myeloid leukocytosis composite — neutrophilia, left shift, monocytosis, dysplastic granulocytes, eosinophilia and basophilia; identify the expanded lineage
pearls_zh: 考法：拼圖中考官指任一格問「增加的是哪一系、反應性還是腫瘤性、下一步」；答題順序：辨認細胞系與成熟度 → 找 blasts、dysplasia、basophilia → 決定是否做 BCR::ABL1 或骨髓。
Leukemoid reaction vs CML：反應性有中毒性顆粒、Döhle bodies、成熟為主；CML 有 myelocyte 與 segmented neutrophil 雙峰、嗜鹼性球增多，確診靠 BCR::ABL1。
單核球增多：持續 ≥0.5×10^9/L 且佔白血球 ≥10% 需考慮 CMML（WHO 5th），須排除感染/發炎並做骨髓與 NGS（如 TET2、SRSF2、ASXL1）。
其他腫瘤性：CNL 與 CSF3R 突變（如 T618I）相關；嗜酸性球增多伴 PDGFRA、PDGFRB、FGFR1 等重排者為特定髓系/淋巴系腫瘤，PDGFRA/B 重排對 imatinib 有反應。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常見錯誤是把 G-CSF 或嚴重感染造成的左移（含 promyelocytes、中毒性顆粒）誤判為 CML；CML 特徵為嗜鹼性球增多與 myelocyte 高峰，中毒性變化少，需驗 BCR::ABL1。

quiz.q: 白血球明顯增多且可見各期顆粒球，哪一個周邊血形態線索最支持 CML 而非 leukemoid reaction？確診檢查為何？
quiz.a: 嗜鹼性球增多（及 myelocyte 高峰、缺乏中毒性變化）；BCR::ABL1（RT-PCR 或 FISH）。

18538.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中兩顆嗜中性球外緣各被一圈血小板環繞（platelet satellitism），左上角另一顆單核細胞邊緣也黏著少數血小板，背景游離血小板稀少，符合假性血小板低下。
features: Segmented neutrophils with platelets adherent circumferentially to the outer membrane
Adherent platelets are small, dark, and granular
A mononuclear cell (upper left) with a few platelets attached to its edge
Sparse free platelets in the background
Normal-appearing red cells without schistocytes
18538.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows segmented neutrophils encircled by adherent platelets, and a mononuclear cell with a few platelets attached to its border. Free platelets in the surrounding field are sparse, while the adherent platelets appear morphologically normal. Red cells show no schistocytes or other significant abnormalities. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism causing pseudothrombocytopenia; the platelet count should be verified on a citrate-anticoagulated sample or by smear estimate.

ddx.vs: Clumping produces free platelet aggregates, often at the feathered edge, rather than platelets rimming leukocyte membranes.
ITP shows genuinely few, often large platelets that do not adhere to neutrophils, and the count remains low in citrate.
TMA shows schistocytes with true thrombocytopenia, which are absent here.

exam.answer_en: Platelet satellitism causing pseudothrombocytopenia — platelets encircling neutrophils (and adhering to a mononuclear cell), no schistocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會問「血小板在哪裡？」要能指出黏附在中性球膜外（不是胞質內）的血小板環，並說明這會讓自動計數器低估血小板。
Satellitism 與 EDTA-induced platelet clumping 常同時出現，兩者都是 EDTA 依賴抗體造成的 in vitro 現象，檢查方式相同：citrate 管重抽或抹片估計。
抹片估計法：油鏡下每視野平均血小板數 ×（約 15–20）×10⁹/L 可粗估血小板數；判讀時要看羽狀邊緣（feathered edge）有無聚集。
此圖無 schistocytes，可排除 TMA；真正的 ITP 則是血小板少但常偏大，且不會黏附在白血球上。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把黏在細胞邊緣的血小板誤認為胞質內吞噬顆粒或中毒顆粒；satellite platelets 位於細胞膜外、與背景血小板形態相同，焦距上略有不同平面。

quiz.q: 此抹片的血小板實際上是真的減少嗎？請說明圖中證據。
quiz.a: 否，是假性血小板低下；血小板黏附環繞在中性球外緣（platelet satellitism），未被儀器計入

18282.recognize_zh: 這是示意圖（非形態學影像）：以分支樹狀圖呈現骨髓瘤由 MGUS、SMM、MM 進展到漿細胞白血病（PCL）的克隆演化，每一階段有新的「打擊」與次克隆競爭，下方以漿細胞數量與形態逐漸增多、變大、出現雙核來表示疾病進展。
features: Branching phylogenetic trees depicting subclones at MGUS, SMM, MM, and PCL stages
Lightning bolts indicating additional genetic hits driving each transition from a myeloma progenitor cell
Labels: clonal advantage (MGUS), competition and selective pressure (SMM), migration and founder effect (PCL)
Lower row of schematic plasma cells increasing in number and becoming larger, rounder, and binucleate with progression
Thresholds of <10% versus >10% marrow plasma cells and an arrow indicating onset of clinical symptoms
18282.describe_en: This non-morphologic schematic illustrates clonal evolution in plasma cell neoplasms. A myeloma progenitor cell acquires initiating lesions to form MGUS, and additional genetic hits generate branching subclones that compete under selective pressure through smoldering myeloma and symptomatic myeloma, culminating in plasma cell leukemia, where a subclone capable of independence from the marrow microenvironment expands through migration and a founder effect. The lower row depicts the corresponding increase in marrow plasma cell burden (<10% in MGUS, >10% in SMM and MM) and progressively more atypical plasma cell morphology. The key concept is intraclonal heterogeneity, which explains variable treatment response and relapse with different dominant clones.

15146.recognize_zh: 多張下肢臨床照片並加上標示：足踝色素沉著與靜脈性潰瘍、小腿細小擴張靜脈（venous ectasia）、足部水腫，以及足跟周圍皮膚硬化，這些是深部靜脈血栓後遺症「血栓後症候群（post-thrombotic syndrome）」的典型表現。
features: Hyperpigmentation of the medial ankle/lower leg with a shallow venous ulcer
Second example of an ulcer with surrounding erythema above the ankle
Venous ectasia: fine dilated reticular/telangiectatic veins on the calf
Pitting-type edema of the foot and ankle
Skin induration (lipodermatosclerosis) with venous ectasia around the heel
Labeled clinical photographs; no histology
15146.describe_en: Labeled composite of clinical photographs of the lower limbs illustrating post-thrombotic syndrome. The images show hyperpigmentation of the gaiter area with shallow venous ulcers, fine dilated superficial veins (venous ectasia) on the calf, edema of the foot and ankle, and indurated, scaly skin with venous ectasia around the heel consistent with lipodermatosclerosis. These signs reflect chronic venous hypertension from valvular damage and residual obstruction after deep vein thrombosis. They correspond to the objective components of clinical scoring systems such as the Villalta scale, which also incorporates symptoms such as pain, heaviness and cramps.

ddx.dx: Primary chronic venous insufficiency (without prior DVT)
ddx.vs: Skin changes are identical, so the distinction rests on a documented prior DVT and duplex ultrasound evidence of post-thrombotic venous obstruction or reflux.
Arterial ulcers are punched-out, painful, on toes or pressure points with absent pulses and low ankle-brachial index, rather than shallow gaiter-area ulcers with pigmentation and edema.
Recurrent DVT causes new acute painful swelling with a non-compressible vein on ultrasound, whereas PTS is chronic and its diagnosis should be deferred until 3-6 months after the acute event.
Lymphedema involves the dorsum of the foot and toes (Stemmer sign) with non-pitting swelling and lacks hemosiderin pigmentation and venous ulcers.

captions: Hyperpigmentation and venous ulcer; venous ectasia; edema; skin induration with venous ectasia

1706.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一群小型圓形藍色腫瘤細胞環狀排列，中央包圍一片淡紫色、無細胞核的纖維狀神經原纖維（neuropil），形成 Homer Wright 菊形團，是轉移性神經母細胞瘤的典型線索。
features: Small round tumor cells with high N:C ratio arranged in a ring
Central pale purple, anucleate fibrillary material (neuropil) forming a Homer Wright-type rosette
Round nuclei with fairly uniform, dense chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Nuclear molding and cohesive clustering of tumor cells
Refractile dark brown-black deposits and background stain artifact/debris
1706.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of small round blue tumor cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, dense chromatin and scant cytoplasm, arranged circumferentially around a central core of pale fibrillary anucleate material, forming a Homer Wright-type rosette. Additional similar tumor cells are dispersed in the background, and there is staining artifact with refractile pigment-like deposits. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma involving the marrow.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are dispersed singly without cohesion, molding or fibrillary neuropil; they are CD45 and TdT positive.
Ewing cells have scant vacuolated (glycogen-rich) cytoplasm, lack neuropil, and are CD99/NKX2.2 positive with EWSR1 rearrangement.
Rhabdomyosarcoma cells often have vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm and are desmin/myogenin positive rather than PHOX2B/synaptophysin positive.
A megakaryocyte has its own lobulated nucleus and granular cytoplasm, whereas the rosette center is anucleate fibrillary neuropil.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic neuroblastoma in bone marrow — small round blue tumor cells forming a Homer Wright rosette around fibrillary neuropil
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指腫瘤細胞中央淡紫色無核纖維狀物質，問名稱（neuropil）與這種排列（Homer Wright rosette），並問病人年齡層與最可能原發腫瘤。
IHC/標記：PHOX2B、synaptophysin、chromogranin、CD56 陽性，CD45−、CD99 通常陰性（與 Ewing sarcoma 區分）、TdT−（與 lymphoblast 區分）。
臨床關聯：多為 <5 歲幼兒；尿中 VMA/HVA 升高、MIBG scan 評估轉移；骨髓侵犯屬遠處轉移（INRG stage M），需雙側骨髓抽吸/切片分期。
預後分子：MYCN amplification 為重要不良預後因子並納入風險分組；其他如 11q 缺失、DNA ploidy 也用於風險分層。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 ALL 的 lymphoblast：lymphoblast 分散不黏聚、不形成 rosette、TdT+；neuroblastoma 細胞成團、核互相擠壓、中央有 neuropil，且 CD45−。

quiz.q: 圖中腫瘤細胞環繞的淡紫色纖維狀物質叫什麼？這種排列稱為什麼？
quiz.a: Neuropil（神經原纖維）；Homer Wright rosette（轉移性 neuroblastoma）。

2026.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有數個大型組織球，胞質豐富淡藍色、呈細纖維狀條紋，像「揉皺的衛生紙（wrinkled tissue paper）」，細胞核小而偏位，這是 Gaucher 細胞的典型外觀。
features: Large histiocytes, several times the size of surrounding cells, forming a loose cluster
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm with fine fibrillary, striated 'crumpled tissue paper' texture
Small, round to oval, eccentrically placed nuclei with coarse chromatin
No discrete vacuoles or foamy bubbly cytoplasm
Admixed small lymphocytes, plasma cell-like cells and myeloid precursors in the background
