2026.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large macrophages with abundant pale blue, fibrillary cytoplasm imparting a wrinkled tissue-paper appearance, and small eccentric nuclei. The cytoplasm lacks the discrete vacuoles of foamy histiocytes. Background hematopoietic and lymphoid cells are unremarkable in this field. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells; confirmation by leukocyte glucocerebrosidase activity and GBA1 genotyping is recommended.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar striated histiocytes arising from high cell turnover; distinguished by the underlying disorder and normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Cytoplasm is finely vacuolated and bubbly ('mulberry') rather than fibrillary and striated.
Striated cytoplasm contains negative-image rods and is acid-fast positive.

exam.answer_en: Gaucher cells in marrow aspirate — large histiocytes with abundant pale blue striated 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei
pearls_zh: 考法：抹片題，考官指淡藍色條紋胞質的大細胞，要求用經典描述（wrinkled tissue paper / crumpled silk）說出名稱，並問缺乏的酵素。
Gaucher disease：GBA1 雙對偶基因致病變異（體染色體隱性）導致 glucocerebrosidase 缺乏；確診靠白血球酵素活性＋基因檢測，不能只靠骨髓形態。
治療：type 1 可用酵素替代療法（imiglucerase、velaglucerase alfa、taliglucerase alfa）或受質減量療法（eliglustat、miglustat）；追蹤可用 lyso-Gb1、chitotriosidase。
臨床關聯：脾腫大、血小板低下、骨痛/bone crisis、股骨 Erlenmeyer flask 變形；Gaucher 病人 MGUS/multiple myeloma 與 Parkinson disease 風險增加。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 sea-blue histiocytes 或 Niemann-Pick cells：sea-blue histiocyte 含藍色顆粒、Niemann-Pick cell 為均勻小泡狀泡沫胞質；Gaucher cell 為纖維條紋狀皺紙樣胞質。

quiz.q: 圖中胞質呈揉皺衛生紙樣的大細胞叫什麼？其缺乏的酵素與致病基因為何？
quiz.a: Gaucher cell；glucocerebrosidase（acid β-glucosidase），GBA1。

2922.recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的骨髓切片中有一群核較大、卵圓或不規則、染色質淡而帶小核仁、細胞質中等淡色的腫瘤細胞，右側則是深色小圓核的造血細胞；這些細胞較未分化神經母細胞大，可能代表正在分化的神經母細胞，但未見成熟節細胞。
features: Paratrabecular population of intermediate to large cells with oval to irregular nuclei
Vesicular chromatin with small but visible nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm
Occasional larger cells approaching early ganglionic features, without the abundant cytoplasm of mature ganglion cells
Adjacent residual hematopoiesis on the right, including erythroid precursors with small dense round nuclei
Pale fibrillary stroma between tumor cells
2922.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows, adjacent to a bony trabecula, a population of intermediate to large cells with oval to irregular nuclei, vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli, and moderate amounts of pale cytoplasm within pale fibrillary stroma. On the right, residual hematopoietic cells including erythroid precursors with small dense nuclei are present. The tumor cells are larger than undifferentiated neuroblasts, suggesting differentiating neuroblasts, but mature ganglion cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent single nucleoli are not clearly identified in this field. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma with features of neuroblastic differentiation after therapy.

ddx.vs: Regenerating precursors show a spectrum of granulocytic maturation with eosinophilic granules and are MPO positive rather than synaptophysin/PHOX2B positive.
Carcinoma forms cohesive glands or nests with keratin positivity and lacks fibrillary neuropil.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma or Hodgkin lymphoma
ddx.vs: These contain large atypical CD30-positive cells with mixed inflammatory background and no neuropil.

1194.recognize_zh: 高倍胸水抹片中，大型細胞具不規則或腎形/分葉狀核、細緻染色質與明顯核仁，灰藍色細胞質含多個小空泡，旁邊的小淋巴球大小約只有它們的三分之一，符合大型 B 細胞淋巴瘤細胞。
features: Large lymphoid cells about 3 times the diameter of adjacent small lymphocytes
Irregular, indented, folded or multilobated nuclei
Fine to vesicular chromatin with one or more distinct nucleoli
Moderate grey-blue cytoplasm containing numerous small clear vacuoles and cytoplasmic blebs
Background small lymphocytes and crenated red cells
1194.describe_en: Pleural fluid cytospin at high power shows discohesive large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, indented to multilobated nuclei, vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli. The cytoplasm is moderate, grey-blue and contains multiple small vacuoles. Scattered small mature lymphocytes are present for comparison, and no cohesive epithelial groups are seen. Findings are consistent with a large B-cell lymphoma involving the pleural fluid, pending immunophenotypic confirmation.

ddx.vs: Macrophages have lower N:C ratio, abundant foamy cytoplasm with phagocytosed material and bland nuclei without prominent nucleoli; CD163/CD68 versus CD20 separates them.
PEL is HHV8-positive and usually lacks CD20 and surface immunoglobulin, often in immunocompromised patients.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized and uniform with round nuclei, multiple small nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, not large pleomorphic lobated nuclei.
Mesothelial cells show central round nuclei, dense two-toned cytoplasm and intercellular windows, and are calretinin/keratin-positive.

1258.recognize_zh: H&E 切片中有一群細胞的細胞質內含大量粗細不一的棕色色素顆粒，部分遮蓋細胞核，周圍是小淋巴球、漿細胞與具淡染核、細胞質豐富的上皮樣大細胞；在骨髓轉移的背景下，棕色色素支持黑色素，但需與含鐵血黃素鑑別。
features: Cluster of large cells with abundant coarse and fine brown granular cytoplasmic pigment, partly obscuring nuclei
Scattered single pigment-laden cells elsewhere in the field
Admixed larger epithelioid cells with oval vesicular nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Background of many small lymphocytes and plasma cells
Occasional small vessels with red cells; no normal fat or hematopoietic lineage architecture clearly visible in this field
1258.describe_en: Section shows a cellular infiltrate containing a cluster of large cells with abundant coarse brown granular cytoplasmic pigment, along with scattered epithelioid cells with oval vesicular nuclei in a background of small lymphocytes and plasma cells. Many pigmented cells may represent melanophages rather than tumor cells, and the pigment cannot be distinguished from hemosiderin on H&E alone. Special stains (Fontana-Masson, Prussian blue) and melanocytic immunostains (SOX10, S100, Melan-A, HMB45) are needed for confirmation. In the clinical context, findings are suggestive of metastatic melanoma involving the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Hemosiderin is golden-brown, refractile and Prussian blue-positive, whereas melanin is finer, dark brown and Fontana-Masson-positive, and background tumor cells are SOX10-positive.
Formalin pigment is extracellular, birefringent, uniformly fine black-brown and unrelated to cells, unlike this intracytoplasmic pigment.
Carcinoma cells are cohesive, keratin-positive and non-pigmented.
Histiocytic proliferations are CD163/CD68-positive and SOX10/S100-negative apart from pigment phagocytosis.

1322.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結切片可見多個具淡色生發中心的反應性濾泡，濾泡間區有一大片鮮紅色、以嗜酸性白血球為主的浸潤區（eosinophilic infiltrate/microabscess），被膜仍完整，符合木村病淋巴結病變（Kimura lymphadenopathy）。
features: Lymph node with intact capsule and preserved overall architecture
Multiple reactive follicles with pale, well-formed germinal centers
Large bright eosinophilic (red-pink) zone in the interfollicular/paracortical area, consistent with a dense eosinophil infiltrate or eosinophilic microabscess
Eosinophil infiltrate abuts and extends toward follicles
Mild fibrosis and vascular channels in the interfollicular region
1322.describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows preserved architecture with an intact capsule and multiple reactive follicles with well-formed germinal centers. The interfollicular region contains a large, sharply eosinophilic area consistent with a dense eosinophil infiltrate forming an eosinophilic microabscess, adjacent to the follicles. Individual cell detail, including germinal center vascularization or polykaryocytes, cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with Kimura lymphadenopathy in the appropriate clinical setting (head and neck mass, peripheral eosinophilia, elevated IgE).

ddx.vs: ALHE is primarily a dermal/subcutaneous vascular lesion with epithelioid (histiocytoid) endothelial cells, not a lymph node with florid follicles and eosinophilic abscesses.
cHL shows effacement with Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+/CD15+) in a mixed background, whereas this node has preserved reactive follicles.
These can show eosinophilia but lack the combination of florid follicular hyperplasia, IgE deposits in germinal centers and eosinophilic microabscesses; clinical history is key.
LCH has sinusoidal Langerhans cells with grooved nuclei (CD1a/langerin+) accompanying the eosinophils.

exam.answer_en: Kimura lymphadenopathy — reactive follicles with a large interfollicular eosinophil-rich infiltrate (eosinophilic microabscess), architecture preserved
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍下考官會先確認淋巴結架構保留（被膜完整、濾泡反應性），再指濾泡間鮮紅色區域問「這是什麼、想到哪個病？」
木村病常見臨床組合：亞洲年輕男性、頭頸部無痛性皮下腫塊、周邊血 eosinophilia 與血清 IgE 明顯上升；良性但易復發。
生發中心內可見 IgE 沉積（IgE IHC 呈網狀陽性於 FDC 上）、血管化及 polykaryocytes，是支持診斷的輔助特徵。
須篩檢腎臟：木村病可合併 nephrotic syndrome，驗尿蛋白是常考連結。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 classic Hodgkin lymphoma（背景也富含嗜酸性白血球）；cHL 會破壞淋巴結架構並有 CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg 細胞，木村病架構保留且無 RS 細胞。

quiz.q: 低倍淋巴結架構保留，濾泡間出現大片嗜酸性白血球聚集，病人為頭頸部腫塊的年輕亞洲男性，最可能診斷為何？需篩檢哪個器官的併發症？
quiz.a: Kimura disease；腎臟（nephrotic syndrome，驗尿蛋白）

1130.recognize_zh: 周邊血中散佈中至大型、細胞質淡灰藍色且無顆粒的芽細胞，核圓或不規則、染色質細緻，看不到 Auer 小體；背景可見淚滴狀紅血球，形態上無法判定系別。
features: Medium to large blasts with moderate to scant pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm
Round to irregular nuclei with fine chromatin; nucleoli faintly visible
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Occasional teardrop red cells (dacrocytes) in the background
One refractile yellow-brown round body of uncertain nature, likely artifact
1130.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered medium to large blasts with pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm and round to irregular nuclei with fine chromatin. Auer rods are not identified. Background red cells include occasional teardrop forms, and a refractile yellow-brown round body in the upper left is most likely artifact. Findings are consistent with circulating blasts of acute leukemia without morphologic evidence of lineage; in the context of AML with minimal differentiation, lineage must be confirmed by flow cytometry with negative MPO cytochemistry.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts look similar and require flow cytometry showing B- or T-lineage markers for distinction.
Megakaryoblasts often show cytoplasmic blebs and are CD41/CD61 positive, often with marrow fibrosis.
Monoblasts have more abundant cytoplasm and strong nonspecific esterase with CD14/CD64 expression.

4202.recognize_zh: 脾臟低倍免疫染色，陽性訊號密集集中在數個白髓濾泡，紅髓內只有零星陽性細胞，呈現B細胞標記的分布模式；抗體名稱未標示，需對照同案H&E與其他染色解讀。
features: Low-power splenic section with dense positive staining localized to rounded white pulp follicles
Scattered individual positive cells in the expanded red pulp
Large areas of red pulp largely negative, suggesting the infiltrate is composed of another population
Central arterioles visible within positive follicles
Chromogen appears dark purple; specific antibody not labeled
4202.describe_en: Immunostained section of spleen at low power shows strong positivity concentrated in the white pulp follicles, with only scattered positive cells in the red pulp. The pattern suggests a B-cell marker (e.g., CD20) highlighting preserved follicles, while the expanded red pulp infiltrate is largely negative. The specific antibody is not stated, so interpretation is limited. In the context of ruptured spleen from infectious mononucleosis, this pattern would support a polymorphous, predominantly non-B red pulp expansion rather than a diffuse B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving spleen
ddx.vs: DLBCL shows sheets or nodules of large B-cells diffusely positive for CD20, not staining confined to preserved follicles.
SMZL shows expanded CD20-positive nodules with marginal zone hyperplasia and intrasinusoidal B-cell infiltration of the red pulp.

4074.recognize_zh: 這是眼眶層級的軸切面增強 MRI（T1 加對比），箭頭指向左側眼眶尖端/視神經周圍區域的軟組織增厚與異常增強，符合急性淋巴性白血病髓外復發的影像表現；此為影像非形態學圖片。
features: Axial contrast-enhanced T1-weighted MRI at the level of the orbits and temporal lobes
Arrow indicates abnormal enhancing soft tissue at the left orbital apex/retro-orbital region near the optic nerve
Asymmetric thickening of left retro-orbital soft tissues compared with the right
Globes, sinuses, brainstem and cerebellum without obvious mass at this level
Single slice limits assessment of extent, cavernous sinus and meningeal involvement
4074.describe_en: Axial post-contrast T1-weighted MRI through the orbits demonstrates asymmetric abnormal enhancing soft tissue at the left orbital apex and retro-orbital region (arrow), compared with the unremarkable right side. The globes, paranasal sinuses, and posterior fossa structures appear grossly unremarkable on this single slice. In a patient with a history of acute lymphoblastic leukemia, this finding is suggestive of extramedullary relapse involving the orbit or optic nerve sheath. Tissue or CSF confirmation with flow cytometry is required, since imaging cannot distinguish leukemic infiltration from infection or inflammation.

ddx.dx: Orbital infection (e.g., invasive fungal sinusitis/orbital cellulitis)
ddx.vs: Often shows adjacent sinus disease and bone erosion with necrotic nonenhancing tissue, and requires biopsy and culture to separate from leukemic infiltration.
Imaging overlaps, so tissue biopsy showing polymorphous inflammation without blasts is needed.

ddx.dx: Myeloid sarcoma or other lymphoma of the orbit
ddx.vs: Radiologically indistinguishable, requiring biopsy with immunophenotyping (TdT/CD19 vs MPO/CD117).

4010.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中脂肪細胞之間的造血空間被成片、單一形態的中型母細胞填滿，核圓、染色質細緻並有小核仁，細胞質極少，正常紅血球系與巨核細胞僅零星殘存；此單調母細胞浸潤符合前驅 B 細胞急性淋巴母細胞白血病復發。
features: Interstitial spaces between adipocytes packed by sheets of monotonous blasts
Medium-sized cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Scant cytoplasm with high N:C ratio
Few residual erythroid precursors and rare megakaryocytes
Adipocytes still present, so overall cellularity reflects both fat and diffuse blast infiltration
4010.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows the hematopoietic spaces between adipocytes diffusely filled by a monotonous population of medium-sized blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is markedly diminished, with only scattered erythroid precursors and rare megakaryocytes. Findings are consistent with diffuse marrow involvement by acute leukemia; in a patient with prior precursor B-ALL, this represents relapsed B-lymphoblastic leukemia, to be confirmed by immunohistochemistry (TdT, CD34, CD19/PAX5, CD10) or flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: AML blasts may show more cytoplasm and residual granulocytic maturation; lineage requires MPO versus PAX5/TdT immunostaining.

ddx.dx: Hematogone hyperplasia in a regenerating marrow
ddx.vs: Hematogones are interstitial and scattered rather than confluent sheets, and show an orderly maturation pattern with scattered CD20 and TdT positivity.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell or Burkitt lymphoma involving marrow
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are usually larger or show a starry-sky pattern and are TdT and CD34 negative with a mature B-cell phenotype.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Small round cell tumors form nests with desmoplasia and are CD45 and TdT negative.

3946.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中可見顆粒稀少、細胞核呈雙葉摺疊狀的異常早幼粒細胞，旁邊還有一顆細胞質充滿深紫顆粒、隱約有 Auer 小體的細胞，提示急性前骨髓細胞白血病微顆粒型。
features: Abnormal promyelocyte with bilobed, folded nucleus and finely granular grey-violet cytoplasm
Larger cell with densely granular purple cytoplasm partially obscuring the nucleus and suggestion of rod-like inclusions
Smaller atypical cell with irregular nucleus and sparse granules
Low leukocyte density in this field
Background red cells without obvious schistocytes; platelets sparse
3946.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered abnormal myeloid cells. One cell has a bilobed, folded nucleus with fine chromatin and hypogranular cytoplasm, and an adjacent larger cell has densely granular cytoplasm overlying the nucleus with suspected rod-like inclusions. Another smaller cell shows an irregular nucleus and sparse granules. Platelets appear reduced. Findings are suggestive of acute promyelocytic leukemia, microgranular variant, and warrant urgent PML::RARA testing and coagulation assessment.

ddx.vs: Promonocytes have folded nuclei but grey-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles and no Auer rod bundles, and are NSE positive with weak or absent MPO.
Dysplastic neutrophils are mature segmented or pseudo-Pelger cells with clumped chromatin, not large cells with fine chromatin and Auer rods.
Reactive promyelocytes have round eccentric nuclei with a Golgi hof and occur with a full maturation spectrum, without bilobed nuclei or Auer rods.

3882.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩顆中型淋巴球，細胞質深藍、無顆粒且有細胞質突起（cytoplasmic bleb），細胞核略不規則並可見小核仁，是 T 細胞前淋巴球性白血病（T-PLL）的典型細胞外觀。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells larger than normal small lymphocytes
Intensely basophilic agranular cytoplasm with a cytoplasmic protrusion (bleb)
Oval to slightly irregular nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin
Small but visible nucleolus in the larger cell
Background red cells with echinocytes (likely artifactual crenation)
3882.describe_en: High-power view of the peripheral blood shows two medium-sized lymphoid cells with moderately condensed chromatin, slightly irregular oval nuclei and a small visible nucleolus in the larger cell. The cytoplasm is deeply basophilic, agranular and shows a characteristic cytoplasmic protrusion. The background red cells show crenation. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia; flow cytometry (CD7 bright, CD4/CD8 pattern) and TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: B-prolymphocytes have a more prominent central nucleolus and paler cytoplasm without blebs, and express B-cell markers rather than T-cell markers.
Sézary cells have cerebriform, grooved nuclei without nucleoli and usually CD7 negative, whereas T-PLL cells are CD7 bright with basophilic blebbed cytoplasm.
ATLL shows polylobated 'flower' nuclei, CD25 positivity and HTLV-1 serology.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm scalloping around red cells, not a monotonous population of blebbed basophilic cells.

exam.answer_en: T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia — medium lymphoid cells with deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm, cytoplasmic blebs and small visible nucleoli
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍指深藍細胞質有 bleb、可見小核仁的淋巴樣細胞，答 T-PLL；並能說出與 Sézary cell、ATLL flower cell 的區分。
遺傳：inv(14)(q11.2q32) 或 t(14;14) 造成 TCL1A 活化，t(X;14) 活化 MTCP1；常合併 ATM 失活，ataxia-telangiectasia 病人風險增加。
Flow：CD2+、CD3+、CD5+、CD7 強陽性（與 Sézary 常 CD7 丟失相反）；CD4+CD8− 最多，CD4+CD8+ 共表現是其特色。IHC TCL1 陽性。
臨床：白血球常極高、脾腫大、皮膚浸潤與漿膜積液，病程侵襲。
細胞高表現 CD52，alemtuzumab 是經典誘導治療，達緩解後考慮 allogeneic HSCT。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 B-PLL／CLL 前淋巴球轉化；後者細胞質較淡、有單一明顯中央核仁且無 bleb，flow 為 B 細胞標記，T-PLL 則為 T 細胞表型並有 TCL1 重排。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞質深藍帶 bleb 的淋巴樣細胞，若為 T-PLL，最具特徵的染色體異常與治療靶點抗原為何？
quiz.a: inv(14)(q11.2q32)/t(14;14) 活化 TCL1A；CD52（alemtuzumab）

3626.recognize_zh: 頭顱側面 X 光片中顱骨整片散布多個圓形、邊緣銳利的溶骨性透亮區，呈典型「打孔狀」（punched-out）病灶，提示漿細胞腫瘤的骨骼侵犯。
features: Lateral skull radiograph
Multiple round, sharply demarcated lucent lesions scattered throughout the calvarium
Lesions of variable size without surrounding sclerosis ('punched-out')
Skull base and facial bones without obvious large destructive lesions
3626.describe_en: Lateral skull radiograph shows multiple round, sharply circumscribed lytic lesions of variable size throughout the calvarium, without sclerotic margins, producing a 'raindrop' or punched-out appearance. This is a radiologic image and does not provide cellular detail. The pattern is characteristic of plasma cell neoplasm involving bone; correlation with serum/urine protein studies and tissue biopsy of any associated soft tissue mass (extramedullary extension) is required.

ddx.vs: Metastases tend to be fewer and more irregular with less uniform size, and biopsy shows non-hematopoietic carcinoma cells.
LCH produces fewer, larger geographic lesions with beveled edges, typically in children, and is CD1a/langerin positive on biopsy.
Hyperparathyroid bone disease shows diffuse fine 'salt-and-pepper' mottling rather than discrete round punched-out lesions.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell neoplasm involving bone — multiple punched-out lytic lesions of the skull ('raindrop skull') on lateral radiograph
pearls_zh: 這是影像題：考官會問「頭顱 X 光多發打孔狀溶骨病灶」代表什麼，答 plasma cell myeloma 的骨侵犯；接著會追問要做 SPEP/immunofixation、serum free light chain 與骨髓檢查。
Myeloma 溶骨病灶是純 osteoclast 活化、osteoblast 受抑制，所以 bone scan 常為陰性、ALP 多正常；評估骨病灶應用 whole-body low-dose CT、PET-CT 或 MRI，而非 bone scan。
骨病灶屬 CRAB 的 B：CT/PET-CT/骨骼攝影上 ≥1 個溶骨病灶（≥5 mm）即為 myeloma-defining event；MRI 上 >1 個 focal lesion 則屬 SLiM 標準。
題目標題為 extramedullary plasmacytoma：要分清 solitary plasmacytoma of bone、由骨頭延伸出去的 paraskeletal 病灶，與真正血行散佈的 extramedullary 病灶；後者預後較差。
臨床連結：溶骨病灶合併高血鈣、病理性骨折風險，治療除抗 myeloma 外應加 bisphosphonate 或 denosumab 並注意顎骨壞死。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為轉移性癌的溶骨病灶或副甲狀腺機能亢進；myeloma 病灶多、大小一致、邊緣銳利無硬化，副甲狀腺亢進則是瀰漫 salt-and-pepper 斑駁而非分離圓洞。

quiz.q: 這張頭顱側面 X 光的多發圓形透亮病灶，為何做 bone scan 常看不到？
quiz.a: Myeloma 病灶為純溶骨性，osteoblast 活性受抑制，tracer 不聚積

3562.recognize_zh: 低倍下可見幾顆淋巴球大小的細胞，核分成數個葉、像苜蓿葉或花瓣（flower-like），染色質深、細胞質少且無顆粒；在 HTLV-1 背景下提示成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤。不過放大倍率低，和分葉中性球不容易分辨，需要高倍或流式確認。
features: Small-to-medium cells with lobulated, clover-leaf/flower-like nuclei
Dense, dark chromatin
Scant pale cytoplasm without obvious neutrophilic granules
Low absolute number of atypical cells in this field, in keeping with a smoldering picture
Normochromic, normocytic RBCs; normal platelets
Low magnification limits distinction from segmented neutrophils
3562.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows a few small-to-medium lymphoid cells with lobulated, flower-like nuclei, dense chromatin, and scant, agranular cytoplasm. Only occasional atypical cells are present, and the red cells and platelets are unremarkable. At this magnification the cells cannot be reliably separated from segmented neutrophils, so high-power review and flow cytometry are needed. With HTLV-1 seropositivity, findings are consistent with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, smoldering type.

ddx.vs: Neutrophils have lobes joined by thin filaments and pink granular cytoplasm, whereas flower cells have agranular basophilic cytoplasm and CD4+/CD25+ T-cell immunophenotype.
Sézary cells have finely grooved cerebriform nuclei rather than deep petal-like lobation, and patients are HTLV-1 negative.
CLL cells have round nuclei with soccer-ball chromatin and are CD5+/CD23+ B cells.
Smoldering ATLL requires at least 5% abnormal T lymphocytes in blood, and clonal HTLV-1 integration confirms neoplasia.

3690.recognize_zh: 皮膚近照可見密布、針尖大小（<2–3 mm）、平坦不隆起的紅紫色斑點，大小相近，部分區域融合成小片瘀斑（ecchymosis）；這種平坦的點狀出血是血小板數量或功能問題造成的典型皮膚表現。
features: Innumerable pinpoint (1-3 mm) flat red-to-purple macules distributed diffusely over the skin
Lesions are non-palpable in appearance and fairly uniform in size
Few slightly larger coalescent purpuric spots and faint ecchymoses
No vesicles, ulceration, or raised palpable purpura visible
3690.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the skin of an extremity shows innumerable pinpoint, flat, red-to-violaceous macules distributed diffusely, with occasional slightly larger coalescent purpuric lesions and faint ecchymoses. The lesions appear non-palpable and without ulceration or vesiculation. These findings are consistent with petechiae, which typically indicate a primary hemostatic defect such as severe thrombocytopenia or platelet dysfunction, and warrant a CBC with peripheral smear review.

ddx.vs: Vasculitic lesions are raised and palpable, often larger, and occur with a normal platelet count.
Angiomas are dome-shaped, bright red papules that blanch partially and are stable over time.
Presents as larger flat ecchymoses on sun-damaged forearms rather than diffuse pinpoint petechiae.
Petechiae are perifollicular with corkscrew hairs and gum hemorrhage, with a normal platelet count.

exam.answer_en: Petechiae — innumerable flat, non-palpable pinpoint red-purple macules indicating a primary hemostatic (platelet) defect
pearls_zh: 考法：臨床照片考官問「這是什麼皮膚病灶、要做什麼檢查」；答 petechiae，代表血小板數量或功能異常，第一步 CBC 加周邊抹片。
大小分級：petechiae 為針尖大小、purpura 較大、ecchymosis 為更大片瘀斑；皆為壓之不褪色（non-blanching）。
先以抹片排除 EDTA 誘發的假性血小板低下（血小板凝集）；再依抹片找 schistocytes、芽細胞等線索判斷 TTP、白血病等。
伴發燒與快速擴散的瘀點要警覺 meningococcemia 或 DIC，屬急症。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 vasculitis 的 palpable purpura 混淆；petechiae 平坦摸不到、源於血小板問題，palpable purpura 可觸及隆起、源於血管發炎，血小板數通常正常。

quiz.q: 照片中平坦、針尖大小、壓不褪色的紅紫色斑點叫什麼？提示哪一類止血缺陷？
quiz.a: Petechiae；primary hemostasis 缺陷（血小板低下或血小板功能異常）。

3370.recognize_zh: 高倍免疫染色下，許多大型細胞的豐富細胞質呈粗顆粒狀棕色陽性，核小而偏位（藍色），周圍小型造血細胞為陰性，這種顆粒狀細胞質染色是組織球標記（多為 CD68）的特徵，支持骨髓組織球增多。
features: Large cells with abundant cytoplasm showing coarse granular brown cytoplasmic positivity
Positive cells have small round-to-oval nuclei, some eccentric, and ill-defined borders
Some positive cells have a vacuolated or foamy cytoplasm with a peripheral rim of staining
Background small hematopoietic cells with negative hematoxylin-stained nuclei
Antibody not labeled; granular lysosomal pattern is typical of CD68
3370.describe_en: High-power immunohistochemical stain of bone marrow shows numerous large cells with abundant cytoplasm displaying coarse granular brown positivity, small eccentric nuclei and focally vacuolated cytoplasm, while surrounding hematopoietic cells are negative. The antibody is not labeled in the image; the granular lysosomal pattern is most consistent with CD68 (or CD163). Findings highlight a marked increase in marrow histiocytes, consistent with marrow histiocytosis; correlation with morphology to assess for storage material or hemophagocytosis is recommended.

ddx.vs: HLH histiocytes contain engulfed hematopoietic cells, best confirmed on aspirate or CD163 with clinical HLH criteria.
Storage histiocytes share CD68 positivity but are identified by characteristic cytoplasmic morphology and enzyme testing.
Mast cells may show granular cytoplasm but are tryptase/CD117 positive and form spindle-cell aggregates.
Megakaryocytes have large lobulated nuclei and are CD61/CD42b positive, unlike histiocytes with small eccentric nuclei.

3306.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的細胞是顆粒球前驅細胞，細胞質灰藍帶細顆粒，細胞核中央有一個清楚的圓形空洞，使核呈甜甜圈狀的環形核（ring nucleus）；這種環形核在大小鼠顆粒球中是常態，因此俗稱「rodent cell」，在人類骨髓屬於反應性或發育異常變化。
features: Intermediate to large granulocytic precursor (arrow) with moderate grey-blue cytoplasm
Fine azurophilic/neutrophilic granules in the cytoplasm
Nucleus with a central round clear hole forming a ring (doughnut) shape
Coarsely granular chromatin without a visible nucleolus
Adjacent larger myelocyte-like cell and a segmented neutrophil
Background with scattered platelets and granular debris
3306.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a granulocytic precursor (arrow) with moderate grey-blue finely granular cytoplasm and a nucleus containing a central round clear space, producing a ring or doughnut-shaped nucleus with coarsely granular chromatin. A larger myelocyte-like cell and a segmented neutrophil are adjacent. Ring-shaped nuclei are normal in rodent granulocytes, hence the term rodent cell. In human marrow, ring-form granulocytes are a nonspecific finding reported in reactive states, growth factor exposure, alcohol use and myeloid neoplasms, and should be interpreted with the overall marrow findings.

ddx.vs: An overlying object sits in a different focal plane and does not have a crisp nuclear membrane lining the hole, unlike a true ring nucleus.

ddx.dx: Dysplastic granulocyte in MDS or CML
ddx.vs: Ring nuclei are more significant when accompanied by other dysplastic features such as hypogranulation, pseudo-Pelger forms or blasts.
Intranuclear inclusions contain cytoplasmic-staining material within the hole rather than an empty clear center.
Giant metamyelocytes are enlarged with open chromatin and horseshoe-shaped nuclei, not a punched-out central hole.

3178.recognize_zh: 單一大型淋巴細胞的核由中央向外放射出多個深凹的花瓣狀分葉，染色質粗而濃縮，外圍為深藍色嗜鹼性細胞質，是 ATLL 典型的 flower cell（花瓣細胞）。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cell, roughly twice the diameter of adjacent red cells
Nucleus with multiple deep radial clefts producing petal-like lobes (flower cell)
Coarse, condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Normal-appearing red cells and small platelet clumps in background
3178.describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a large atypical lymphoid cell with a nucleus divided by multiple deep radial clefts into petal-like lobes, coarse chromatin and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm. Surrounding red cells and platelets are unremarkable. This polylobated flower-like nuclear configuration is the classic cytologic hallmark of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma. Findings are consistent with ATLL; confirmation by HTLV-1 serology and a CD4+ CD25+ CD7- T-cell phenotype is recommended.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells have cerebriform nuclei with fine grooves rather than deep radial petal-like lobes and lack HTLV-1.
Hypogranular APL cells have bilobed butterfly nuclei with fine chromatin, faint granules and strong MPO positivity.
Promonocytes have delicately folded nuclei with fine chromatin, gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and are nonspecific esterase+.
Pleomorphic MCL cells have irregular but not petal-like nuclei and are CD5+ CD20+ cyclin D1+ B cells.

exam.answer_en: Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma — classic flower cell with deep radial petal-like nuclear lobes and basophilic cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：單一細胞高倍圖，直接問「此細胞名稱與診斷」；答 flower cell、ATLL，並補 HTLV-1 與 CD4+ CD25+ CD7− 表型。
流行病學：HTLV-1 帶原者終生 ATLL 發生率低（約數個百分比），潛伏期長達數十年，發病多在成人。
Acute 型高鈣血症機轉與腫瘤細胞分泌 PTHrP 及 RANKL 導致骨吸收有關。
HTLV-1 另一相關疾病：HAM/TSP（HTLV-1 associated myelopathy/tropical spastic paraparesis）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 hypogranular APL 的雙葉核細胞；APL 染色質細緻、MPO 強陽性，ATLL 染色質濃縮、無顆粒且為 T 細胞表型。

quiz.q: 這顆核呈放射狀花瓣分葉的淋巴細胞叫什麼？典型免疫表型為何？
quiz.a: Flower cell（ATLL）；CD4+ CD25+ CD7−

3114.recognize_zh: 數顆單核球系細胞核呈摺疊、分葉或腎形，胞質灰藍，右上一顆較大且染色質細緻（promonocyte樣），並有一個破碎細胞；背景紅血球內可見小點狀包涵體，符合CMML。
features: Several monocytic cells with folded, lobulated, or reniform nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm
Larger cell at upper right with fine chromatin and oval nucleus (promonocyte-like)
Smudged/disrupted cell at right
Small round cell with dense nucleus and gray cytoplasm at upper left (nucleated red cell versus lymphocyte)
Several red cells with small dark inclusions; one red cell with coarse punctate granules at lower right
3114.describe_en: The smear shows multiple monocytic cells with folded to lobulated nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm, including a larger promonocyte-like cell with finer chromatin. A disrupted cell and a small cell with a dense round nucleus are also present. Several red cells contain small dark inclusions, and one shows coarse punctate granules. Findings are consistent with atypical monocytosis of chronic myelomonocytic leukemia; an iron stain would clarify whether the red cell inclusions are siderotic.

ddx.vs: Acute monocytic leukemia has at least 20% monoblasts plus promonocytes with round nuclei, fine chromatin, and prominent nucleoli.
Reactive monocytosis lacks immature monocytes and dysplastic features in other lineages.

ddx.dx: MDS/MPN with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: This entity shows thrombocytosis and ring sideroblasts with SF3B1 mutation rather than sustained monocytosis.

3050.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中數個小型淋巴球核深染、形狀不規則並有裂溝，旁邊可見一個核較圓、細胞質較多的淋巴球作對照，整體為小型成熟淋巴球增多，符合百日咳。
features: Several small lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm scattered among normal RBCs
Hyperchromatic nuclei with irregular, notched or clefted contours
Condensed mature chromatin without nucleoli
One lymphocyte with a rounder nucleus and a rim of deeper blue cytoplasm for comparison
Neutrophil at the field edge; RBCs and platelets unremarkable
3050.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several small lymphocytes, most with scant cytoplasm and dense, irregular nuclei containing notches or clefts. One lymphocyte has a rounder nucleus with a slightly broader rim of basophilic cytoplasm, and a neutrophil is present at the field edge. No blasts or atypical large cells are seen, and red cells and platelets are normal. The picture of small, mature-appearing clefted lymphocytes is suggestive of pertussis-associated lymphocytosis.

ddx.vs: CLL lymphocytes are round with block-like chromatin and smudge cells and show a clonal CD5+/CD23+ phenotype, unlike polyclonal pertussis lymphocytes.
Deeply cleaved buttock cells are clonal CD10+/BCL2+ B cells in adults, while pertussis lymphocytosis affects children and is reactive.
Viral infections produce large lymphocytes with abundant basophilic cytoplasm hugging RBCs rather than small clefted cells with scant cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Pertussis lymphocytosis — small mature lymphocytes with dense irregular clefted nuclei and scant cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：同視野有一顆核圓、胞質較多的淋巴球可作對照，考官會要你指出哪幾顆是「clefted lymphocytes」。
Pertussis 的淋巴球增多來自 pertussis toxin 阻止淋巴球離開血液，細胞形態成熟、多株性。
與 EBV/CMV 的差別：病毒感染為大型 reactive lymphocyte、胞質豐富被紅血球壓出凹痕；pertussis 則是小而胞質少的細胞。
實驗診斷：鼻咽 PCR；成人或青少年症狀不典型，白血球增多也較不明顯。
治療與預防：macrolide（azithromycin）；嬰兒重症風險高，孕婦 Tdap 可提供新生兒保護。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易當成 viral reactive lymphocytosis；病毒感染為大型、胞質豐富的反應性淋巴球，pertussis 則是小型、核有裂溝、胞質極少的成熟淋巴球。

quiz.q: 圖中核有裂溝的小淋巴球與旁邊核圓的淋巴球相比，前者在兒童最常提示哪種感染？
quiz.a: Pertussis（Bordetella pertussis，百日咳）

2986.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中嗜酸性系細胞含粗大紅色巨大顆粒，另有空泡化巨噬細胞，右下方一顆巨噬細胞吞噬了數個紅血球（噬血現象），符合 Chediak-Higashi 症候群合併噬血變化。
features: Eosinophilic precursor with coarse, oversized red-orange granules
Large vacuolated macrophage with abundant pale cytoplasm (left)
Macrophage containing phagocytosed red cells within vacuoles (lower right)
Granulocytic precursors with coarse granules and small erythroid precursors
Scattered mature lymphocytes
2986.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixed hematopoietic population. An eosinophilic precursor contains coarse, abnormally large red-orange granules, and granulocytic precursors show coarse granulation. A large vacuolated macrophage is present, and another macrophage contains engulfed erythrocytes within cytoplasmic vacuoles. Findings are consistent with Chediak-Higashi syndrome with hemophagocytosis, suggesting an accelerated phase.

ddx.vs: Familial HLH shows hemophagocytosis without giant granules in granulocytes.
Secondary HLH has normal granulocyte granules and an identifiable trigger such as EBV.
Pseudo-CH granules occur within a myeloid neoplasm with blasts or dysplasia rather than a congenital syndrome with albinism.

2794.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片免疫染色中，只有一個間質性淋巴球聚集呈強棕色陽性，其他造血區域只有零星陽性細胞；抗體未標示，依標題推測是 T 細胞標記，顯示聚集為 T 細胞性。
features: Low-power core biopsy with cellular marrow, fat spaces and trabeculae
Single well-circumscribed interstitial aggregate with strong brown staining
Scattered individual positive cells in the interstitium
No paratrabecular or diffuse positive infiltrate
Hematopoietic cells in the background negative
2794.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of a bone marrow core biopsy shows cellular marrow with a single discrete interstitial lymphoid aggregate that is strongly positive, together with scattered positive interstitial cells. There is no paratrabecular or diffuse infiltrate. The antibody is not specified on the image; if this represents CD3, the aggregate is T-cell rich. Paired with a negative or sparse CD20/PAX5 stain in a patient after rituximab, the pattern supports rituximab-associated reactive T-cell aggregates.

ddx.dx: Residual follicular or marginal zone lymphoma
ddx.vs: Residual B-cell lymphoma aggregates are often paratrabecular (FL) or intrasinusoidal (MZL) and composed mainly of PAX5-positive B cells.
Mast cell aggregates contain spindle mast cells with eosinophils and are tryptase/CD117/CD25-positive rather than CD3-positive.
T-cell lymphoma requires atypical cytology, aberrant immunophenotype and clonality, not a single bland T-cell aggregate.

2602.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中多顆大型異常前骨髓球，細胞質布滿紫紅色細至粗顆粒，核呈腎形、凹陷或雙葉（中下方一顆心形分葉核），與正常顆粒球系成熟序列不同，符合APL。
features: Large abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm
Dense fine-to-coarse azurophilic granules filling the cytoplasm, focally obscuring the nuclear border
Reniform, indented and bilobed (heart-shaped) nuclei with fine chromatin
Some cells with irregular cytoplasmic outlines and pale-blue agranular peripheral cytoplasm
Auer rod bundles not clearly identified
Occasional small orthochromatic erythroid precursor in the field
2602.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous large abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm densely filled with fine to coarse azurophilic granules. Nuclei are reniform, indented or bilobed with fine chromatin, and granules focally obscure the nuclear outline. Some cells have pale agranular cytoplasmic margins. Auer rod bundles are not clearly identified in this field, and normal maturing granulocytes are sparse. Findings are consistent with hypergranular acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent PML::RARA testing and coagulation studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: Normal promyelocytes have a round eccentric nucleus with a Golgi hof and are accompanied by an orderly maturation sequence rather than bilobed nuclei and obscuring granules.
Blasts in AML with maturation have fewer granules and nuclei are not bilobed, with MPO positivity but no PML::RARA.

ddx.dx: Acute monocytic leukemia with folded nuclei
ddx.vs: Monocytic cells have gray-blue cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules and are nonspecific esterase positive and CD14/CD64 positive, unlike strongly MPO-positive hypergranular promyelocytes.

exam.answer_en: Hypergranular acute promyelocytic leukemia — sheets of abnormal promyelocytes with dense granules and bilobed (heart-shaped) nuclei
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指中下方心形雙葉核的細胞，問此核型態意義 → APL 的特徵；並追問確診檢查 PML::RARA（FISH／RT-PCR）。
APL 為血液急症：常見 DIC、低 fibrinogen；懷疑時立即給 ATRA、積極輸血品支持，避免侵入性操作。
WHO 5th 將 APL 定義為 AML with PML::RARA fusion，不設 blast 門檻；ICC 2022 要求 blasts／異常前骨髓球 ≥ 10%。
Differentiation syndrome：發燒、呼吸窘迫、肺浸潤、水腫、腎功能惡化，處置為 dexamethasone，必要時暫停 ATRA／ATO。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 acute monocytic leukemia 混淆：單核球胞質灰藍、顆粒細如粉塵、NSE 陽性；APL 細胞顆粒粗密、MPO 強陽性、CD34−/HLA-DR−。

quiz.q: 圖中顆粒濃密、核呈雙葉的細胞構成的白血病，最常見致命併發症為何？
quiz.a: DIC／hyperfibrinolysis 導致出血（如顱內出血）

2346.recognize_zh: 中倍切片中，粉紅色細纖維狀膠狀基質佔滿髓腔，裡面只剩成串排列的少量造血細胞、充血的微血管與小而萎縮的脂肪空泡，符合骨髓膠狀轉化。
features: Diffuse pale eosinophilic, finely fibrillar extracellular ground substance replacing marrow
Small clusters and cords of residual hematopoietic cells, often aligned along capillaries
Numerous small round clear vacuoles consistent with atrophic adipocytes
Congested capillaries and sinusoids with red cells
Markedly reduced overall cellularity
2346.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy at intermediate power shows diffuse replacement of the marrow space by pale eosinophilic, finely fibrillar extracellular material. Residual hematopoietic cells are sparse and arranged in small clusters and cords, frequently adjacent to congested capillaries. Adipocytes are small and atrophic, appearing as scattered small vacuoles. Findings are consistent with gelatinous transformation of the marrow.

ddx.vs: Amyloid is homogeneous and waxy with Congo red apple-green birefringence rather than a loose Alcian blue-positive fibrillar matrix.
Fibrosis shows streaming spindle cells and reticulin/collagen fibers with clustered atypical megakaryocytes, not an amorphous mucoid matrix.
Hypocellular MDS retains fatty marrow with dysplastic megakaryocytes or increased blasts rather than extracellular gelatinous substance.

exam.answer_en: Gelatinous transformation (serous atrophy) of bone marrow — pale fibrillar extracellular matrix with atrophic fat cells and sparse hematopoiesis
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指淡粉紅色細纖維狀基質，問「這是什麼物質、常見於哪種病人？」答 gelatinous transformation，見於 anorexia nervosa、cachexia、嚴重營養不良。
特殊染色：基質為酸性黏多醣（hyaluronic acid），Alcian blue 陽性、Congo red 陰性，可與 amyloid 區分。
其他原因：AIDS、慢性酒精、惡性腫瘤末期消耗、慢性心衰或腎衰；本質是極度能量缺乏時脂肪細胞與造血細胞萎縮。
臨床：周邊常見 pancytopenia，anorexia nervosa 可伴 acanthocytes；營養恢復後骨髓變化可逆，不需化療或特殊治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 amyloidosis 或 myelofibrosis：amyloid 為均質蠟樣、Congo red 蘋果綠雙折射；骨髓纖維化有 reticulin 增加與梭形細胞；膠狀轉化為鬆散 Alcian blue 陽性基質。

quiz.q: 圖中取代髓腔的淡粉紅纖細基質，用哪一種特殊染色可確認其黏多醣性質？
quiz.a: Alcian blue（陽性）

2282.recognize_zh: 成串聚集的中型母細胞，核質比極高、細胞質稀少淡藍，染色質細緻，多顆核有凹痕、摺疊或腦回狀（convoluted）外形，無顆粒，是淋巴母細胞的形態，常見於 T 淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: Aggregates of medium-sized blasts with very high N:C ratio
Nuclear irregularities including notches, folds and convolutions in several cells
Finely stippled chromatin with inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm, occasionally with small vacuoles
Few red cells; no granules or Auer rods
2282.describe_en: Smear shows aggregates of medium-sized blasts with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely stippled chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm. Several blasts show nuclear notching, folding or convolutions. No granules or Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia; the convoluted nuclei are compatible with but not specific for T-lymphoblastic leukemia, which requires immunophenotypic confirmation.

ddx.vs: Nuclear convolutions occur in both, so separation depends on flow cytometry for cytoplasmic CD3 versus CD19/CD79a.
Monoblasts have more abundant gray granular cytoplasm and are NSE, CD14 and CD64 positive.

ddx.dx: Sézary cells / leukemic mature T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform nuclei with condensed mature chromatin and are TdT negative, unlike the fine blast chromatin here.

1962.recognize_zh: 細胞抹片（推測為淋巴結印片）中細胞組成多形：小淋巴球、染色質細緻並帶淡藍胞質的中大型淋巴樣細胞、胞質深藍的免疫母細胞與漿細胞樣細胞，並夾雜少數顆粒球，呈現 AITL 常見的混合性細胞組成。
features: Polymorphous population of small, medium and large lymphoid cells
Medium to large cells with round to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and moderate pale blue cytoplasm
Immunoblasts and plasmacytoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Scattered small mature lymphocytes, a band/segmented granulocyte at upper left, and a few small dark cells
Pale grey proteinaceous background with scattered red cells and fine granular debris
1962.describe_en: Cytologic smear (likely a lymph node touch imprint) shows a polymorphous population of small lymphocytes, medium to large lymphoid cells with finely dispersed chromatin and moderate pale blue cytoplasm, and scattered immunoblasts and plasmacytoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm. Occasional granulocytes are present in a proteinaceous background. The mixed cellular composition is not diagnostic on cytology alone, but in the setting of the corresponding histology and a TFH immunophenotype, findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive imprints show a similar spectrum of cells, so separation requires histologic architecture, TFH immunophenotyping, and T-cell clonality studies.
DLBCL imprints are dominated by a monotonous population of large cells rather than a mixture of small, medium and plasmacytoid cells.
cHL imprints show scattered Reed-Sternberg or Hodgkin cells with giant nucleoli among small lymphocytes, eosinophils and histiocytes.

1898.recognize_zh: 高倍下為中型淋巴樣細胞，核形不規則、有凹陷或切跡，染色質細緻分散、核仁不明顯，並可見核分裂像與散在淡粉紅色組織球；細胞較典型套細胞淋巴瘤稍大，需考慮母細胞樣／多形性變異型。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells, somewhat larger than typical small MCL cells
Irregular, indented to cleaved nuclear contours
Finely dispersed to vesicular chromatin with small inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant cytoplasm; a mitotic figure is present
Scattered pale eosinophilic histiocytes in the background
1898.describe_en: High-power section shows a diffuse population of medium-sized lymphoid cells with irregular, indented nuclear contours, finely dispersed chromatin, small inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. A mitotic figure is identified, and scattered epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm are admixed. There are no centroblasts or immunoblasts forming sheets. Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma, and the relatively large cell size with mitotic activity raises consideration of a blastoid/pleomorphic variant, warranting Ki-67 and TP53 assessment.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are TdT and CD34/CD99 positive with finer blast chromatin, whereas blastoid MCL is TdT negative and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive.
DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli (centroblasts/immunoblasts) and are cyclin D1 negative (except rare CD5+ cases).
Burkitt shows cohesive medium cells with multiple small nucleoli, starry-sky macrophages, Ki-67 ~100%, CD10+/BCL2−, and MYC rearrangement rather than CCND1.

1770.recognize_zh: 免疫染色（未標示抗體，推測為ALK）中，大型多形性腫瘤細胞同時呈細胞核與細胞質棕色陽性，背景小細胞與基質細胞核為綠色陰性，這種核加質的染色模式符合NPM1-ALK融合的ALK陽性間變性大細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Large pleomorphic tumor cells with irregular, lobulated nuclei and prominent nucleoli
Brown granular cytoplasmic staining together with nuclear staining in the large cells
Some tumor nuclei show paler central staining with nucleoli highlighted
Background small cells and stromal nuclei unstained with methyl green counterstain
Antibody is not labeled in the image; the nuclear plus cytoplasmic pattern is interpreted as ALK
1770.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain with methyl green counterstain shows large pleomorphic tumor cells with granular brown cytoplasmic and nuclear positivity, while background small cells and stromal cells are negative. The antibody is not labeled in the image; in this context the combined nuclear and cytoplasmic pattern is most consistent with ALK expression. This pattern corresponds to the NPM1-ALK fusion produced by t(2;5)(p23;q35). Findings are consistent with ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: ALCL with a variant ALK partner (e.g., TPM3-ALK)
ddx.vs: Variant translocations give cytoplasmic-only or membranous ALK staining without nuclear positivity, whereas NPM1-ALK gives nuclear plus cytoplasmic staining.
ALK+ LBCL shows granular cytoplasmic ALK with plasmablastic morphology, is CD30 weak or negative, and expresses plasma cell markers (CD138, MUM1).
ALK-negative ALCL can look identical on H&E and CD30 but lacks ALK staining and has a worse prognosis.
IMT is ALK positive but consists of spindled myofibroblasts in an inflammatory background and is CD30 negative, SMA positive.

exam.answer_en: ALK-positive ALCL (presumed ALK IHC) — nuclear plus cytoplasmic ALK staining in large pleomorphic cells, indicating NPM1::ALK t(2;5)
pearls_zh: 判讀 ALK IHC：除陽性與否，要看染色定位。核 + 細胞質陽性 → NPM1::ALK（t(2;5)，最常見）；只有細胞質或膜陽性 → 其他 partner（如 TPM3::ALK）。
考法：考官問「這個染色模式代表哪個轉位？」答 t(2;5)(p23;q35) NPM1::ALK；NPM1 帶核定位訊號使融合蛋白進入細胞核。
ALK+ ALCL 好發兒童與年輕成人，預後較 ALK− 佳；ALK 也可用 FISH（ALK break-apart）確認重組。
ALK 陽性的其他血液腫瘤：ALK+ large B-cell lymphoma（顆粒狀細胞質染色、漿母細胞形態、CD30 弱或陰性）；非血液如 inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor、部分肺腺癌。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把所有 ALK 陽性都當成 NPM1::ALK；只有細胞質染色、無核染時應想到 variant partner，若細胞為漿母細胞樣、CD30 弱，則要考慮 ALK+ LBCL 而非 ALCL。

quiz.q: 圖中 ALK 同時呈核與細胞質陽性，對應哪一個染色體轉位與融合基因？

1642.recognize_zh: 低倍下一條粉紅色厚壁小動脈（中央動脈，central arteriole）被深藍色小淋巴球鞘包圍（PALS/白髓），外圍為富含紅血球的紅髓，是正常脾臟白髓與紅髓的典型分區。
features: Muscular arterioles with eosinophilic walls (central arterioles) in the white pulp
Dense cuff of small dark lymphocytes around the arterioles (periarteriolar lymphoid sheath)
Paler transitional zone at the edge of the white pulp (marginal zone region)
Surrounding red pulp rich in red cells with cords and sinuses
No germinal center, granuloma, or infiltrate in this field
1642.describe_en: Low-power section of spleen shows white pulp composed of dense small lymphocytes arranged around muscular central arterioles, forming periarteriolar lymphoid sheaths. The lymphoid tissue merges peripherally into a paler zone and then into congested red pulp composed of cords and sinuses. No follicular expansion, nodular infiltrate, or granuloma is identified. Findings are consistent with normal splenic white and red pulp.

ddx.vs: SMZL shows enlarged, often biphasic white pulp nodules with expanded pale marginal zones and red pulp involvement, rather than the modest normal lymphoid sheaths seen here.
HCL diffusely infiltrates red pulp with blood lakes and atrophic white pulp, whereas the red pulp here is congested but not infiltrated.
Congestive splenomegaly shows fibrotic dilated sinuses and Gamna-Gandy bodies, which would require assessment of the whole organ and are not seen here.

exam.answer_en: Normal spleen — white pulp with central arterioles sheathed by small lymphocytes (PALS) surrounded by congested red pulp
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指粉紅厚壁小血管與周圍深藍淋巴球鞘，問「這是什麼構造？主要是哪類淋巴球？」答 central arteriole 與 PALS，PALS 以 T 細胞為主；濾泡與 marginal zone 則為 B 細胞。
紅髓由 cords of Billroth 與 sinusoids 組成；脾竇內襯 littoral cells（CD8 陽性），負責過濾老化或變形紅血球。
淋巴瘤侵犯分區常考：SMZL 以白髓結節擴大為主；hairy cell leukemia 侵犯紅髓並形成 blood lakes；hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma 侵犯紅髓竇道。
判讀脾臟切片先定位白髓/紅髓比例與分布，再判斷有無結節擴大、紅髓浸潤、肉芽腫或髓外造血。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把正常 PALS 與 marginal zone 當成 SMZL 結節；正常白髓小而分布均勻、無雙相性擴大的淡染 marginal zone，且紅髓無浸潤。

quiz.q: 圖中包圍中央小動脈的深藍淋巴球鞘叫什麼？主要由 B 或 T 細胞組成？
quiz.a: Periarteriolar lymphoid sheath（PALS）；主要為 T 細胞。

1450.recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶（G-banding）部分核型圖，只顯示一對第 5 號染色體：右側箭頭指的那條明顯較短，長臂中段缺失，標示為 del(5)(q13q33)；左側為正常同源染色體，並以小箭頭標出斷點位置。
features: Partial G-banded karyotype showing a single chromosome 5 pair
Left homolog normal, with small arrows marking the q13 and q33 breakpoint regions
Right homolog (large arrow) visibly shorter with loss of mid long-arm bands
Interstitial deletion labeled del(5)(q13q33)
1450.describe_en: Partial G-banded karyotype shows a chromosome 5 pair in which one homolog, indicated by the arrow, is shortened owing to an interstitial deletion of the long arm between bands q13 and q33, compared with the normal homolog on which the breakpoints are marked. The abnormality is designated del(5)(q13q33). When present as the sole abnormality, or with one additional abnormality other than -7/del(7q), in a myelodysplastic neoplasm with fewer than 5% marrow blasts, this defines MDS with low blasts and isolated del(5q), which is associated with a favorable response to lenalidomide.

exam.answer_en: Partial G-banded karyotype: interstitial deletion del(5)(q13q33) — cytogenetic hallmark of MDS with isolated del(5q)
pearls_zh: 讀圖：比較同源第 5 號染色體，異常者長臂中段缺失、變短，ISCN 寫法 del(5)(q13q33) 表示在 q13 與 q33 兩斷點之間的 interstitial deletion。
判讀規則：結構異常需在 ≥2 個 metaphase 出現才算 clone；需分析足夠 metaphases（常規 20 個）才能說是 isolated。
FISH（如 EGR1 5q31 probe）可在 metaphase 不足時補充偵測，但無法看出其他額外異常，因此不能取代核型。
WHO 5th 稱 MDS with low blasts and isolated 5q deletion（MDS-5q）；ICC 2022 稱 MDS with del(5q)。可再合併一個額外異常，但不可為 -7 或 del(7q)。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 del(5q) 與 -5（整條 monosomy）或複雜核型中的 5q loss 混為一談；後兩者屬不良預後，不歸入 isolated del(5q) MDS。

quiz.q: 此核型圖應如何以 ISCN 表示？

1514.recognize_zh: 中央一顆漿細胞的細胞質被許多淡藍灰色、圓形的免疫球蛋白小球（Russell bodies）塞滿，呈葡萄串狀，即 Mott 細胞（grape cell）；周圍是核偏位、細胞質深藍且有核周淡染區的漿細胞，符合多發性骨髓瘤。
features: Central Mott cell: plasma cell with cytoplasm packed with multiple pale blue-gray round globules (Russell bodies), compressing the nucleus
Surrounding plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hof
Several immature-appearing plasma cells with larger nuclei, less condensed chromatin and visible nucleoli
Scattered small dark lymphocytes/erythroid precursors in the background
Increased plasma cells overall in this aspirate field
1514.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an increased population of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs, some with immature features including larger nuclei, less condensed chromatin and visible nucleoli. In the center is a Mott cell whose cytoplasm is filled with numerous pale blue round Russell bodies (accumulated immunoglobulin). Scattered other marrow elements are present. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm (multiple myeloma) in the stated context; percentage of clonal plasma cells should be established by differential count and CD138/light-chain studies.

ddx.vs: Mott cells also occur in reactive states, where plasma cells are mature, usually <10% and polytypic for kappa/lambda.
LPL contains a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P rather than sheets of immature plasma cells.
Macrophages have a small central nucleus with fibrillar or foamy cytoplasm, not discrete immunoglobulin globules in a plasma cell with a hof.
Dutcher bodies are intranuclear PAS-positive pseudoinclusions, whereas Russell bodies are cytoplasmic globules.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell myeloma — Mott cell (grape cell) packed with Russell bodies among eccentric-nucleus plasma cells
pearls_zh: 考法：指中央細胞問名稱；答 Mott cell，其內小球為 Russell bodies（粗面內質網堆積的免疫球蛋白），胞核內者稱 Dutcher bodies。
Mott cell 本身不具特異性，反應性 plasmacytosis 也可見；需以 κ/λ 輕鏈限制性證明 clonality。
Flow/IHC：CD138+、CD38+；neoplastic plasma cells 常 CD19−、CD45−/dim、CD56+，並呈單一輕鏈（cytoplasmic κ 或 λ）。
IMWG：clonal BMPC ≥10% 加上 CRAB 或 SLiM（BMPC ≥60%、involved/uninvolved FLC ratio ≥100、MRI >1 個 ≥5 mm focal lesion）才診斷 myeloma。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Gaucher cell 或吞噬細胞；Mott cell 有偏位漿細胞核與核周淡染區，內容物為分散圓形小球，而非皺紙狀胞質。

quiz.q: 中央細胞稱為什麼？其內圓形小球名稱為何？
quiz.a: Mott cell（grape cell）；Russell bodies

106.recognize_zh: 脾臟切面佈滿均勻、粟粒狀的灰白色小結節（白髓擴張），切片低倍下可見大量擴張融合的淋巴結節被紅髓分隔，結節由小至中型、胞質淡染的B細胞組成且紅髓亦受侵犯，符合脾邊緣區淋巴瘤（SMZL）的白髓結節型態。
features: Gross: diffuse miliary pattern of uniform, pale tan 2-4 mm nodules replacing the cut surface of a markedly enlarged spleen
Low power: numerous expanded, closely packed, partly confluent white pulp nodules with intervening compressed red pulp
Neoplastic cells small to medium-sized with round to slightly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, and a rim of pale cytoplasm; red pulp cords and sinuses also infiltrated
Touch imprint/aspirate: monotonous small-to-intermediate lymphocytes with modest pale blue cytoplasm, admixed with scattered histiocytes and neutrophils
IHC: diffuse strong B-cell marker staining in nodules and red pulp; T cells reduced to scattered cells and perivascular/trabecular zones; membranous marker highlighting cells filling the nodules
Peripheral blood: occasional lymphocyte with mature clumped chromatin and slightly irregular cytoplasmic border (villous projections not prominent in this field)
106.describe_en: Splenectomy specimen shows marked splenomegaly with a cut surface diffusely replaced by innumerable uniform, pale miliary nodules. Sections show effacement by numerous expanded, partly confluent lymphoid nodules centered on the white pulp, separated by red pulp that is also infiltrated by small lymphoid cells. The neoplastic cells are small to medium-sized with round to slightly irregular nuclei, condensed chromatin, and a moderate rim of pale cytoplasm; large transformed cells are not a dominant population, and touch preparations show a monotonous small-to-intermediate lymphoid population. Immunostains show a diffuse B-cell population filling nodules and red pulp with only scattered background T cells; individual antigens are not labeled on the images, so antigen-specific interpretation relies on the case history (IgD expression reported). Findings are consistent with splenic marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: HCL diffusely infiltrates red pulp with atrophic white pulp and blood lakes, whereas SMZL expands the white pulp into nodules; HCL is CD103/CD25/CD123/annexin A1+ and BRAF V600E mutated.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL diffusely involves red pulp cords and sinuses without the micronodular white pulp expansion seen here and is typically IgD negative.
MCL can also produce a miliary white pulp pattern but shows cyclin D1 and SOX11 positivity with CD5 expression and t(11;14).
CLL/SLL involves white and red pulp with proliferation centers and is CD5+/CD23+/LEF1+, while SMZL is usually CD5-/CD23- with marginal zone cytology.

exam.answer_en: Splenic marginal zone lymphoma — miliary expanded white pulp nodules on gross and histology with red pulp infiltration by small-medium B cells
pearls_zh: 考法：給脾臟切面照片，問均勻粟粒狀小結節代表白髓擴張（micronodular），這是 SMZL 的典型；紅髓瀰漫浸潤則要想 HCL 或 splenic diffuse red pulp lymphoma。
表型：CD20+，CD5、CD10、CD103、cyclin D1、Annexin A1 陰性，常 IgD 陽性；周邊血可見極性短絨毛淋巴球（villous lymphocytes）。
遺傳：del(7q) 常見，NOTCH2、KLF2 突變；骨髓常見血竇內浸潤，CD20 IHC 易看出。
與 HCV 感染相關者抗病毒治療可緩解；其他治療選項為 rituximab 或脾切除。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 HCL、MCL 或 CLL 侵犯脾臟混淆；HCL 只侵紅髓且 CD103/Annexin A1 陽性，MCL cyclin D1 陽性，CLL CD5/CD23 陽性。

quiz.q: 脾臟切面呈均勻粟粒狀結節，反映的是紅髓還是白髓病變？最可能的淋巴瘤是？
quiz.a: 白髓擴張；splenic marginal zone lymphoma

42.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結呈模糊結節狀，結節由小 B 淋巴球構成（膜性 B 細胞標記陽性、濾泡樹突細胞網存在）；結節內散在具大核仁的單核 Hodgkin 細胞與少數多核細胞，B 細胞標記陰性、CD30/CD15 型膜加 Golgi 點狀陽性，符合富含淋巴球的典型 Hodgkin 淋巴瘤（結節型）。

42.describe_en: Lymph node biopsy shows effacement by a vaguely nodular proliferation composed predominantly of small lymphocytes, without broad sclerotic bands. Within the nodules are scattered large mononuclear and occasional binucleated cells with vesicular chromatin and prominent eosinophilic nucleoli, set in a lymphocyte-rich background with few eosinophils or neutrophils. Immunostains (markers not labeled in the figures) show that the nodules are composed of small B cells with an associated dendritic meshwork, whereas the large cells are negative for the membranous B-cell marker, show only weak nuclear staining with a nuclear B-cell marker, and display membranous and paranuclear dot staining with a CD30/CD15-type marker. Findings are consistent with classical Hodgkin lymphoma, lymphocyte-rich subtype with nodular growth.

ddx.vs: LP (popcorn) cells have multilobated nuclei with small nucleoli and are CD20+, OCT2/BOB1 strong, CD30-/CD15-, whereas the large cells here are B-marker-negative/PAX5-dim and CD30/CD15-positive.
NScHL has broad collagen bands and lacunar cells with a mixed inflammatory background, which are absent in these lymphocyte-rich nodules.
THRLBCL has scattered CD20+ large B cells in a diffuse T-cell and histiocyte background lacking small B-cell nodules, unlike the CD20-negative, CD30+ cells within B-cell nodules here.
Reactive immunoblasts are CD20+/PAX5 bright, CD15-negative and confined to germinal centers or interfollicular areas, without Reed-Sternberg-type cells.
